episodes.overview: Rudeus sinks into depression following Eris's departure. As he struggles to get back on his feet, the many people he's met continue their own journeys.

episodes.title: Dreams and Reality
episodes.overview: Rudeus and Eris finally return to Fittoa, but sudden goodbyes and unpleasant news make their homecoming bittersweet.

episodes.title: Turning Point 2
episodes.overview: Rudeus, Eris, and Ruijerd are nearing the end of their journey, but a chance encounter in a snowy mountain pass threatens to put a premature end to their adventures.

episodes.title: The Birth of My Little Sister, the Maid
episodes.overview: Rudeus is in desperate straits, imprisoned in a magic-proof dungeon by a despotic prince. But just when all seems hopeless, an unexpected visitor appears with a strange request. Will Rudeus be able to talk his way out of this one?

episodes.title: Route Selection
episodes.overview: Dead End finally arrives in the Shirone Kingdom on the Central Continent. Rudeus is anxious for a reunion with Roxy, but an unexpected vision from the Man-God means he may be in for more than he bargained for.

episodes.title: Separate Journeys
episodes.overview: After setting out from Millishion, Rudeus, Eris, and Ruijerd board a ship back to the Central Continent. Meanwhile, Roxy arrives in Rikarisu, where she encounters some familiar faces.

episodes.title: Reunion
episodes.overview: After having a family squabble with Rudy, Paul kept brooding and drinking. Will Paul's depression and anxieties continue? Or will he have a change of heart and talk to Rudy?

episodes.title: Family Squabble
episodes.overview: Rudeus and his team arrive in Millishion. In the city, he comes across a kid being kidnapped. He follows them and gets into a fight with the kidnappers, but these people are actually involved with someone whom Rudeus knows very well.

episodes.title: Slow Life in the Doldia Village
episodes.overview: Dead End decide to wait out the rainy season in the Doldia village. Eris befriends the chieftain's granddaughter, but her fondness for Ghislaine leads to unexpected conflict.

episodes.title: No Such Thing as a Free Lunch
episodes.overview: Rudeus finds himself imprisoned by the beast people in Doldia Village. Will Ruijerd and Eris arrive to clear his name before he loses patience and tries to fight his way to freedom?

episodes.title: Missed Connections
episodes.overview: Roxy arrives on the Demon Continent to begin her search for Paul's missing family. Meanwhile, Rudeus strikes a deal with smugglers to transport Ruijerd across the ocean.

episodes.title: The Woman with the Demon Eyes
episodes.overview: Dead End discovers that Ruijerd will have to pay a fortune in fees to leave the Demon Continent. As they struggle to find a way around this unexpected roadblock, Rudeus receives another vision.

episodes.title: Children and Warriors
episodes.overview: With their new money-making scheme in place, Dead End head out to track down a mysterious monster. Unfortunately, the job doesn't go as smoothly as they hope, and Rudy's plans may turn out to be a lot less safe than he thought.

episodes.title: The Value of a Life and the First Job
episodes.overview: Rudeus, Eris, and Ruijerd make it to a city. They need to earn money for their journey, and decide to register as adventurers, but Superd like Ruijerd aren't allowed inside. Rudeus has a plan, but how well will it hold up in practice?

episodes.title: A Chance Encounter
episodes.overview: Rudy and Eris find themselves stranded in the wilds of the Demon Continent. Their only chance to survive seems to lie in Ruijerd, a warrior of the infamous Superd tribe of demons, but can he be trusted?

episodes.title: Turning Point 1
episodes.overview: Rudy reaches his 10th birthday, and Eris and her family plan a surprise party for him. Meanwhile, the strange orb hovering over the city remains a mystery as powerful entities across the world begin to take note of it.

episodes.title: What Lies Beyond Effort
episodes.overview: Eris's 10th birthday is fast approaching, and her grandfather has invited nobles from across the kingdom to a dance party to celebrate. There's just one problem: Eris can't dance, and she's quickly losing patience with her lessons.

episodes.title: A Day Off in Roa
episodes.overview: Rudy is officially Eris's tutor, but she doesn't want to learn anything but magic. As Rudy struggles to get her interested in other subjects, he realizes that non-stop lessons are causing her stress and proposes a day off in the city.

episodes.title: A Young Lady and Violence
episodes.overview: Rudy arrives in the city of Roa, where he's supposed to spend the next five years tutoring the daughter of the local lord. His student, however, is more than he bargained for, and he'll have to fight to start his first ever job, let alone keep it.

episodes.title: Emergency Family Meeting
episodes.overview: The Greyrat family is overjoyed when Zenith announces that she's pregnant with a second child, but the mood takes a dour turn when Lilia reveals that she is also pregnant and Paul is the father. Will this be the end of Rudy's happy family?

episodes.title: A Friend
episodes.overview: Rudy begins to explore the village and rescues a green-haired child from a group of bullies. The two grow close practicing magic, but is there more to Rudy's new friend than he thinks?

episodes.title: Teacher
episodes.overview: Rudy begins training with his new magic tutor and learning swordsmanship from his father. He makes rapid progress, but traumatic memories from his past life leave him to afraid to go outside. Is his second chance already doomed to failure?

episodes.title: Jobless Reincarnation
episodes.overview: A 34-year-old unemployed recluse get hit by a truck... and wakes up as a newborn baby in a fantasy world! With loving parents, a lifetime of regrets, and a beginner's magic textbook, he sets out to make the most of his second chance at life.

title: The Walking Dead: Dead City
overview: Maggie and Negan travel to post-apocalyptic Manhattan - long ago cut off from the mainland. The crumbling city is filled with the dead and denizens who have made it a world full of anarchy, danger, beauty, and terror.

episodes.title: Tenebrae
Hourglass
episodes.overview: As Negan faces his fate, Maggie pleads with him to save the community.

episodes.title: Genesis
episodes.overview: Maggie and Negan find themselves in different circumstances, wrestling with their purposes.

episodes.title: Imperialis
episodes.overview: Maggie, Negan, Dillard, and Renata go on a hunt to resupply their dwindling resources.

episodes.title: Found / Lost
episodes.overview: Maggie and Luis look for valuable resources, while Negan and Renata protect the city.

episodes.title: Emigrants
episodes.overview: Maggie, Negan and their new community receive an unexpected overflow of survivors.

episodes.title: Haven
episodes.overview: Maggie and Negan deal with old enemies.

episodes.title: Trillium
episodes.overview: Maggie and Negan are caught in a treacherous situation that challenges their newfound alliance.

episodes.title: If History Were a Conflagration
episodes.overview: Maggie makes a painful choice, while Negan puts on a show.

episodes.title: Novi Dan, Novi Početak
episodes.overview: Negan and Maggie go on harrowing journeys and face unexpected challenges.

episodes.title: Bridge Partners Are Hard to Come By These Days
episodes.overview: Maggie considers making an alliance, as the outcome of Negan's actions come to a head.

episodes.title: The Bird Always Knows
episodes.overview: Negan makes some big moves, while Maggie takes matters into her own hands.

episodes.title: Feisty Friendly
episodes.overview: Maggie uncovers surprising information. Negan attempts to outmaneuver a slippery foe.

episodes.title: Why Did the Mainlanders Cross the River?
episodes.overview: Negan tries something new with The Croat. Maggie travels into a dangerous, surprising place.

episodes.title: Another Shitty Lesson
episodes.overview: Maggie begins a treacherous journey back to the island. Negan reluctantly joins the fight.

episodes.title: Power Equals Power
episodes.overview: In the war for control of Manhattan, Maggie and Negan find themselves trapped on opposite sides.

episodes.title: Doma Smo
episodes.overview: Tensions between Maggie and Negan come to a head; Ginny's search continues; questions arise around Armstrong's path forward.

episodes.title: Stories We Tell Ourselves
episodes.overview: Truths are unearthed and motives are revealed as Maggie, Negan and the others travel further into the city's depths.

episodes.title: Everybody Wins a Prize
episodes.overview: Maggie and Negan carry out an attack, but not everything unfolds according to plan; Ginny and Armstrong each make unexpected contact with others.

episodes.title: People Are a Resource
episodes.overview: Dark instincts reveal themselves as Maggie and Negan form a strategy; Armstrong is tested; Ginny embarks on a daring journey.

episodes.title: Who's There?
episodes.overview: Maggie and Negan encounter native New Yorkers; Armstrong revisits a trauma; Ginny attempts to adapt to change.

episodes.title: Old Acquaintances
episodes.overview: Maggie and Negan travel to Manhattan; a marshal named Armstrong follows Negan.

title: Silo
overview: In a ruined and toxic future, thousands live in a giant silo deep underground. After its sheriff breaks a cardinal rule and residents die mysteriously, engineer Juliette starts to uncover shocking secrets and the truth about the silo.

episodes.title: Troy
episodes.overview: Season finale. A leader wakes to a new world.

episodes.title: Farewell
episodes.overview: Camille's announcement shakes the entire silo. Daniel and Helen attend a special event.

episodes.title: Gray Goo
episodes.overview: Knox's father Gus comes clean about a secret. Charlotte makes a life-changing decision.

episodes.title: Radio
episodes.overview: Juliette sends Lukas and Kennedy on a mission, as a desperate Camille threatens Robert to tell the truth.

episodes.title: The Drive
episodes.overview: Billings and Hank stumble on a new mystery. Daniel and Helen receive a surprising proposition.

episodes.title: Memory
episodes.overview: The events following Juliette's return come to light—and unexpected allies are made.

episodes.title: Whatever You Do, Don't Go Home
episodes.overview: The race to evade Camille leads Juliette to a shocking discovery. Daniel seeks help from a friend.

episodes.title: A Dark Web
episodes.overview: Juliette takes control of her recovery process. Helen suffers consequences of her investigation.

episodes.title: It's All Good
episodes.overview: Billings investigates a disappearance. Daniel Keene has a run-in with a reporter.

episodes.title: Who Are You?
episodes.overview: New mayor Juliette can't remember anything from her time outside—or her past.

episodes.title: Into the Fire
episodes.overview: Season finale. The rebels make their move—and so does Juliette.

episodes.title: The Safeguard
episodes.overview: Billings' faith is shaken. Lukas heads to the down deep. Knox identifies the traitor. Juliette uncovers the truth about Solo's past.

episodes.title: The Book of Quinn
episodes.overview: Juliette discovers something's happened to Solo. Bernard makes an offer to Walker. Lukas meets with Salvador Quinn's descendants.

episodes.title: The Dive
episodes.overview: Lukas is assigned a mission. Mechanical sends a powerful message. Juliette embarks on a perilous descent—and confronts a new danger.

episodes.title: Barricades
episodes.overview: Bernard enacts a plan to root out Knox, Shirley, and Walker. Billings takes a stand. Solo saves Juliette's life and wants something in return.

episodes.title: Descent
episodes.overview: Sims finds himself with a new position. Juliette learns Solo isn't being honest. Bernard and Lukas make an important discovery.

episodes.title: The Harmonium
episodes.overview: Juliette sets out on a dangerous quest to retrieve a suit so she can return home and save her silo. Mechanical plans a meeting with Judge Meadows.

episodes.title: Solo
episodes.overview: Bernard turns to Judge Meadows for help. Billings begins to wonder if he's being lied to. Juliette finally meets the man in the vault.

episodes.title: Order
episodes.overview: In Silo 18, shock and unrest take hold in the wake of Juliette doing what no one's done before.

episodes.title: The Engineer
episodes.overview: Juliette finds sanctuary in a silo long ago destroyed by war, thinking she's alone.

episodes.title: Outside
episodes.overview: Season finale. Juliette's fate seems sealed when certain truths finally come to light.

episodes.title: The Getaway
episodes.overview: Racked with guilt, Billings sets off on a personal mission, only to discover a mind-blowing clue from Juliette.

episodes.title: Hanna
episodes.overview: New information causes Juliette to see her family's past differently—and she finally gains access to the silo's biggest secrets.

episodes.title: The Flamekeepers
episodes.overview: Bernard seeks Juliette's cooperation as he grows increasingly concerned about the silo's security. Juliette asks her father for a favor.

episodes.title: The Relic
episodes.overview: During her investigation, Juliette uncovers disturbing secrets about someone she thought she knew.

episodes.title: The Janitor’s Boy
episodes.overview: Sims appoints Billings as chief deputy to keep tabs on Juliette, whose efforts to solve two murders lead to a showdown.

episodes.title: Truth
episodes.overview: Juliette tries gaining the trust of Deputy Marnes as they work to uncover the truth about recent tragedies.

episodes.title: Machines
episodes.overview: In her hunt for a new sheriff, Mayor Jahns clashes with Bernard. Juliette strikes a deal to keep the generator running.

episodes.title: Holston’s Pick
episodes.overview: Juliette, an engineer, pieces together what might have led to a co-worker's mysterious death.

episodes.title: Freedom Day
episodes.overview: Sheriff Becker's plans for the future are thrown off course after his wife meets a hacker with information about the silo.

title: One Piece
overview:
Years ago, the fearsome Pirate King, Gol D. Roger was executed leaving a huge pile of treasure and the famous "One Piece" behind. Whoever claims the "One Piece" will be named the new King of the Pirates.

Monkey D. Luffy, a boy who consumed a "Devil Fruit," decides to follow in the footsteps of his idol, the pirate Shanks, and find the One Piece. It helps, of course, that his body has the properties of rubber and that he's surrounded by a bevy of skilled fighters and thieves to help him along the way.

Luffy will do anything to get the One Piece and become King of the Pirates!

The Threat of the Arrow-Arrow Fruit - Gunko vs. the Straw Hats
episodes.overview: Gunko from the Knights of God shows up right in front of Nami and the others and reveals to them that their plan is to take the children to Mary Geoise. Enraged, the Straw Hats launch an attack, only to be completely overwhelmed by Gunko's extraordinary power.

episodes.title: Elbaph in Flames! Jinbe's Shoulder Throw Explodes!
episodes.overview: In the Underworld, Loki talks about a pirate he idolized when he was young. Meanwhile, in the Sun World, the marching children get closer to the fire. The Elbaph Fire Brigade tries to extinguish the flames, while others beg the children to stop. When all hope seems lost, a lone savior arrives to turn the tide.

episodes.title: Save the Children! The Elbaph Warriors Rise Up
episodes.overview: As monsters assault villages throughout Elbaph, the Giants scramble to hold them back. Meanwhile, as the sleeping children get closer to the fire, Saul tries everything to stop them, but suddenly, he finds his efforts stymied.

episodes.title: A Nightmarish Game - The Dark Plot of the Knights of God
episodes.overview: Saul tries to stop the marching children, but as he reaches out to them, some unknown force gets in his way. Meanwhile, hearing the school's emergency call throws Dorry and the others at the Western Village into disarray, just as a monster appears before them as well.

episodes.title: What I Fear Most
episodes.overview: A massive snake suddenly attacks the Walrus School. Saul and the other teachers stand their ground to protect the children, but just then, another mystery strikes, plunging the school into pure panic.

episodes.title: The Heinous Sinner - Loki of the Underworld Freed?!
episodes.overview: While observing the Jewel Tree Adam along with Ripley, Franky learns of Elbaph's weak points. Meanwhile, in the Underworld, Luffy and Zoro find a heavily injured Loki. As they argue over whether to unchain him, an unexpected turn of events blindsides them.

episodes.title: Get the Key! Luffy vs. Scopper Gaban
The Legend Lurking in Elbaph - The Identity of the Mountain-Eater
episodes.overview: While exploring the abandoned castle, Luffy and the others find a strange mark on the floor of the throne room and hear a mysterious voice out of nowhere. At the banquet, Oimo tells Usopp the tale of a legendary man linked to the Pirate King.

episodes.title: Ancient History - The Harley Passed Down by Elbaph
episodes.overview: Leaving behind a brutal parting gift, Shamrock and Gunko of the Knights of God abandon Loki and move on to their next strategy. Meanwhile, Franky is shown old wall paintings, and Robin reads an important religious text passed down since ancient times in Elbaph.

episodes.title: Shamrock Appears - Commander of the Knights of God
episodes.overview: Luffy and some of his companions snuck out of the banquet to explore the deceased king's castle.

episodes.title: Encountering Loki - Gunko of the Knights of God
episodes.overview: Amidst the roaring banquet with the Giants, Luffy hears the legend of the Sun God passed down in Elbaph and learns why Loki is being held captive. In the Underworld, two mysterious guests appear before Loki, expressing their desire to recruit him into their order of knights.

episodes.title: A Welcome with Friends' Cups and Intruders Seeking Loki
episodes.overview: Robin, Chopper, Bonney, and Lilith enjoy the Owl Library.

episodes.title: Saul's Resolve - The Inherited Will of Ohara
episodes.overview: Robin formally introduces Luffy and the others to Saul. Then his assistant, Ange, shows them around the school, where Usopp is shocked by the education being provided there. Meanwhile, Robin is taken to the library by Saul, where she is met with an incredible sight.

episodes.title: I Want You to Praise Me - The Reunion of Robin and Saul
episodes.overview: Robin and the others finally arrive at the port of the Western Village in Elbaph.

episodes.title: A Gargantuan Wave of Emotion - The Dreamlike Scenery of Elbaph
episodes.overview: As the Great Erik, carrying Robin and the others, reaches the island of Elbaph, a breathtaking rainbow stretches out before them. Yet even greater astonishment awaits them in the direction the ship is traveling.

episodes.title: A Dangerous Deal! Loki of the Underworld and Luffy
episodes.overview: Luffy encounters Loki, the Accursed Prince, who offers him a deal. He hints at a connection to Shanks, all while savage beasts crowd around, staring Luffy down. Meanwhile, Zoro and the others on the suspension bridge realize someone is following them.

episodes.title: An Encounter on a Snowfield - Loki, the Accursed Prince
episodes.overview: Leaving the Block Kingdom behind, Luffy and the others find themselves facing a vast snowy landscape and a massive suspension bridge. They resolve to move forward, only to be halted by approaching figures and a mysterious roar.

episodes.title: Destroy the Miniature Garden - Escape Block Kingdom!
episodes.overview: Pursued by the Sun God, the Straw Hats flee across Block Kingdom at full speed. Amidst the chaos, the Sun God's true objective begins to surface. But as they run, another wall blocks their path. Their breakthrough rests on Luffy's fists.

episodes.title: A Quest in the Land of Mystery! The Secret of the Sun God
episodes.overview: Luffy and the others come across a warrior riding a grasshopper.

episodes.title: Nami in a Fix! An Adventure in Block Kingdom
episodes.overview: Nami awakens to find herself in a completely unfamiliar place. Giant creatures attack one after another, driving her into a corner. At that moment, she hears a voice calling her name.

episodes.title: The Long-sought Elbaph! The Big Reunion Banquet!
episodes.overview: After leaving Egghead, the Straw Hats and the Giant Pirate Crew celebrate their reunion with a big banquet.

episodes.title: The Promised Horizon - Off to the Long-Awaited Elbaph
episodes.overview: York wakes up to see Island Clouds rising, and to her surprise, something is about to be taken away. Meanwhile, at Mary Geoise, the Celestial Dragons realize their food stock is dwindling and become belligerent. Another one of Vegapunk's Satellites, Lilith wakes up and receives astonishing news.

episodes.title: The Truth Behind the Secret Plan - Vegapunk Claims Victory
episodes.overview: Two weeks before the battle erupted on Egghead, Vegapunk found out someone stole a portion of the Mother Flame. Along with Pythagoras and Shaka, he launched an investigation and identified the culprit, also learning their shocking motivation. Then, for the future of humanity, he resolved himself to make a bold decision.

episodes.title: The Upheaval of an Era! The Color of the Supreme King That Leads Luffy
episodes.overview: Vegapunk's speech raises the spirits of the pirates across the world, infuriating the Navy and the civilians. However, the broadcast is suddenly cut off while Vegapunk is still speaking. Meanwhile, off the coast of Egghead, the Five Elders are about to deliver the Straw Hats and the Giants a deadly strike

episodes.title: Her Father and Mother's Legacy! Bonney's Nika Punch
episodes.overview: Zoro and the others who are on the Sunny in the Labophase finally attempt to escape, but at the cost of an unexpected sacrifice. Meanwhile, as Vegapunk concludes his speech, Bonney once again faces St. Saturn, the object of her great hatred.

episodes.title: Her and Her Father's Dream! Bonney's Free Future
episodes.overview: Luffy finally hops on the Elbaph ship along with Dorry and Brogy, but the Five Elders catch up to them and begin their assault. Aboard the burning ship, Bonney hears a familiar sound and then finds a new strength in her memories of her father.

episodes.title: Get the Ship Moving! The Iron Giant Activates
episodes.overview: Vegapunk's revelation shocks even Koby and his fellow SWORD members, leading them to discuss what to do next.

episodes.title: The Void Century - A Revelation About a Sinking World
episodes.overview: The severely injured Edison begs Stussy to escape, but she makes a stunning request in exchange. Meanwhile, Vegapunk presents another astonishing disclosure about a past cataclysm and the Ancient Weapons that will fundamentally challenge the beliefs of people everywhere.

episodes.title: The Lost History - Joyboy, the First Pirate
episodes.overview: Vegapunk's revelation sends shockwaves around the world. St. Saturn abandons his fight with Nami and the others and rushes to stop the broadcast at all costs. Vegapunk goes on to expose another stunning truth, this time about Joyboy, the first pirate.

episodes.title: A Stunning Conclusion - Vegapunk's Great Prediction
episodes.overview: Vegapunk's broadcast resumes as people in various locations all over the world listen closely. St. Mars rushes to find the Transponder Snail that is the source of the broadcast while the Straw Hats and their allies clash with the other members of the Five Elders.

episodes.title: An Imminent Threat - Stussy and Edison's Resolve
episodes.overview: Franky and Bonney clash with Navy vice admirals in front of the Elbaph ship. St. Mars tries to find the room from Vegapunk's broadcast. The heavily injured Stussy tells Kaku the reason she chose to stay behind while Edison takes desperate action to help the Straw Hats escape.

episodes.title: Friends Fight Together! Luffy and the Warriors of Elbaph
episodes.overview: Dorry and Brogy finally reunite with Luffy. However, they are still facing St. Saturn and St. Warcury in their alternate forms. Dorry blows a horn to alert his people to prepare to escape, but St. Warcury unleashes a deafening roar.

episodes.title: The Worst Nightmare - The Five Elders Come Together
episodes.overview: Just like when St. Saturn emerged on Egghead, black lightning strikes and pentagrams appear again. The Pacifistas are rendered immobile by an unknown shadow. Meanwhile, as the time for the Straw Hats to evacuate the island is drawing near, the fight between Zoro and Lucci intensifies.

episodes.title: Vegapunk's Secret Plan - A Tense Worldwide Broadcast
episodes.overview: Suddenly, Vegapunk's broadcast begins and the whole world is taken by surprise. As everyone rushes to set up Video Transponder Snails and screens to watch it, the Five Elders grow concerned and discuss countermeasures.

episodes.title: Come In, World - Vegapunk's Message
episodes.overview: Caribou begs Augur and Devon to let him meet Blackbeard. An order is given to the Navy vice admirals to kill Jewelry Bonney at all costs in order to take back control over the Pacifistas. Sanji flees with the injured Vegapunk while Luffy holds St. Saturn back.

episodes.title: Reliable Reinforcements! Dorry and Brogy Arrive!
episodes.overview: The Giant Pirate Crew led by Dorry and Brogy arrive at Egghead, which deeply moves Usopp and the others. Zoro keeps fighting Rob Lucci and the Pacifistas continues to torment the Navy while Luffy shows Bonney how to throw a real punch.

episodes.title: An Admired Hero - The Warrior of Liberation Who Saves Bonney
episodes.overview: Vegapunk reveals the secret he alone has been keeping regarding the Pacifistas. Meanwhile, Bonney, her back against the wall, hears a familiar rhythm. It's the rhythm that her father taught her along with the legend of the hero he admired.

episodes.title: Destroy Egghead - The Buster Call is Invoked
episodes.overview: As an order comes down to evacuate the island in preparation for bombardment, Navy soldiers rush to their ships. Meanwhile, Vegapunk pleads with Saturn to halt the attack, arguing how vital the island is for the future of humanity, but Saturn refuses to listen.

episodes.title: Thank You, Dad - Bonney and Kuma's Warm Embrace
episodes.overview: Kuma, battered and without free will, approaches Bonney. Overcome with emotion, she tells him she saw all his memories and learned everything that he did for her. Watching the scene, Vegapunk wonders what compelled Kuma to come to Egghead.

episodes.title: I'm Sorry, Dad - Bonney's Tears and Kuma's Fist
episodes.overview: The present day on Egghead, Bonney is caught in St. Saturn's grasp, knowing he is responsible for her father's transformation into a cyborg. However, Saturn reveals an even more shocking truth that throws Bonney into despair.

episodes.title: Kuma's Life
episodes.overview: Bonney sails out to sea in search of her father and rises to prominence. At the same time, Luffy makes his name by defeating the Arlong Pirates and declaring war against the World Government. Watching his actions, Kuma begins to hold a certain belief.

episodes.title: To the Sea Where My Father is! The Future Bonney Chooses
episodes.overview: Bonney has been waiting for a letter from her father Kuma who promised to write to her. But with no letters in sight, she turns nine and one day realizes her disease is cured. She then decides to go out to sea to search for her father.

episodes.title: Cruel Fate - Kuma's Decision as a Father
episodes.overview: Taking advantage of Kuma's love for his daughter Bonney, the World Government imposes three harsh conditions on him in exchange for her treatment. Kuma agrees to them and Bonney's treatment starts at Laboratory 8 in tandem with the clone development with which Kuma agrees to cooperate.

episodes.title: To Save His Daughter - Kuma the Timid Pacifist
episodes.overview: By fighting off King Bekori who is supported by the World Government, Kuma is put on the wanted list and decides to travel around the world in search of a cure for Bonney's disease. He reunites with Dragon and learns about the Government's eccentric scientist who might be able to cure Bonney.

episodes.title: A Pledge to Ginny - Kuma Becomes a Father
episodes.overview: Two years after Ginny's abduction, the Revolutionary Army suddenly receives a call from her.

episodes.title: A Fleeting Moment of Happiness - Kumachi and Ginny
episodes.overview: Kuma and Ginny live peacefully in the Sorbet Kingdom eight years after the God Valley Incident. However, their new king initiates a policy of enslaving the poor. Kuma tries to free those who were captured but ends up being imprisoned himself. But a familiar face comes to rescue him.

episodes.title: A History Erased! God Valley of Despair
episodes.overview: The human hunt begins and the Celestial Dragons start chasing locals of God Valley and slaves for prizes. Ivankov and Ginny share with Kuma and the others their surprising plan to survive the game. Meanwhile, ships full of infamous pirates start arriving on the island one after another.

episodes.title: Kuma's Past - Better Off Dead in This World
episodes.overview: Bonney gets captured by St. Saturn, whose enigmatic power keeps Sanji and Franky from saving her. In St. Saturn's clenched fist, she recalls the memories of her father, Kuma. 47 years ago, Kuma was born to a father of a race on the verge of extinction.

episodes.title: The Nightmare Strikes - Godhead of Science & Defense, St. Saturn
episodes.overview: Vegapunk successfully wrests back the Pacifistas from the Navy, but another party soon gains control of them. At the same time, Luffy, Zoro, and the others sense an unearthly presence just as a pentagram suddenly appears on Egghead.

episodes.title: Luffy vs. Kizaru! A Fierce Kaleidoscopic Battle
episodes.overview: A bizarre battle between Luffy and Kizaru heats up. Meanwhile, in the Fabiriophase, Bonney is all alone and being chased by the Navy soldiers. Dr. Vegapunk sees this and can't help but leave the Labophase to rescue her, risking his life.

episodes.title: Looming Despair! Admiral Kizaru's Depressing Mission
episodes.overview: Kuma finally reaches Mary Geoise and keeps advancing even without free will or mind. But Fleet Admiral Akainu stands in his way. On Egghead, Kizaru enters the Labophase and delivers a powerful kick to Luffy who tries to stop him.

episodes.title: A Clash of Two Men's Determination! Kizaru and Sentomaru
episodes.overview: Navy Admiral Kizaru finally makes landfall on Egghead and Sentomaru, Vegapunk's bodyguard, stands in his way. The two men who were once close now clash violently. Meanwhile, Luffy and the others try their best to move the Sunny to the back side of the island to escape.

episodes.title: Completely Surrounded! The Operation to Escape Egghead
episodes.overview: In the Labophase on Egghead, which is completely surrounded by the Navy, Luffy and the others devise a plan to escape the island. However, the Frontier Dome, the laser defense system, cannot be deactivated without York's secret passcode.

episodes.title: The World Shakes! The Straw Hats' Hostage Situation
episodes.overview: As the news about Garp's disappearance and Luffy's hostage situation spreads, a mysterious earthquake suddenly shakes the entire world. Meanwhile, a huge Navy fleet led by Admiral Kizaru surrounds Egghead and listens in as York contacts Mary Geoise to negotiate a deal.

episodes.title: The Last Lesson! Impact Inherited
episodes.overview: Avalo Pizarro, who merged with the Pirate Island, reaches his giant hand to crush the Navy ship with many soldiers and civilians on board. The wounded Garp gives orders to Koby, Helmeppo, and Prince Grus, and delivers a powerful blow to save the ship.

episodes.title: Garp and Kuzan - A Master and a Pupil's Beliefs Clash
episodes.overview: At the Pirate Island of Beehive, Vice Admiral Garp deals with an overwhelming number of pirates alone. As he and his fellow Navy soldiers try to escape the island, the former Navy admiral Kuzan stands in their way.

episodes.title: The World Is Shaken! The Ruler's Judgment and the Five Elders' Actions!
episodes.overview: Vivi and Wapol try to escape Mary Geoise while Sabo also looks for a way to leave to deliver King Cobra's message to Luffy and Vivi. Meanwhile, Imu orders the Five Elders to test a horrendous weapon.

episodes.title: The Entrusted Message! King Cobra's Resolve
episodes.overview: King Cobra is surprised by seeing someone sitting on the Empty Throne. When he is subject to a deadly attack, Sabo cuts in to save him.

episodes.title: The Holy Land in Tumult! Sai and Leo's Full-Power Blow!
episodes.overview: Sabo runs into Kuma's daughter Bonney. Meanwhile, King Cobra of the Kingdom of Alabasta begins asking the Five Elders questions that trouble them.

episodes.title: Sabo Returns - The Shocking Truth to Be Told!
episodes.overview: Sabo starts recounting what happened at Mary Geoise. During the Reverie he witnessed Kuma being the Celestial Dragons' slave.

episodes.title: Let's Go Get It! Buggy's Big Declaration
episodes.overview: While the Marines deal with the problems caused by the Cross Guild, Buggy gives a passionate speech to Crocodile, Mihawk, and his crew.

episodes.title: The Navy Surprised! The Navy Headquarters' Former Admiral, Kuzan
episodes.overview: Kuzan stands in the way of Garp who came to rescue Koby. He was once Garp's pupil, but has now sided with Blackbeard.

episodes.title: For the Beloved Pupil - The Fist of Vice Admiral Garp!
episodes.overview: A massive warship comes flying towards the Pirate Island of Beehive and Vice Admiral Garp launches a crushing attack to save his pupil Koby.

episodes.title: Run, Koby! A Desperate Escape Strategy!
episodes.overview: Koby, who is being held captive on the pirate island of Beehive, has the chance to escape but decides to become a decoy to free slaves. Soon pirates from all over the island are after him, as there is a large bounty on his head.

episodes.title: Clash! Shanks vs. Eustass Kid
episodes.overview: Kid gives his crew a pep talk before the battle with Shanks. And Shanks also prepares for the battle but learns how his own subordinates do as they like to protect their beloved boss. Finally, Kid has his Damned Punk ready to shoot.

episodes.title: The Second Ohara! The Mastermind's Ambition!
episodes.overview: Stussy and Sentomaru discuss how big the threat that closes in on Egghead is as Luffy and the others keep fighting the uncontrollable Seraphim. Meanwhile, in an underground lab, someone approaches Vegapunk, who is being held captive.

episodes.title: Survive! Deadly Combat with the Strongest Form of Humanity!
episodes.overview: Luffy, Zoro, Rob Lucci and Kaku relentlessly attack the Seraphim, but the they keep getting back up. Meanwhile, Shaka goes to check one place where he thinks Vegapunk might be.

episodes.title: A Tough Decision! An Unusual United Front!
episodes.overview: Rob Lucci and Kaku ask Luffy and Zoro to uncuff them so they can fight alongside them against the Seraphim, but the two pirates are reluctant to do so.

episodes.title: Incomprehensible! The Seraphim's Rebellion!
episodes.overview: The Seraphim suddenly start attacking the Straw Hats and the Vegapunk Satellites. They are not stopping even when the Satellites order them to. When Luffy and Zoro are cornered, Lucci and Kaku wake up and make them a surprising offer.

episodes.title: A Shudder! The Evil Hand Creeping Up on the Laboratory!
episodes.overview: The search for Dr. Vegapunk continues and gets more complicated when the communications and surveillance goes down, causing Shaka to suspect an intruder.

episodes.title: Trouble Occurs! Seek Dr. Vegapunk!
episodes.overview: The Straw Hats and Dr. Vegapunk's Satellites find out that Vegapunk has disappeared and begin searching for him. Meanwhile, Bonney begins exploring her father's memories.

episodes.title: A Beautiful Act of Treason! The Spy, Stussy
episodes.overview: Stussy suddenly knocked out Lucci to the Straw Hats' surprise, and when Shaka reveals her true identity, they're stunned again. Meanwhile, a major incident occurs on an island called Sphinx where Whitebeard came from.

episodes.title: A Desperate Situation! The Seraphim's All-out Attack!
episodes.overview: After the Seraphim appear, Zoro and Brook now face seven powerful opponents. Sanji, Franky, Lilith and Edison head out to regain control of the Seraphim, while Lucci orders them to destroy the lab.

episodes.title: Turn Back My Father! Bonney's Futile Wish!
episodes.overview: Rob Lucci, Stussy and Kaku start attacking the Thousand Sunny. Luffy reunites with Nami and the others. Meanwhile, Bonney is pressing Vegapunk to change back her father Kuma.

episodes.title: Sinister Schemes! The Operation to Escape Egghead
episodes.overview: Lucci orders his troops to block off all Vegapunk's escape routes and looks to invade the Labophase. Elsewhere, at the Red Line, Kuma crashes into the Red Port.

episodes.title: The Strongest Form of Humanity! The Seraphim's Powers!
episodes.overview: Vegapunk explains how he managed to grant the Seraphim Devil Fruit powers. Meanwhile, Luffy is still facing Lucci in his awakened form, as the rocket to the Labophase is about to leave.

episodes.title: Powers on a Different Level! Luffy vs. Lucci!
episodes.overview: Lucci is instructed not to confront Luffy until Kizaru arrives with reinforcements, but the two attack each other with their newly awakened Devil Fruit forms. Meanwhile, Vegapunk reveals the shocking truth about the Gum-Gum Fruit.

episodes.title: Preparations for Interception! Rob Lucci Strikes!
episodes.overview: CP-0 led by Rob Lucci makes a forced landing at Egghead and people on the Fabriophase are plunged into confusion while Shaka and the others prepare to fight back on the Labophase. The enraged Atlas stands up to defend the peace of the island.

episodes.title: The Eccentric Dream of a Genius!
episodes.overview: Vegapunk reveals the shocking history of the ancient giant robot and asks Luffy to take him off Egghead. Rob Lucci and his fellow Cipher Pol agents arrive at the island and ask for permission to enter the port.

episodes.title: The Will of Ohara! The Inherited Research
episodes.overview: Shaka reveals the secret behind the foundation of the Revolutionary Army and how the relationship between Vegapunk and Dragon affected it. Meanwhile, Vegapunk explains to Luffy and the others about his special power and how his clones work.

episodes.title: A Forbidden Piece of History! A Theory Concerning a Kingdom
episodes.overview: Vegapunk Shaka shares with Robin and the others his theory about an ancient kingdom and the 100-Year Void. He even says that he visited Ohara after its destruction. Meanwhile, Luffy and Chopper try to activate the giant robot and something surprising happens.

episodes.title: The Brain of a Genius - Six Vegapunks!
episodes.overview: Nami and the others are attacked by a Pacifista who resembles Jimbei and while they're in battle, some of Vegapunk's Satellites look on with excitement. Meanwhile, Luffy and the others find something extraordinary at the scrap heap.

episodes.title: The Mystery Deepens! Egghead Labophase
episodes.overview: The Straw Hats without Luffy, Chopper, and Jimbei are taken to the laboratory on the clouds far above the ground by Lilith. They get excited about the things they've never seen before. However, inside the laboratory, a new threat is waiting for them.

episodes.title: The Winner Takes All! Law vs. Blackbeard!
episodes.overview: The Blackbeard Pirates ambushed the Heart Pirates led by Law. The Blackbeard Pirates' top officers use a variety of formidable Devil Fruit powers and keep pushing the Heart Pirates in order to obtain the copies of the Road Ponegliffs.

episodes.title: Bonney's Lamentation! Darkness Lurking on the Future Island
episodes.overview: While Luffy and the others are enjoying the futuristic machines of Egghead, someone who resembles Bartholomew Kuma comes after them. When Luffy tries to fight back, Bonney stops him and reveals her shocking relationship with Kuma.

episodes.title: Brimming with the Future! An Adventure on the Island of Science!
episodes.overview: A young girl who came out of the big robot names herself Dr. Vegapunk and it surprises Franky and the rest of the Straw Hats. Meanwhile, Luffy's group gets to the surface of the island where futuristic buildings stand and unknown giant creatures wander about.

episodes.title: A New Island! Future Island Egghead
episodes.overview: Luffy and Chopper fall into the rough cold sea along with the mysterious girl. Jimbei tries to help them but another attack comes from the unknown creature. Meanwhile, the Sunny is hit by torpedoes and the rest of the Straw Hats are thrown into the sea, too.

episodes.title: Entering a New Chapter! Luffy and Sabo's Paths!
episodes.overview: Sabo, the Chief of Staff of the Revolutionary Army, contacts Koala and everyone in Kamabakka Queendom. He explains to them about the things that he is accused of, but someone who was eavesdropping on the call takes a stunning action.

episodes.title: Luffy's Dream
episodes.overview: The three-way struggle between the Navy, the Blackbeard Pirates, and the Kuja Pirates comes to an end when an unexpected figure shows up. On the Sunny, the Straw Hats talk about the recent incidents around the world and Luffy's words surprise everyone.

episodes.title: The War on the Island of Women! A Case Involving Koby the Hero
episodes.overview: With the aid of their new Seraphim Pacifista, the Marines invade Amazon Lily with the intention of apprehending Pirate Empress Boa Hancock. But the Blackbeard Pirates make an appearance on Amazon Lily as well.

episodes.title: A New Emperor! Buggy the Genius Jester!
episodes.overview: The Straw Hat Pirates' new bounties are revealed. Meanwhile, Crocodile and  Mihawk, visit Buggy to discuss their newly-established organization, Cross Guild.

episodes.title: The Last Curtain! Luffy and Momonosuke's Vow
episodes.overview: The Straw Hat Pirates say their final goodbyes to Momonosuke, Kinemon, and Yamato, and formally declare Wano Country as one of their territories.

episodes.title: The Time of Departure - The Land of Wano and the Straw Hat Pirates!
episodes.overview: Zoro visits Yasuie's grave, where he encounters Hiyori, while Luffy visits the ruins of Oden Castle. Later, Luffy and Tama eat red-bean soup together for the last time

episodes.title: The World That Moves On! A New Organization, Cross Guild!
episodes.overview: The Straw Hats are surprised when Robin tells them about the Ancient Weapon Pluton. Kid reveals that a new criminal organization, the Cross Guild, has emerged.

episodes.title: A New Era Arrives! The Fury of Red-Haired Yonko
episodes.overview: Momonosuke and the Akazaya try to defend the Land of Wano against Admiral Ryokugyu, but they get driven into a corner.

episodes.title: The World in Flames! The Navy Admiral's Attack!
episodes.overview: The Akazaya attempt to stop Admiral Ryokugyu as he approaches the Flower Capital, but he outclasses them with his Devil Fruit power.

episodes.title: The Festival Banquet! New Emperors of the Sea
episodes.overview: The news of the defeat of the Emperors of the Sea spreads across the world. Luffy enjoys the banquet but just as he is about to make a toast, an enraged Kid comes in to strike him.

episodes.title: Dawn Has Come! Luffy and Friends Rest
episodes.overview: As the Five Elders learn of Wano's status, a festival is held to celebrate the alliance's victory. Meanwhile, an Admiral heads to Wano.

episodes.title: Return! Shogun of Wano Country - Kozuki Momonosuke
episodes.overview: When Kinemon and the other samurai who were thought to be dead emerge from the smoke, the residents of the Flower Capital become baffled. Momonosuke then announces to their victory and the return of the Kozuki Family to the citizens.

episodes.title: Closing the Curtain! Winner - Straw Hat Luffy!
episodes.overview: The samurai and the Straw Hats shout for joy as they hear that Luffy defeated Kaido.

episodes.title: The World That Luffy Wants!
episodes.overview: Kaido recalls being treated unfairly in the past and his vision of the ideal world. While his friends fight to survive on Onigashima, Luffy is asked by Kaido to imagine his ideal world.

episodes.title: Twenty Years of Prayer! Reclaim Wano Country
episodes.overview: As Luffy and Kaido prepare their final attack, Momonosuke is tasked with moving Onigashima out of the way of Luffy's attack.

episodes.title: Believe in Momo - Luffy's Final Powerful Technique!
episodes.overview: Momonosuke struggles to create flame clouds to sustain Onigashima. To fulfill his promise tothe people of Wano, Luffy inflates his fist to strike Kaido.

episodes.title: Nowhere to Run! Hell on Onigashima!
episodes.overview: Raizo and Jimbei work together to put out the fire that has spread throughout Onigashima.

episodes.title: The Ridiculous Power! Gear Five in Full Play
episodes.overview: While Luffy enjoys his new, bizarre power, Kaido is perplexed and can't make sense of it. As they wait for Luffy to win, Kid, Law, and the other allies carry on with the battle below.

episodes.title: Luffy's Peak Attained! Gear 5
episodes.overview: As Luffy's heart pounds in a funny way, the Five Elders reveal the secret behind the Gum-Gum Fruit. Meanwhile, Orochi tries to convince Komurasaki to escape with him, but when he sees Kanjuro, he makes a malicious decision.

episodes.title: Luffy is Defeated?! The Determination of Those Left Behind
episodes.overview: The battle between Luffy and Kaido comes to an unexpected end. After Kaido descends, he informs everyone that Luffy has lost.

episodes.title: There is Only One Winner - Luffy vs. Kaido
episodes.overview: A CP0 agent tries to get to Luffy, but Drake gets in the way. Meanwhile, Luffy, who is running dangerously low on energy, uses his final Gear Four to free the people of Wano from Kaido.

episodes.title: Moon Princess Echoes! Wano Country's Final Phase!
episodes.overview: Kaido mourns Big Mom's defeat and remembers the day he first met her. Meanwhile, Orochi sees the true nature of Komurasaki, the woman he loves, and trembles with fear.

episodes.title: To the New Era! Settled! The Determination of the Brats
episodes.overview: Big Mom is defeated by Law and Kid, whereupon she falls into the exposed magma chamber below.

episodes.title: The Main Attraction is Coming! Ultimate Attack of Shockwave and Magnetism
episodes.overview: After Big Mom recovers from Kid's previous onslaught, she unleashes a potent counterattack that endangers both Law and Kid. Even though they are exhausted, the two rivals start their own desperate attempt to get Big Mom out of Onigashima.

episodes.title: The Destruction of the Alliance?! Fire up, the Will of the New Generation!
episodes.overview: With Law and the Kid  worn out and deeply injured, Big Mom tries to get to the rooftop.

episodes.title: Shuron Hakke! A Lawless Dragon Approaches Luffy!
episodes.overview: The battle between Luffy and Kaido is becoming increasingly fierce. However, Kaido who is thrilled to have a strong opponent starts drinking too much.

episodes.title: Luffy Accelerates! The Turning Point of a New Era!
episodes.overview: Usopp discovers the severely injured Kiku and the upper body of Kinemon. However, they are unable to escape, because they are surrounded by Gifters.

episodes.title: King of Hell Three Sword Style - Zoro vs. King
episodes.overview: King recalls his first meeting with his captain and declares that Kaido is the one to become the King of the Pirates, which leads Zoro to set his swords alight with hellfire.

episodes.title: Attack of the Devil! Sanji vs. Queen
episodes.overview: Taking advantage of his scientific enhancements, Sanji discovers a new ability that could prove decisive in his fight with Queen.

episodes.title: Secrets of Enma! The Cursed Sword Entrusted to Zoro
episodes.overview: As Zoro recalls his past, the clues from his memory help him realize the secret necessary to truly master Enma.

episodes.title: Zoro's Hardship - A Monster! King the Wildfire
episodes.overview: Zoro is up against an seemingly unbeatable opponent in King. Not even one of Zoro's most lethal attacks manages to injure him.

episodes.title: The Onslaught of Kazenbo - Orochi's Evil Clutches Close in
episodes.overview: Kanjuro's creation, Kazenbo, is wreaking havoc all throughout the Skull Dome, causing panic among Beasts Pirates and samurai, alike.

episodes.title: For Luffy - Sanji and Zoro's Oath
episodes.overview: Sanji is plagued by the thought of turning into a vicious Germa warrior like his siblings. When he makes up his mind, he asks Zoro the ultimate favor.

episodes.title: Strike Back! Law and Kid's Counterattack Alliance
episodes.overview: Law and Child are facing a formidable opponent in Big Mom. But they see a chance to defeat her when they cooperate and make use of their awakened Devil Fruit powers.

episodes.title: A Shadowy Figure Pulls the Strings! Onigashima in Flames
episodes.overview: Kinemon hears an unexpected voice calling for Kanjuro. Orochi tries to stir up Kanjuro to make him perform one last time.

episodes.title: Death to Your Partner! Killer's Deadly Gamble!
episodes.overview: As Kid is dying not knowing where his damage is coming from, Killer takes a gamble in his fight with Hawkins.

episodes.title: Sanji's Mutation - The Two Arms in Crisis!
episodes.overview: Queen uses a special technique which can break every bone in Sanji's body. On the verge of a crisis, Sanji feels something strange once more.

episodes.title: The Situation Has Grown Tense! The End of Onigashima!
episodes.overview: While Zoro and Sanji are in a battle against King a Queen, Yamato and Momonosuke launch a secret operation.

episodes.title: A Legend All Over Again! Luffy's Fist Roars in the Sky
episodes.overview: Yamato and Momonosuke take on the important task of saving Onigashima. Meanwhile, Luffy and Kaido's clash shakes up the sky.

episodes.title: Two Dragons Face Off! Momonosuke's Determination!
episodes.overview: With Luffy's encouragement, Momonosuke bravely steps forward and faces Kaido in his dragon form.

episodes.title: Luffy Soars! Revenge Against the King of the Beasts
episodes.overview: Luffy flies on Momonosuke in his giant pink dragon form to get to Onigashima with him. Meanwhile, Yamato vows to survive until Luffy returns.

episodes.title: For the Future! Yamato and the Great Swordsmen's Pledge
episodes.overview: Yamato remembers three great samurai who he met as a child. Their stunning choice for the future of Wano encourages Yamato to keep fighting.

episodes.title: Ascend to the Dawn! A Pink Dragon Gets Agitated
episodes.overview: Zoro and Sanji continue their clash against King and Queen. Meanwhile Inuarashi confronts his nemesis Jack, who destroyed his country and Nekomamushi confronts Perospero, who is responsible for Pedro's death.

episodes.title: Taking a Chance! The Two Arms Go into Battle!
episodes.overview: Zoro gets back on his feet after taking the instant recovery drug from Zou and confronts King and Queen along with Sanji.

episodes.title: A Spell! Kid and Zoro Facing Threats!
episodes.overview: While Kid and Law take on Big Mom, Killer battles Hawkins and Sanji stuggles against both King and Queen, who try to go after Zoro while he is still incapacitated.

episodes.title: Clutch! A Demon Incarnate, Robin!
episodes.overview: After enduring Black Maria's physical and mental torture, Robin shows what she is truly capable of as a Demon Child.

episodes.title: Slash the Nightmare - Brook Draws His Freezing Sword!
episodes.overview: In the dense mist, Brook is surprised to see his old friends, the Rumbar Pirates and Laboon. They reminisce about the old days and play music together, however, they suddenly attack Brook.

episodes.title: The Predator's Trap - Black Maria's Temptation
episodes.overview: Suddenly Nico Olvia, Professor Clover and the giant Jaguar D. Saul appear in front of Robin.

episodes.title: Showdown Battles of the Monsters! Yamato and Franky
episodes.overview: Yamato unleashes his true power, Queen bombards Sanji with his cyborg-powers and Sasaki launches tricky attacks against Franky.

episodes.title: The Pride of a Helmsman – The Enraged Jimbei!
episodes.overview: When Who's-Who asks Jimbei a question, he tramples on the dignity of the Fish-Men, causing Jimbei's outrage.

episodes.title: A Dramatic Increase of Allies! Straw Hats Fight Back!
episodes.overview: Hearing Otama's command, the Gifters side with the samurai. Chopper starts to take care of Zoro and Jinbe gets stunned by Who's-Who's story.

episodes.title: Nami's Lethal Attack! Otama's Desperate Challenge!
episodes.overview: Nami strikes a thunder blast against Ulti to clear their way to the Live Floor. After that Usopp catches one of the Marys and Otama stands up to give a command to the Gifters.

episodes.title: Believe in Luffy! The Alliance's Counterattack Begins!
episodes.overview: Momonosuke and Shinobu run from Kaido while Law and Kid team up against Big Mom. Meanwhile, Nami and Usopp encounter an enemy they thought they had already defeated.

episodes.title: Fight Against the Dark Night – The Commander-in-chief of the Land of Wano Sounds Off
episodes.overview: Chopper is discouraged by the news of Luffy's loss and Queen doesn't miss the chance and tries to finish him off. However, Sanji comes to Choppers rescue. Meanwhile, Kin'emon fights for his life to save Momonosuke who makes a big anouncement after escaping!

episodes.title: The Animal Kingdom Pirates Trample Down! The End of the Kozuki Clan!
episodes.overview: The Straw Hats and their allies receive the news that Luffy lost his battle against Kaido. Meanwhile, Kanjuro disguises himself as Oden again and approaches Momonosuke to destroy the Kozuki lineage. However, Kin'emon amd Kiku stand in his way.

episodes.title: Luffy Defeated! The Straw Hats in Jeopardy?!
episodes.overview: Luffy falls into the sea after being pushed off the rooftop by Kaido. Meanwhile, Zeus intervenes in the fight between Big Mom and Nami's group and Chopper continues to stall Queen on the Live Floor.

episodes.title: The Conclusion! Luffy, Accelerating Fist of the Supreme King
episodes.overview: Sanji is forced to carry Zoro to the Live Floor, while Nami, Usopp and Big Mom face off against Ulti. On the rooftop, the intense battle between Luffy and Kaido continues.

episodes.title: The Dawn of the Land of Wano - The All-Out Battle Heats Up!
episodes.overview: The Akazaya are rushing to Momonosuke while Yamato tries to lure away the enemies. At the same time, Luffy lands a few punches on Kaido, Chopper struggles against Queen and Ulti faces off against Big Mom.

episodes.title: Nami Screams - A Deadly Death Race!
episodes.overview: Luffy and Kaido, who are both using Conqueror's Haki, keep clashing! In the meantime, Usopp, Nami and Tama are being chased by Page One on their way to the Performance Floor.

episodes.title: A Pledge for the Next Genesis! Luffy and Uta!
episodes.overview: After Uta travels with Shanks, she is not aboard when Shanks returns to Foosha Village. This shocks Luffy and he wonders what happened to her. At the same time, news spread that the island Elegia has been mysteriously destroyed.

episodes.title: A Faint Memory - Luffy and Red-Haired's Daughter Uta!
episodes.overview: Luffy meets Shanks and his daughter Uta for the first time and the two children begin developing their friendship.

episodes.title: Surpass the Emperor of the Sea! Luffy Strikes Back with an Iron Fist!
episodes.overview: The Worst Generation and Emperors scatter across Onigashima, preparing for new fights. Kid prepares to battle Big Mom, Killer fights Hawkins, and Luffy decides to take on Kaido all by himself. Meanwhile, Nami, Tama, and Usopp return to the Live Floor, chased by Page One.

episodes.title: Protect Luffy! Zoro and Law's Sword Technique
episodes.overview: After Big Mom was pushed off of the island the furious battle against Kaido continues. When Kaido tries to beat up the unconscious Luffy, Zoro launches an all-out attack to protect his captain.

episodes.title: The Supernovas Strike Back! The Mission to Tear Apart the Emperors!
episodes.overview: While the Akazaya take on Orochi, the members of the Worst Generation continue to fight against the Emperors. They try to separate Kaido and Big Mom to increase their chances of victory.

episodes.title: The Worst Generation Gets Wiped Out?! The Emperors' Deadly Attack!
episodes.overview: The Akazaya try to save Momonosuke but Jack stands in their way. Meanwhile, Chopper and Marco team up to take down Queen and the fierce battle on the rooftop rages on.

episodes.title: Oden Appears! The Confused Hearts of the Akazaya Members!
episodes.overview: The wounded Akazaya members are surprised to see Kozuki Oden alive. They were disappointed by their failure to take down Kaido, but now with their lord, they are filled with hope to face their sworn enemy again.

episodes.title: All Set! Chopperphage Nebulizer!
episodes.overview: While the captains of the Worst Generation still struggle against Kaido and Big Mom, Chopper finally manages to cure the samurai and Beast Pirates infected by Ice Oni.

episodes.title: No Regrets! Luffy and Boss, a Master-Disciple Bond!
episodes.overview: Chopper creates and tries the antidote for Ice Oni while Law, Kid, Zoro and Killer continue their battle against Big Mom and Kaido on the roof of the Skull Dome.

episodes.title: Spank Strikes! Sanji's Woman-trouble!
episodes.overview: Robin bursts in to rescue Sanji from the fangs of Black Maria. In the meantime, Yamato, Momonosuke and Shinobu are spotted hiding by the enemy and are forced to fight their pursuers.

episodes.title: Sanji's Scream! An SOS Echoes Over the Island!
episodes.overview: Sanji is captured and tortured by the Black Maria. She wants him to hand over Robin to her. Meanwhile, Carrot and Wanda continue their fight against Perospero.

episodes.title: Otama's Secret Plan! Operation Kibi Dango!
episodes.overview: Tama wondered if there was anything she could do to help the Straw Hats and the samurai. Now that she's here on Onigashima, it's time to execute her powerful plan – Operation Kibi Dango!

episodes.title: Kaido Laughs! The Emperors of the Sea vs. the New Generation!
episodes.overview: Luffy batters Kaido with his Kong Gatling and delivers a final blow using all his strength. Big Mom tries to fight back, but Law gets in her way.

episodes.title: A Barrage of Powerful Techniques! The Fierce Attacks of the Worst Generation!
episodes.overview: Luffy, Law, Kid, Zoro and Killer keep landing hard blows against Kaido in tandem despite the arguing. However, when Big Mom steps in and unleashes powerful lightning strikes, the tide turns for all except one of the rookies.

episodes.title: The Battle of the Monsters! The Three Stubborn Captains
episodes.overview: Luffy's strong attack reminds Kaido of all the strong opponents he has faced. Meanwhile, Sanji is caught and interrogated by Black Maria.

episodes.title: Straw Hat Luffy! The Man Who Will Become the King of the Pirates!
episodes.overview: Yamato tells Momonosuke about how Ace gave him hope for the future. Meanwhile, Luffy and the other allied pirates from the Worst Generation make it to the rooftop to finally face off against Kaido and Big Mom.

episodes.title: Marco's Tears! The Bond of the Whitebeard Pirates!
episodes.overview: Marco helps Zoro get to the rooftop where Kaido and Big Mom are waiting for their opponents.

episodes.title: Yamato's Past - The Man Who Came for an Emperor of the Sea
episodes.overview: Yamato tells Momonosuke and Shinobu that he once met Ace, who came to Onigashima looking to get Kaido's head. Yamato and Ace engaged in a fierce battle that eventually turned into an important friendship.

episodes.title: A Turnaround Move! The Flames of Marco the Phoenix!
episodes.overview: While Kaido begins the New Onigashima Project and makes the island float, Marco appears in front of Chopper and the others, who are struggling with Ice Oni.

episodes.title: It's Not Okay! The Spider lures Sanji!
episodes.overview: Sanji hears a woman's scream for help and rushes into the room the scream can be heard from. However, it's a trap set up by Black Maria of the Tobi Roppo. How will Sanji get out of this sticky situation?

episodes.title: Eliminate the Ice Oni! Chopper's Fire Trick!
episodes.overview: Zoro and Drake continue to chase Apoo to get the antibody against Ice Oni. In the castle, Luffy, Jimbei and Sanji are climbing up the stairs to reach the rooftop.

episodes.title: Sasaki's Onslaught - Armored Division vs. Yamato
episodes.overview: Carrot and Wanda help Marco, who is cornered by Big Mom and Perospero. In the meantime, Yamato fights against Sasaki in order to protect Shinobu and Momonosuke.

episodes.title: Nami Surrenders?! Ulti's Fierce Headbutt!
episodes.overview: Ulti and Page One  chase Nami and Usopp. Cornered, Nami gives in and Ulti pushes her to say the unthinkable.

episodes.title: Zoro's Pursuit! Ice Oni Tag
episodes.overview: Yamato fights Sasaki to protect Momonosuke. In the meantime, Zoro tries to get rid of the Gifters who have turned into Ice Oni, but Queen starts a horrible game that involves the antibody for the virus.

episodes.title: I Won't Forgive Him! Chopper's Determination!
episodes.overview: King orders his subordinates to go after Momonosuke. Meanwhile, seeing people suffering from Queen's Plague Rounds, Chopper is determined to save everyone.

episodes.title: The Power of Ice Oni! A New Version of the Plague Rounds!
episodes.overview: Queen blazes away at Zoro and Drake with a special version of the Plague Rounds. Meanwhile, Luffy and Sanji run into another Headliner with a special ability on their way to the rooftop.

episodes.title: An Inherited Technique! Unleashing Oden's Secret Swordplay!
episodes.overview: While Luffy rushes to the roof and Yamato tries to catch up with Momonosuke to protect him, the Akazayas finally confront Kaido. Hearing Kaido taunt them for their weakness, the samurais attack him relentlessly.

episodes.title: A Heroic Blade! Akazaya vs. Kaido, Again Once More!
episodes.overview: Queen uses a new version of the Plague Bullets which will turn the samurai into monsters. Meanwhile, the Minks keep pushing the fight against the Gifters and drive Jack into a corner.

episodes.title: A New Rivalry! Nami and Ulti!
episodes.overview: Drake vows to fight alongside Luffy's side, but Zoro becomes skeptical and challenges him to a fight. Meanwhile, Nami confronts Ulti, who is angered since her brother was attacked.

episodes.title: A Risky Invitation! A Plot to Eliminate Queen
episodes.overview: Who's-Who tries to bring Drake and Hawkins on board to kill Queen. Meanwhile, the Straw Hats are facing two large monsters that remind them of the Giant who they once struggled to take down.

episodes.title: Overwhelming Strength! The Straw Hats Come Together!
episodes.overview: Luffy and Zoro try to get to the rooftop to help the Akazayas but Queen and King get in their way. The rest of the Straw Hats arrive, the whole crew assembles and Luffy vows to take down Kaido.

episodes.title: The Fate That Protects You - Yamato and Momonosuke
episodes.overview: Franky, Robin and Jimbei face Big Mom but the Numbers interrupt their fight. One of them holds the Brachio Tank containing Usopp and Chopper in his hand. Meanwhile, Yamato finally meets Momonosuke.

episodes.title: Zeus' Treason?! The Cornered Nami!
episodes.overview: Shinobu tries to rescue Momonosuke but is discovered and attacked by King. Meanwhile, Nami is chased by Zeus who is ordered by Big Mom to kill her.

episodes.title: The Battle Under the Moon! The Berserker, Sulong the Moon Lion!
episodes.overview: Kaido's men are amazed when they see thousands of samurai warriors storming into the castle. Kaido goes outside to fight the Akazayas in his dragon form.

episodes.title: Onigashima in Tumult! Luffy's All-Out War Begins!
episodes.overview: The Akazayas deliver a devastating blow to Kaido. Luffy and Yamato try to support them, but Ulti and Big Mom get in their way. Meanwhile, Nami and Carrot set out to retrieve Zeus.

episodes.title: Raid! Inheriting Oden's Will
episodes.overview: The Akazaya charge at Kaido from the back entrance of Onigashima and open the fierce battle.

episodes.title: The Akazaya Face-off! Kikunojo vs. Kanjuro!
episodes.overview: While Kaido and Big Mom proclaim their goal, Kikunojo faces Kanjuro at the back entrance of Onigashima and gets into an emotional fight with her former colleague.

episodes.title: Explosive?! The Handcuffs that Shackle Yamato's Freedom!
episodes.overview: The Akazaya have reached the back entrance of Onigashima and try to get through the gate, but they are stopped by the traitor Kanjuro. Meanwhile, Kaido reveals his grand plan.

episodes.title: Desire to be Oden! Yamato's Dream!
episodes.overview: Orochi announces the execution of Momonosuke and Kaido also has an important announcement to make. Meanwhile, Yamato tells Luffy a story.

episodes.title: Enemy or Ally? Luffy and Yamato!
episodes.overview: Luffy is kidnapped by the ominous Yamato, who claims to be Kaido's son. How will their encounter unfold? Meanwhile, Chopper and Usopp are still on the run from Big Mom.

episodes.title: Thunder Bagua! Here Comes Kaido's Son!
episodes.overview: Luffy runs into two members of the Tobi Roppo: Ulti and Page The brother and sister duo use their Devil Fruit powers and turn themselves into massive beasts. When Luffy is driven into a corner, someone wearing a demon mask appears and whisks him away.

episodes.title: Oath of Man! Fierce Battle of the Brachio-Tank
episodes.overview: Big Mom chases the Brachio Tank V driven by Chopper and Usopp. Meanwhile, Kanjuro takes Momonosuke to Kaido and Orochi and informs them about Oden's vassals.

episodes.title: Reinforcements Arrive! The Commander of the Whitebeard Pirates!
episodes.overview: The Big Mom Pirates are climbing up the waterfall of Wano again. However, this time it is not King who hinders them, but an unexpected opponent stands in their way.

episodes.title: His Dream Broken?! The Trap That Lures Sanji!
episodes.overview: The Kid Pirates abandon their mission to join the fight against Apoo and the Beast Pirates to allow Luffy, Zoro, Kid and Killer continue searching for Kaido. Due to the commotion of the fight, the compound is emptying out, allowing Kinemon's forces to pass undetected.

episodes.title: Fighting Music! An Ability That Harms Luffy!
episodes.overview: As the Kid Pirates head towards Kaidou, Luffy and Zoro are attacked by Scratchmen Apoo with his Tone-Tone abilities. Kid gets blinded by revenge and attacks Apoo for betraying him.

episodes.title: Thinking of Otama! Luffy's Furious Strike!
episodes.overview: Luffy and Zoro pick a fight with the Beast Pirates for intentionally wasting food. Luffy's Elephant Gun causes even more chaos.

episodes.title: Luffy Goes Out of Control?! Sneaking into Kaido's Banquet
episodes.overview: As Kinemon and Denjiro's forces advance across the mountain paths, Luffy and his men charge through the main entrance. Luffy and Zoro get lost in the hustle and bustle of the banquet and strike up a conversation with Kaido's men.

episodes.title: The Samurai Warriors' Earnestness! The Straw Hats Land at Onigashima
episodes.overview: As the alliance reaches Onigashima, Kinemon uses his sorcery to change everyone's clothes to blend in with the Beasts Pirates. He then gives a speech to the samurai to take advantage of their disguises and reach the castle for the final battle.

episodes.title: Kaido's Trump Card! The Tobi Roppo Appear!
episodes.overview: While Luffy, Kinemon and all the other comrades are still on their way to Onigashima there's a big banquet on the island and Queen gives an unforgetable concert.

episodes.title: A New Member! 'First Son of the Sea' Jimbei!
episodes.overview: Jimbei has joined the Straw Hat Pirates and arrived in time to raid Onigashima. Now Kinemon is planning the invasion of the island.

episodes.title: A Tearful Promise! The Kidnapped Momonosuke!
episodes.overview: Kanjuro grabbed Momonsuke and is now on his way to Onigashima. Luffy and the others start heading there, but Kaido's army gets in their way again.

episodes.title: Good Luck?! Leader Kin'emon's Plot!
episodes.overview: Kyoshiro has come with his clan for support. But to everyone's surprise, he does not attack the Straw Hats or the Akazayas, but targets Kaido's fleet instead. How will the course of the battle develop?

episodes.title: The Worst Generation Charges in! The Battle of the Stormy Sea!
episodes.overview: Luffy, Law and Kid have come to the aid of Kinemon and the Akazayas. Before they can continue sailing towards Onigashima, they have to sink Kaido's battleships.

episodes.title: Pirates at Sea! Raid! Onward to Onigashima
episodes.overview: Kinemon and the other Akazayas want to cross to Onigashima by boat! However, they are stopped by Kaido's fleet on the way. The spy who revealed their plan finally reveals himself.

episodes.title: Back to the Present Day! 20 Years Later
episodes.overview: Momonosuke, Raizo, Kanjuro and Kinemon were sent 20 years into the future by Toki. In the meantime, their remaining comrades wait for them and disguise themselves among the people of Wano.

episodes.title: The Castle on Fire! The Fate of the Kozuki Clan!
episodes.overview: Oden Kozuki was executed but thanks to him his vassals were able to escape. They run to Oden Castle to help Toki and her children who are attacked by Kaido.

episodes.title: Oden Wouldn't Be Oden If It Wasn't Boiled!
episodes.overview: Oden and his vassals must endure one hour in the cauldron of boiling oil. If they succeed, they will be free. However, Orochi is already forging the next devious plan.

episodes.title: Boiled to Death! Oden's One-hour Struggle!
episodes.overview: Oden proposes a bet to Kaido and Orochi. If he and his vassals manage to survive in the cauldron for a certain amount of time, they must release them. Kaido and Orochi accept his proposal.

episodes.title: The End of the Battle! Oden vs. Kaido!
episodes.overview: It comes to the decisive battle between Kaido's army and Oden and his samurais. How will the battle end? What card does Kaido have up his sleeve against Oden?

episodes.title: Raid! Oden and the Akazaya Nine
episodes.overview: Oden keeps dancing naked in the Flower Capital and losing all the trust of the people. His vassals wonder why he is doing this. One day, Orochi comes to Kuri and reveals his evil plan for the Land of Wano.

episodes.title: Sad News! The Opening of the Great Pirate Era!
episodes.overview: Oden learns that Orochi is tyrannizing Wano as the new shogun. When he hears that Toki has been injured in an attack on Momonosuke, he rushes to the capital to attack Orochi.

episodes.title: To the Land of Wano! The Roger Pirates Disband!
episodes.overview: After the Roger Pirates have been on Laugh Tale, they decide to disband. Captain Roger is the first man to disembark. After that, his remaining crew takes Oden back to Wano.

episodes.title: The King of the Pirates is Born! Arriving at the Last Island!
episodes.overview: After Roger and his crew have inspected all the Road Poneglyphs, they set off for the last island. What awaits them there leaves them speechless.

episodes.title: Devoting His Life! Roger's Adventure!
episodes.overview: Roger's joint adventure with Oden continues. They travel to Sky Island, Water 7 and also Fish Man Island in search of the Porneglyph.

episodes.title: Roger's Wish! A New Journey!
episodes.overview: The Roger Pirates against the Whitebeard Pirates! Their battle extends over three days and nights. Which crew will emerge victorious?

episodes.title: Blades Crossed! Roger and Whitebeard!
episodes.overview: While Oden is still traveling the world with Whitebeard, his father's health is increasingly deteriorating. Orochi is to fill in as shogun until Oden's return.

episodes.title: Whitebeard's Little Brother! Oden's Great Adventure!
episodes.overview: Oden rescues Toki from the slavers and befriends her. She wants to travel to Wano, which unfortunately displeases him. With the appearance of Whitebeard on the coast, the course of their journey changes.

episodes.title: Oden's Determination! Whitebeard's Test!
episodes.overview: Whitebeard and his crew dock at one of the ports in the Land of Wano with their broken ship and the news excites Oden. He runs to the port and asks Whitebeard to let him get on board the ship but the request is rejected. When the ship's repairs are complete, Whitebeard tries to sneak out of the country, but he finds Oden tagging along.

episodes.title: Changing Destiny - The Whitebeard Pirates Cast Ashore!
episodes.overview: Oden transforms the wild land of Kuri into a habitable region and is made Daimyo over it. Then he meets Kawamatsu the Kappa and the two Minks, Dogstorm and Cat Viper, who become his followers like the others. Kin'emon and the other vassals are scolded by Yasuie when they try to steal money from him, and they begin reforming themselves for their lord Oden.

episodes.title: Tearfully Swearing Allegiance! Oden and Kin'emon!
episodes.overview: When the angry mountain god, the giant boar, almost kills Kin'emon, Oden steps in. Kin'emon is impressed when he sees Oden's strength and pledges his life to serve him. Disavowed by his father, Oden decides to go on a journey around the country and gathers more followers along the way.

episodes.title: The Number-One Samurai in the Land of Wano! Here comes Kozuki Oden!
episodes.overview: The night before the great battle, Orochi orders the destruction of the Sunny along with some bridges across the country to block Akazaya samurai's allies from their rendezvous. Disappointed, the group of samurai still sets out for Onigashima with the memory of their beloved lord, Oden, in their hearts. However, 41 years ago, Oden was not respected by everyone.

episodes.title: The Rendezvous Port! The Land of Wano Act Three Begins!
episodes.overview: On the day of the Fire Festival, Orochi leaves the mainland of the Land of Wano heading for Onigashima where a big banquet will take place. Meanwhile, at Tokage Port, the rendezvous point for the rebel group, Kin'emon and the others are stunned by the fact that none of their allies are there.

episodes.title: A Legendary Battle! Garp and Roger!
episodes.overview: Admiral Issho and Fleet Admiral Sakazuki argue over the abolition of the Seven Warlord system and the alliance of the two Emperors of the Sea. Meanwhile, ex-Fleet Admiral Sengoku teaches the young Navy soldiers about the legendary Rocks Pirates that Kaido and Big Mom once belonged to along with all the other big names.

episodes.title: Big News! An Incident That Will Affect the Seven Warlords!
episodes.overview: The resolution that passed the Reverie and the incidents surrounding the conference stun people all over the world and corner the Seven Warlords of the Sea. Meanwhile, a Navy captain Koby secretly contacts someone who is currently in the Land of Wano.

episodes.title: Ticking Down to the Great Battle! The Straw Hats Go into Combat Mode!
episodes.overview: Kin'emon, Momonosuke, and the others can't fight back tears when they hear that Hiyori is alive. Zoro is stunned by Enma's demonic power and its ties to him. And as the day of the Fire Festival is finally in sight, Kin'emon and the others head out for the rendezvous point.

episodes.title: A New Alliance?! Kaido's Army Gathers!
episodes.overview: As the day of the raid approaches, Law finds someone who might help him escape the prison and Kin'emon gathers up most of his main allies to discuss the raid plan. Meanwhile, at Onigashima, Kaido and Big Mom make a stunning declaration!

episodes.title: Its Name is Enma! Oden's Great Swords!
episodes.overview: Zoro runs after the warrior-monk who took his Shusui and Kawamatsu shares with Hiyori his memory of a fox that was guarding the graves in Ringo. As they catch up to Zoro, they find a room filled with swords. And Hiyori tells Zoro to give Shusui back to the Land of Wano.

episodes.title: Hiyori's Confession! A Reunion at Bandit's Bridge!
episodes.overview: As the clash between Kaido and Big Mom continues, Queen looks for a way to get out of Onigashima. Meanwhile in Udon, Old Man Hyo finds his former allies, four bosses from each region. At Bandit's Bridge, Hiyori and Kawamatsu finally see each other after a long time.

episodes.title: Tension Rises in Onigashima! Two Emperors of the Sea Meet?!
episodes.overview: Nami and Franky join Kanjuro who has taken Yasuie's dead body to bury him with Oden, and together they hit the road. Robin, Usopp, and Brook are at the dock trying to figure out a way to pass through a check point. Meanwhile, Big Mom and Kaido finally clash at Onigashima.

episodes.title: Orochi's Hunting Party! The Ninja Group vs. Zoro!
episodes.overview: After standing against Orochi, Zoro and Hiyori are chased by Orochi's ninja group. Meanwhile, Orochi is told that they captured Trafalgar Law as the people of the Flower Capital prepare for the upcoming Fire Festival.

episodes.title: Warriors' Dream! Luffy's Conquer of Udon!
episodes.overview: The freed prisoners in Udon refuse to fight alongside Luffy because he is a pirate. Raizo and Old Man Hyo try their best to convince them, but an unexpected person stands up to bring the prisoners hope after taking down Kaido!

episodes.title: We're Here to Win! Luffy's Desperate Scream
episodes.overview: Luffy faces those who are infected by the Plague Rounds and the non-infected prisoners who submit to the authority of Udon. To open their eyes, Luffy takes a measure that will risk his life. However, the Chief Warden Babanuki has something up his sleeve.

episodes.title: Start Fighting Back! Luffy and the Akazaya Samurai!
episodes.overview: Kawamatsu the Kappa is freed and stands up against Babanuki and his underlings! Listening to Old Man Hyo's suggestion, Raizo and Kiku reveal their true identities which give the desperate prisoners not only a shock but also some hope.

episodes.title: Brutal Ammunition! The Plague Rounds Aim at Luffy!
episodes.overview: Queen hastily ties up the sleeping Big Mom and carries her to Onigashima leaving Udon to Babanuki. Babanuki uses a weapon that Queen made to threaten inmates and make them catch Luffy, but a mysterious figure emerges from the forbidden cell to save Luffy.

episodes.title: Stop the Emperor of the Sea! Queen's Secret Plan!
episodes.overview: After finding out that Luffy ate the whole pot ofthe red-bean soup that she was looking for, Big Mom becomes infuriated and goesafter him. Meanwhile, Queen, the Lead Performer, comes up with a plan to stopthe rampaging Big Mom.

episodes.title: A Grudge Over Red-bean Soup! Luffy Gets into a Desperate Situation!
episodes.overview: Craving red-bean soup, Big Mom attacks Queen, the Animal Kingdom Pirates' Lead Performer who reins over Udon. However, when she finds out that the pot is empty, she turns her wrath against the one who ate it all: Luffy.

episodes.title: The Storm Has Come! A Raging Big Mom!
episodes.overview: Kin'emon apologizes Ashura Doji AKA Shutenmaru for goading Holdem to attack Atamayama where Ashura's hideout was located, and asks him to join the fight against Kaido.
