episodes.overview: After hearing that a small village has fake Rebel Army bodyguards that have been keeping peace, Vivi asks the men of the crew to test if they are worthy of staying.

episodes.title: Here Come the Desert Pirates! The Men who Live Free
episodes.overview: Nami and Vivi found themselves an easier way to travel in the desert and leave all men behind. While trying to catch up with them, Ace gets lost. Luffy and the rest of the gang find the Desert Pirates, and Vivi meets a figure from her past.

episodes.title: Adventure in the Country of Sand! The Demons that Live in the Scorching Earth
episodes.overview: After leaving Erumalu, the Straw Hats plus Vivi & Ace continue through the desert, facing the many dangers of it.

episodes.title: The Green City, Erumalu and the Kung Fu Dugongs
episodes.overview: Ace decides to travel with the Straw Hats, as he is hunting for a man known as Blackbeard. The group arrives first at the 'Green City' of Erumalu only to find it abandoned to the desert. Vivi and Nami explain what Dance Powder is and what it has done to Arabasta.

episodes.title: Ace and Luffy! Warm Memories and Brotherly Bonds
episodes.overview: Ace fights Smoker while the Straw Hats run for their ship. Luffy reunites with his brother, and together take down agents of Baroque Works.

episodes.title: Reunion of the Powerful! His Name Is Fire Fist Ace
episodes.overview: While in Nanohana, the Straw Hats encounter Smoker and Tashigi. A powerful pirate named Portgas D. Ace appears, and is revealed to be Luffy's older brother.

episodes.title: Coming to the Desert Kingdom! The Rain-Calling Powder and the Rebel Army
episodes.overview: Luffy separates from the rest of the crew, right after arriving at Arabasta's port city of Nanohana. The crew dons disguises while Luffy learns of Dance Powder.

episodes.title: The Hero of Alabasta and the Ballerina on Deck
episodes.overview: Crocodile appears to stop rampaging pirates. Luffy and his crew meet Mr. 2 Bon Kurei, who shows off his Devil Fruit power; Vivi sees a shocking sight.

episodes.title: Farewell, Drum Island! I'm Going Out to Sea!
episodes.overview: Chopper joins the Straw Hat crew as they continue their journey to Vivi's homeland.

episodes.title: Hiruluk's Cherry Blossoms! Miracle of the Drum Rockies
episodes.overview: After finally been convinced to join the team, Chopper announces his intentions to Dr. Kureha, who does not take it too well; but after escaping from the castle, she has decided to give the whole Straw Hat crew a farewell gift.

episodes.title: When the Kingdom's Rule is Over! The Flag of Conviction Lasts Forever
episodes.overview: After trying every trick in the castle, Wapol is finally hunted down by Luffy. The villagers along with Zoro, Vivi and Usopp start their ascent to the castle through a ropeway.

episodes.title: Devil's Fruit of the Zoan Family! Chopper's Seven-Level Transformation
episodes.overview: Chopper demonstrates the abilities of Rumble Balls when fighting Chessmarimo. Dalton is uncovered from the avalanche.

episodes.title: VS. Wapol's Army Corps! The Abilities of the Baku Baku Fruit!
episodes.overview: Wapol is determined to bring down Hiriluk's flag, and to do that, he engages Sanji, Luffy and Chopper in a fight.

episodes.title: Hiruluk's Cherry Blossoms and Inherited Will
episodes.overview: More of Chopper's past is revealed, including the fate of doctor Hiriluk and Wapol's cruelties as the king. Meanwhile, Wapol reaches the castle where the crew is residing.

episodes.title: Dream of the Outcasts! The Quack Doctor Hiruluk
episodes.overview: Doctorine continues to tell how Chopper lived his life and how the quack doctor Hiriluk took care of him.

episodes.title: The Blue-Nosed Reindeer! Chopper's Secret
episodes.overview: Nami asks Chopper to join the crew, but he is not interested. Kureha tells Nami some of what was Chopper's background. After realizing the abilities that Chopper has, Luffy is eager to make him join the crew.

episodes.title: Island that Lives in Snow! Ascend The Drum Rockies!
episodes.overview: The Lapahn help Luffy escape from Wapol, giving him enough time to climb to the castle where doctor Kureha lives. Vivi, Usopp and Zoro deal with the king's army in order to save Dalton. The recovering Nami meets a strange creature.

episodes.title: Dalton's Resolve! Wapol's Forces Land
episodes.overview: Dalton faces Wapol, but only gets himself hit by arrows thrown by his former comrade Chess. An avalanche stops the battle, but injures Sanji. Luffy must carry both Nami and Sanji to the doctor, and begins his ascent.

episodes.title: Ya Happy? The Doctor who is Called a Witch!
episodes.overview: While Sanji and Luffy fight off the wilderness, the islander's worst nightmare turns true, as Wapol returns to the island. The doctor is discovered to be on the other side of the island, and Usopp, Vivi and Dalton rush to find her. Dalton however returns as he hears of Wapol's return.

episodes.title: A Doctorless Island? Adventure in the Country Without a Name!
episodes.overview: The Straw Hat crew manages to gain the trust of the people that attacked them, and are taken to the village, except for Zoro and Karoo, who guard the ship. Luffy and Sanji must take Nami to the island's sole doctor who lives on a mountain-top. Vivi and Usopp discover the past of the island, and about the pirate Wapol from Dalton.

episodes.title: Ambush! The Bliking and Wapol the Tin-man
episodes.overview: While looking for a doctor, the crew meets the pirate Wapol, who attacks them, but only makes Luffy send him flying. Meanwhile Smoker manages to intercept the conversation between Mr. 0 and Sanji and plans to go to Arabasta. Back with the crew they arrive at last to an island only to find out they are not welcome.

episodes.title: Nami Is Sick? Beyond the Snow that Falls on the Ocean!
episodes.overview: Nami is sick, but the crew does not have a doctor to help her.

episodes.title: Farewell to the Giants' Island! On to Alabasta
episodes.overview: After having a pleasant chat with Mr. 0 and encountering the "Unluckies", Sanji retrieves an Eternal Pose for Arabasta. The crew leaves Little Garden and sets sail for Arabasta.

episodes.title: Critical Counterattack! Usopp's Quick Wit and Kaenboshi!
episodes.overview: Usopp frees Luffy from Miss Goldenweek's control. With Karoo's help, Usopp and Luffy rescue the others, who take on Mr. 5 and Miss Valentine. Luffy and Karoo pursue Mr. 3 and Miss Goldenweek into the forest.

episodes.title: Luffy Attacked by Magic! Colors Trap
episodes.overview: Luffy attempts to rescue his friends but only accelerates the deadly waxing process. To make matters worse, Miss Goldenweek interferes and reveals her own terrifying ability.

episodes.title: The Devil's Candle! Tears of Regret and Tears of Anger
episodes.overview: Having subdued the giants, Baroque Works makes their move. Mr. 3 introduces Zoro, Nami, Vivi, and Brogy to the slow torture of becoming living statues of wax.

episodes.title: Brogy Wails in Victory! Elbaf's Judgement
episodes.overview: Luffy tries in vain to convince the injured Dorry not to fight Brogy. The Officer Agents who sabotaged Dorry's ale further tamper with the giants' duel.

episodes.title: Luffy's Anger! A Dirty Trick in a Sacred Battle
episodes.overview: Dorry, critically injured by exploding ale, blames the Straw Hats. Luffy is enraged that someone would pull such a cowardly trick to sabotage the giants' honorable duel.

episodes.title: Humongous Battle! The Giants Dorry and Brogy!
episodes.overview: Nami and Usopp meet a giant named Brogy, while Luffy and Vivi encounter Brogy's rival, Dorry. The Straw Hats little suspect that Officer Agents of Baroque Works are on their tail.

episodes.title: Prehistoric Island! The Shadow Lurking in Little Garden!
episodes.overview: Luffy and friends land on Little Garden, a prehistoric island inhabited by dinosaurs and giants.

episodes.title: Koby-Meppo's Determination! Vice Admiral Garp's Fatherly Pride
episodes.overview: Vice Admiral Garp mentors Koby and Helmeppo to become marines.

episodes.title: Try Hard, Koby! Diary of Koby-Meppo's Marine Struggles
episodes.overview: As Luffy and his crew are sailing in the Grand Line, Koby and Helmeppo are stuck doing odd-jobs for the marines back in East Blue, and encounter Vice-Admiral Garp.

episodes.title: Deliver Princess Vivi! Luffy Pirates Depart
episodes.overview: Luffy's crew manages to become targets of Crocodile, one of the Shichibukai, and decide to help Princess Vivi. They also meet Miss All-Sunday, the second strongest member of Baroque Works and partner of Crocodile.

episodes.title: A Serious Fight! Luffy vs. Zoro: The Unexpected Duel!
episodes.overview: Luffy, who does not realize the town is full of bounty hunters, engages in a battle with Zoro after he discovers that Zoro attacked the townsfolk, while Mr. 5 and Miss Valentine head for Princess Vivi.

episodes.title: Exploding Santouryu! Zoro vs. Baroque Works!
episodes.overview: Zoro battles a hundred members of Baroque Works, and discovers there is more to them than meets the eye.

episodes.title: A Pirate-Loving Town? Arrival at Whiskey Peak
episodes.overview: Luffy and friends arrive at Whisky Peak, a town of pirate-lovers who hold them a feast.

episodes.title: A Man's Promise, Luffy and the Whale Vow to Meet Again
episodes.overview: After hearing the story of Laboon the whale, Luffy comes up with a clever solution to his problems. From Laboon's caretaker, Crocus, the crew learns more about the Grand Line and how to navigate through it, since compasses are useless there.

episodes.title: The First Obstacle? Giant Whale Laboon Appears
episodes.overview: Upon entering the Grand Line, the ship is swallowed by a giant whale, inside of which they discover a strange place. In addition, they are not the only ones there.

episodes.title: Angry Finale! Cross the Red Line!
episodes.overview: After leaving Warship Island the Going Merry is now towards the Grand Line, and the crew now returns to the Great Adventure.

episodes.title: Those who Soar in the Open Skies! Revival of the 1000 Year Legend
episodes.overview: With his last breath, Ryuuji calls all his fellow dragons, and the Lost Island re-surfaced. Meanwhile Luffy takes out Admiral Nelson and his gang.

episodes.title: Luffy, Completely Surrounded! Admiral Nelson's Secret Plan
episodes.overview: At last Admiral Nelson has seen through the ambitions of Eric, but takes it a little too personally and now the mystical dragon's life is in danger.

episodes.title: Duel in the Ruins! Strained Zoro vs. Erik
episodes.overview: Zoro is left fighting with Eric while Luffy and the gang run to the ship in order to get to Lost Island, but only find more problems.

episodes.title: Lone Island in a Distant Sea! The Legendary Lost Island
episodes.overview: After arriving to what might seemed as the Lost Island the Straw hats where looking for, they find an old Temple with paintings that might indicate where the Lost Island really is, and also Eric who has been following them throughout the sea.

episodes.title: Erik's Raid! Great Escape from Gunkan Island!
episodes.overview: Now that the crew is informed about the reasons for which Apis was followed, they hurry to escape the island so Ryuuji could be saved, but they meet with a foe that wants Ryuuji to himself. Zoro and Usopp bring the ship to a thin rock at the side while Nami and Apis get Ryuuji onto a cart. Luffy and Sanji fight the Marines to buy time for all preparations. In the end, the ship pulls the cart away on the search for Lost Island.

episodes.title: The Holy Beast! Apis' Secret and the Legendary Island
episodes.overview: The Calm Belt is revealed to have no winds or currents as well as being the home of many giant sea kings. Apis forms a plan with Luffy's help and escapes the sea kings by riding with one's sneeze. Later, the crew reaches Warship Island, where they listen to the soporific story of the island's creation. After following Apis into a cave where a dragon is hidden, Luffy and Nami find the reason why Apis is being chased.

episodes.title: Foreboding of a New Adventure! The Puzzling Girl, Apis
episodes.overview: On a stormy night a girl called Apis escapes from the Marines and arrives at Straw hat's ship, but the girl upon knowing that they are pirates begins to hide some of the reasons which she is being wanted by the Marines. As the Straw Hats escape from the Marines, they get caught in the Calm Belt.

episodes.title: The Legend has Begun! Head to the Grand Line
episodes.overview: Miraculously saved from death by an unnatural green gust and a lightning bolt to Buggy, the Straw Hats rush out of Loguetown, only for Zoro to be stopped by Tashigi and Luffy to be stopped by Captain Smoker.

episodes.title: Buggy's Revenge! The Man who Smiles at the Execution Platform!
episodes.overview: Luffy arrives at the execution platform only to be caught in a trap by Buggy and Alvida.

episodes.title: A Burning Culinary Battle? Sanji vs. The Gorgeous Chef
episodes.overview: In order to win a rare fish, Sanji enters a cooking contest and faces a woman named Carmen.

episodes.title: Usopp vs. Daddy The Father! Showdown at High Noon!
episodes.overview: Usopp manages to anger the daughter of bounty hunter Daddy the Father, and finds his own life at stake. When Daddy discovers that Usopp is the son of Yasopp, the only man to beat him, he challenges him to a duel.

episodes.title: Sandai Kitetsu and Yubashiri! Zoro's New Swords, and the Female Sergeant Major
episodes.overview: While searching for new swords to replace the ones shattered by Mihawk, Zoro meets a woman named Tashigi, who looks exactly like an older Kuina, who then helps him look.

episodes.title: The Town of the Beginning and the End - Arrival at Loguetown
episodes.overview: The crew arrives at the last large town before the entrance to the Grand Line--Loguetown, the place where Gold Roger was both born and executed, where they stock up on supplies and sightsee. As Luffy heads for the execution platform where Roger was killed, old enemies are searching for him.

episodes.title: You've Been Waiting For It! The Return of Captain Buggy!
episodes.overview: With Buggy assumed to be dead, his crew fights over who will be the new captain, only to be captured by a tribe of cannibals.

episodes.title: Following the Straw Hat! Little Buggy's Big Adventure
episodes.overview: After his fight with Luffy, Buggy was sent flying to another island with several body parts missing. Thus, Buggy begins his journey to find his crew and his body parts, making some unlikely friends.

episodes.title: Bounty! Straw Hat Luffy Becomes World Famous!
episodes.overview: As a result of defeating Buggy, Krieg and Arlong, Luffy now has the highest bounty in all of East Blue. News quickly spreads to Shanks, who celebrates Luffy's arrival into the world of pirates by partying with Mihawk, despite already being severely hungover.

episodes.title: Setting Out with a Smile! Farewell, Hometown Cocoyashi Village!
episodes.overview: Arlong's reign of terror is over, and no one has anything on their mind except to party. As the crew celebrates, Nami reflects on her hometown and decides to officially join the Straw Hat Pirates.

episodes.title: End of the Fishman Empire! Nami's My Friend!
episodes.overview: The battle spreads into Arlong Park itself and Arlong is no longer holding back.

episodes.title: Bursting Out! Fishman Arlong, Fearsome Attack From The Sea!
episodes.overview: Luffy returns to the fight, and the battle with Arlong versus Luffy begins.

episodes.title: Luffy's Best! Nami's Courage and the Straw Hat
episodes.overview: Arlong's officers have been defeated, but Sanji and Zoro prove to be no match for Arlong in their current state. However, with Luffy finally free, he just may be able to defeat the "most wicked man in the East Blue". Meanwhile, Nami finally gathers the courage to face Arlong.

episodes.title: Proud, Tall Warriors! Dramatic Battle of Sanji and Usopp!
episodes.overview: With Hatchan defeated, two of the fishmen battle Sanji and Usopp. Things look grim for Sanji as he attempts to face Kuroobi underwater, and Usopp gets the chance to prove that he too is a brave warrior.

episodes.title: Luffy Drowning! Zoro vs. Octopus Hatchan!
episodes.overview: Arlong has trapped Luffy in the ocean and Zoro faces the six-sword wielding octopus Hatchan.

episodes.title: Luffy in Trouble! Fishmen vs. Luffy Pirates!
episodes.overview: The Straw Hats face the Fishmen themselves as the villagers watch from the sidelines.

episodes.title: Luffy Stands Up! End of a Broken Promise!
episodes.overview: When a marine officer under Arlong's pay confiscates all the money Nami stole over the years, in order to one day buy the village from Arlong, the villagers decide that enough is enough and fight back, despite Nami's pleads that they do not and that they'd all be killed. Upon seeing Nami's sorrow, the Straw Hats head for Arlong Park.

episodes.title: Survive! The Mother Bellemere and Nami's Family!
episodes.overview: Nojiko continues her story, explaining how their life was ruined when the Arlong Pirates first took over the village.

episodes.title: The Hidden Past! Female Fighter Bellemere!
episodes.overview: Nojiko starts her story about Nami's childhood and their adopted mother, Bellemere. Despite being poor and none of them being related by blood, they had a happy life.

episodes.title: Reunited! Usopp Tells Nami's True Story
episodes.overview: Johnny tells the others about Nami killing Usopp, and Luffy does not believe them until Nami appears herself and confirms it. She tells them to stay out of her business and leave without her, but Luffy stubbornly decides to stay on the island. Usopp returns, revealing that Nami only pretended to kill him, and Nami's sister, Nojiko, starts to explain why Nami is acting the way she is.

episodes.title: Usopp Dead?! When is Luffy Going to Make Landfall?!
episodes.overview: After Zoro escapes with Nami's help, she tries to prove her loyalty to the Arlong Pirates by appearing to kill Usopp. Meanwhile, Luffy's group finally arrives at the island.

episodes.title: The Witch of Cocoyashi Village, Arlong's Female Officer
episodes.overview: Zoro is captured by the fishmen after Usopp and Johnny ditch him, and it's revealed that Nami was part of Arlong's crew the entire time. When a group of Fishmen attack Cocoyashi Village, Usopp comes to the rescue.

episodes.title: The Most Wicked Man of East Blue, Fishman Pirate Arlong
episodes.overview: The crew chases after Nami, who stole their ship, and Yosaku takes time during the trip to explain about Arlong and his Fishmen to Luffy and Sanji. Meanwhile, Usopp, Johnny, and Zoro arrive at the island Nami docked at.

episodes.title: Departure! Sea Chef and Luffy Travel Together!
episodes.overview: After the battle, Gin decides to go back to the Grand Line with Krieg despite still being poisoned, and Sanji makes the difficult decision on whether to stay or to go with Luffy just as Yosaku comes back with news that he knows where Nami is.

episodes.title: Outcome of a Deadly Battle! The Spear Inside!
episodes.overview: Even after taking several hits from the Battle Spear, Luffy refuses to give up.

episodes.title: I Won't Die! Conclusion: Luffy vs. Krieg
episodes.overview: When Gin refuses to kill Sanji, Krieg uses a poison gas on him. Luffy seems to have the advantage in the fight until Krieg pulls out his explosive Battle Spear.

episodes.title: The Coldhearted Devil-man. Gin, the Pirate Fleet Battle Commander
episodes.overview: Gin finishes off Pearl, claiming that he wants to kill Sanji himself. Still wounded, Sanji faces Gin while Luffy attacks Don Krieg.

episodes.title: Zeff and Sanji's Dream! The Illusory All Blue!
episodes.overview: With Zeff held captive by Gin, Sanji has no choice but to take Pearl's hits, and he reflects on why Zeff means so much to him.

episodes.title: The Deadly Foot Technique Bursts Forth! Sanji vs. The Invincible Pearl!
episodes.overview: Mihawk leaves after defeating Zoro, so Krieg continues his invasion and has Pearl, one of his stronger crewmates, attack, and Sanji reveals his fighting skills. Meanwhile Johnny and Yosaku leave with Usopp and the wounded Zoro to go after Nami.

episodes.title: Hawk-Eye Mihawk! The Great Swordsman Zoro Falls At Sea!
episodes.overview: As Nami steals the Going Merry, Mihawk has returned to finish the job, but Zoro challenges him to a duel in order to achieve his dream.

episodes.title: Protect Baratie! The Great Pirate, Red Foot Zeff!
episodes.overview: It is revealed that Chef Zeff was a great pirate known as Red Leg Zeff. Gin explains the catastrophe the fleet met in Grand Line when they encountered Hawk-Eyes Mihawk, and Krieg attempts to take control of the Baratie.

episodes.title: The Strongest Pirate Fleet! Commodore Don Krieg!
episodes.overview: Gin returns to the Baratie with his also-starving captain, Don Krieg, to whom Sanji once more gives food, but Don Krieg betrays the cook once he regains his energy.

episodes.title: Unwelcome Customer! Sanji's Food and Ghin's Debt!
episodes.overview: Sanji, a cook at the Baratie, helps a starving pirate named Gin. Luffy begins his job as a waiter to pay for the damage he did to the Baratie, and tries to convince Sanji to join his crew.

episodes.title: Famous Cook! Sanji of the Sea Restaurant!
episodes.overview: The crew meets Johnny and Yosaku, Zoro's former companions, and they set sail for the Baratie restaurant in search of a cook.

episodes.title: The Three-Sword Style's Past! Zoro and Kuina's Vow!
episodes.overview: While Usopp & Luffy fool around with the ship's cannon one day, Zoro dreams about his childhood and the promise he made to Kuina.

episodes.title: You're the Weird Creature! Gaimon and His Strange Friends!
episodes.overview: With Usopp now in the crew and a new ship, the Going Merry, under their command, the Straw Hats head to an island said to hold a fabled treasure, only to encounter a strange man stuck in a treasure box that has also been looking for this treasure.

episodes.title: Anger Explosion! Kuro vs. Luffy! How it Ends!
episodes.overview: Kuro's ultimate attack, "Shakushi", attacks everything in the area, whether friend or foe, and Luffy becomes enraged by his lack of regard for his crew. Will Luffy's determination overcome Kuro's sheer speed?

episodes.title: Protect Kaya! The Usopp Pirates' Great Efforts!
episodes.overview: As the fight between Luffy and Kuro is close to an end, the Usopp Pirates do their best to avoid Jango.

episodes.title: Beat Kuro! Usopp the Man's Tearful Resolve!
episodes.overview: Zoro and Buchi (of the Nyaban Brothers) face off once again as Luffy and Kuro begin their fight. Usopp orders the Usopp Pirates to run away with Kaya, but Jango goes after them. A flashback reveals how Captain Kuro faked his death with Captain Morgan and how he became Kaya's butler.

episodes.title: Luffy Back in Action! Miss Kaya's Desperate Resistance!
episodes.overview: Captain Kuro himself arrives at the scene, and with Zoro too injured to fight, Luffy being incapacitated, and the other two being too weak to handle him, things seem hopeless. However, Kaya herself appears to bargain with Kuro.

episodes.title: The Terrifying Duo! Meowban Brothers vs. Zoro!
episodes.overview: The Straw Hats manage to take out most of the opposing Black Cat Pirates, so Jango orders the Nyaban Brothers to attack. Meanwhile, after getting hypnotized by Jango, Luffy gets himself stuck under the collapsed mast of the Black Cat Pirates' ship.

episodes.title: Clash with the Black Cat Pirates! The Great Battle on the Slope!
episodes.overview: Usopp resolves to keep his story of pirates attacking the town a lie by making sure none reach it. Luffy, Zoro, Nami, and Usopp then try to keep the Black Cat Pirates at bay.

episodes.title: Expose the Plot! Pirate Butler, Captain Kuro!
episodes.overview: After learning of Captain Kuro's evil plan, Usopp runs back to the village to warn Kaya, only to find that after all his years of lying no one believes him.

episodes.title: The Weirdest Guy Ever! Jango the Hypnotist!
episodes.overview: When trying to convince his rich friend, Kaya, to give the Straw Hats a ship, Usopp is told to stay away from her by her caretaker, Klahadore. However, when Usopp and Luffy later see him conversing with a strange man, they learn of a plot to kill Kaya.

episodes.title: The Honorable Liar? Captain Usopp!
episodes.overview: With Nami forming an alliance with the crew as their navigator (though not as an actual member), the crew arrives at the Syrup Village in search of a proper ship, where they meet the town liar, Usopp, who too has ties to Shanks.

episodes.title: Who is the Victor? Devil Fruit Power Showdown!
episodes.overview: Buggy's link to Shanks is revealed, and when he rips the straw hat Shanks gave Luffy, his rage knows no bounds. Who will win in this clash between Devil Fruit users?

episodes.title: Epic Showdown! Swordsman Zoro vs. Acrobat Cabaji!
episodes.overview: Enraged by the actions of Buggy's crew, the city's mayor rushes to fight Buggy himself, but the Straw Hat Pirates come to his rescue. Zoro fights Cabaji, despite still being wounded from his previous encounter with Buggy, while Luffy faces the clown pirate himself and Nami searches for the map to the Grand Line.

episodes.title: Desperate Situation! Beast Tamer Mohji vs. Luffy!
episodes.overview: Mohji and Richie show up for revenge after Buggy's humiliating defeat in the previous episode, and Luffy meets a small dog guarding his master's store, even though he knows that he is long dead.

episodes.title: A Terrifying Mysterious Power! Captain Buggy, the Clown Pirate!
episodes.overview: In order to save herself and steal a map to the Grand Line, Nami tricks Luffy into allowing her to turn him over to Buggy.

episodes.title: Luffy's Past! The Red-Haired Shanks Appears!
episodes.overview: Out on the sea, Luffy almost loses his hat and reflects on his past, and how a pirate named Shanks influenced him. Afterwards, Luffy meets Nami, and Buggy the Clown's men.

episodes.title: Morgan versus Luffy! Who's the Mysterious Pretty Girl?
episodes.overview: Luffy convinces Zoro to join his crew, but they must first defeat Captain Morgan. After freeing the island from Morgan's oppressive rule, Koby is accepted as a marine while the other two continue on their journey.

episodes.title: The Great Swordsman Appears! Pirate Hunter Roronoa Zoro
episodes.overview: Luffy and Koby arrive at Shell Island, a Marine base. They meet the bounty hunter Roronoa Zoro, held under arrest by the infamous marine, Captain Morgan, and his son Helmeppo.

episodes.title: I'm Luffy! The Man Who Will Become the Pirate King!
episodes.overview: A band of pirates led by Alvida plundered a ship, only to find a barrel which contains a strange boy named Luffy. Luffy is on a quest to find the legendary treasure "One Piece" and he befriends the ship's cabin-boy, Koby, who actually wants to become a marine officer. Luffy defeats Alvida and the two journey on in search of crewmates.

title: The Rookie
overview: Starting over isn't easy, especially for small-town guy John Nolan who, after a life-altering incident, is pursuing his dream of being an LAPD officer. As the force's oldest rookie, he's met with skepticism from some higher-ups who see him as just a walking midlife crisis.

episodes.title: The Bandit
episodes.overview: The team launches a high-stakes search to take down a notorious criminal. Meanwhile, Lucy's leadership is tested; Wesley tests the boundaries of his friendships, and Nolan tries to balance duty and family.

episodes.title: Dead Ringer
episodes.overview: Nolan and Harper try to help a desperate mother protect her child, while Lt. Grey and Garza continue to work with Monica despite their misgivings.

episodes.title: Out of Time
episodes.overview: Nolan is put to the test when he's forced to protect a man he doesn't trust. Meanwhile, Lucy and Celina follow a promising lead, and Lopez finds herself conflicted about Wesley's new position.

episodes.title: Survive the Streets
episodes.overview: The team works together after Nolan and Celina discover a possible suicide that spirals into conspiracy.

episodes.title: Tiger Bear
episodes.overview: A troubling incident at a school draws the team into a complex case, while Celina's temporary missing persons assignment leads her into a dangerous situation.

episodes.title: The Thinker
episodes.overview: Bailey gets a new role, and a ride-along with Nolan goes awry. Meanwhile, the team looks to recruit new members.

episodes.title: Spy Games
episodes.overview: The FBI and LAPD join forces on a covert sting operation to protect Bailey, while Wesley and Angela face tensions in their marriage when his campaign is threatened by a public scandal.

episodes.title: Aftermath
episodes.overview: Lucy returns to work in the aftermath of the attack. Meanwhile, an unexpected twist hinders the Liam Glasser case, and a familiar face helps the team track down a killer.

episodes.title: His Name Was Martin
episodes.overview: Nolan, Harper and Miles face a dangerous situation when a routine check takes a sudden turn. Meanwhile, Bailey conducts a covert investigation at the Pentagon at the request of Lt. Grey.

episodes.title: Fun and Games
episodes.overview: Harper and Miles feel the weight of their recent mistakes, while Harper is tasked with training Miles. Nolan and Celina are dispatched to a robbery call where Nolan encounters a familiar face.

episodes.title: Grand Theft Aircraft
episodes.overview: Nolan and Garza lead a high-stakes operation that quickly goes south. Lucy and Tim navigate their relationship when an unexpected visitor shows up. Meanwhile, the team conducts a citywide search for a suspect.

episodes.title: Baja
episodes.overview: Harper and Lucy go undercover in Baja while investigating the murder of two young women. Back in LA, Bradford and the FBI task force assist in the investigation, while Nolan and Bailey navigate their long-distance relationship.

episodes.title: Burn 4 Love
episodes.overview: It's Valentine's Day, and the team is on the hunt for someone who is setting more than hearts on fire. Meanwhile, Celina thinks Miles' recent string of bad luck is the result of a curse, and she's determined to break it.

episodes.title: The Network
episodes.overview: Lieutenant Grey and the FBI task force enlist the help of an old colleague to uncover a criminal network; while Nolan, Miles, Lucy and Celina respond to a mysterious officer involved shooting.

episodes.title: Cut and Run
episodes.overview: While out in the city, Nolan and Bailey witness a murder in public and immediately spring into action in the hopes of finding the person responsible; Angela and Wesley have a big life decision that may affect their future.

episodes.title: The Red Place
episodes.overview: Nolan makes a quiet arrest; Lucy and Celina race to rescue a kidnapping victim; Harper and Lopez help outsmart a killer; Miles visits a familiar face.

episodes.title: Fast Andy
episodes.overview: When the president visits Los Angeles, the LAPD teams up with the Secret Service to ensure his safety and assess any major threats on their watch list. Meanwhile, Miles's instincts are tested, and Tim takes on a new role.

episodes.title: Czech Mate
episodes.overview: The LAPD, FBI and Interpol work with Monica Stevens in Prague to target high-value terrorists operating within and outside the United States.

episodes.title: The Good, The Bad, And The Oscar
episodes.overview: John and Harper work together to catch Oscar; Angela investigates a bank robbery; Lucy and Tim learn to adapt to her new schedule, and Miles' first date takes an unexpected turn.

episodes.title: Mutiny and the Bounty
episodes.overview: The team helps Skip Tracer Randy when his new love interest is kidnapped. Meanwhile, Angela and Nyla enlist their moms to help catch a con artist, and Wesley is threatened to drop a case.

episodes.title: The Return
episodes.overview: The team has mixed feelings when a familiar face returns hoping to prove himself. Meanwhile, an influencer gets his fans to come after Wesley, and Tim supports Lucy as she prepares for the sergeant's exam.

episodes.title: A Deadly Secret
episodes.overview: Documentary filmmakers interview the LAPD on a complicated missing person's case connected to John.

episodes.title: Mad About Murder
episodes.overview: Tim receives a strange message, launching a larger investigation into the dark web. Meanwhile, Celina works to take down a popular podcast, and Miles helps update the department's training videos.

episodes.title: Three Billboards
episodes.overview: When anti-LAPD billboards emerge throughout the city, the team searches for who's responsible. Meanwhile, a car bombing prompts an investigation, Miles reconnects with an old friend, and John and Bailey assess their ability to adopt.

episodes.title: April Fools
episodes.overview: An April Fools' prank on LAPD's social media leads to citywide chaos. Meanwhile, John's T.O. skills are tested, Wesley is assigned a challenging case, and Tim and Lucy play a joke on the team.

episodes.title: Speed
episodes.overview: John and Celina find themselves in a hostage situation while undercover for a public safety initiative. While Angela and Nyla investigate the suspects, Tim challenges Lucy's decision-making skills.

episodes.title: Chaos Agent
episodes.overview: John, Lucy and Angela investigate the suspicious stabbing of three teenage girls. Back at the station, the team experiences technical difficulties while managing a group of prisoners and a wild animal.

episodes.title: The Kiss
episodes.overview: The team mobilizes to locate a suspect after a deadly series of events affects one of their own. Meanwhile, Celina takes on her first case with Bailey's help.

episodes.title: Wildfire
episodes.overview: Nyla remains suspicious of Liam Glasser as a wildfire erupts, causing chaos in the city. Meanwhile, James tries to help a friend, and Seth makes a costly mistake, putting two of their own in danger.

episodes.title: The Mickey
episodes.overview: On Celina's last day as a rookie, John gives her one final test. Meanwhile, Bailey makes a new friend, and Lucy places her faith in Seth for an undercover assignment.

episodes.title: The Gala
episodes.overview: It's Valentine's Day, and Lieutenant Grey gives Tim and Lucy an unromantic assignment, while John and Celina track down a missing girl. Later, the team sharpens up for a charity gala where multiple relationships come to a head.

episodes.title: Til Death
episodes.overview: The team searches for a serial killer as Nyla struggles with the aftermath following the attack. Lucy's relationship with Seth takes a turn, while Bailey battles her fear of Jason Wyler.

episodes.title: Darkness Falling
episodes.overview: Following his stint at the LAPD, Wesley returns to the district attorney's office where his past connects him to the team's investigation. Meanwhile, Bailey and John have conflicting feelings over safety, while Lucy grows suspicious of Seth.

episodes.title: Out of Pocket
episodes.overview: Ahead of Bailey's return home, John looks for clues to locate Jason Wyler. Then, Tim and Lucy swap rookies; a friendly face resurfaces at the station, and Wesley feels unsettled over Angela.

episodes.title: The Watcher
episodes.overview: The team is tasked with community policing while hunting for a local vigilante. Meanwhile, Celina's instincts are tested, and Tim and Lucy discover secrets about the two new rookies.

episodes.title: The Shot
episodes.overview: Now recovering from a gunshot wound and feeling the effects of his age, John and the team welcome two new rookies and continue the hunt for two dangerous inmates with very personal vendettas following their prison escape.

episodes.title: Escape Plan
episodes.overview: Sgt. Grey helps the team prepare for their biggest mission yet. Meanwhile, Aaron, Lopez, Celina, Tim and Smitty discover a surprising connection in their case.

episodes.title: The Squeeze
episodes.overview: Officer Nolan and Celina take on a special case; meanwhile, Monica enlists help to identify her attackers. Elsewhere, Lopez and Harper discover a connection to the trail of crimes.

episodes.title: Punch Card
episodes.overview: After a mafia-related mass casualty, the team is tasked to keep the peace at the hospital. Lucy and Celina work together to investigate the suspects behind the attack. Meanwhile, Tim and Aaron embark on a metro ops mission.

episodes.title: Crushed
episodes.overview: When two teenagers go missing, it is up to the entire team to find the girls and uncover the truth about their disappearance. Meanwhile, Lopez and Harper are on a different kind of investigation – the search for the perfect nanny.

episodes.title: Secrets and Lies
episodes.overview: Following their time as foster parents, Bailey has decided she wants to have a baby and forces John to reconsider their decision to not have children. Meanwhile, John and Celina discover a prison escapee who they fear is out for revenge and race to find her before it is too late.

episodes.title: The Vow
episodes.overview: When a toddler is found at the scene of a crime, John and Bailey must decide whether to let the child go to a shelter for the night or care for her themselves. Meanwhile, when someone from his past returns, Tim disappears and leaves Lucy in the dark.

episodes.title: Training Day
episodes.overview: It's Officer Aaron Thorsen's first day back since the assault, and he's tasked with a series of high-stress cases to determine whether he's ready to work. Elsewhere, the team investigates a homicide case with a potential tie to the pentagram killer.

episodes.title: Trouble in Paradise
episodes.overview: Nolan and Bailey's honeymoon is more of a nightmare than dream when it turns into an active crime scene. Meanwhile, Tim and Celina partner up and must uncover the identity of a John Doe.

episodes.title: The Hammer
episodes.overview: The team comes together to celebrate John and Bailey's wedding; meanwhile, Celina discovers a discrepancy in her case, leading to a new discovery. Elsewhere, Lucy and Tim's relationship is put to the test.

episodes.title: Strike Back
episodes.overview: The team must try to understand why they were targeted and if there is a bigger plan in place; Nolan must survive his last shift before his wedding to Bailey.

episodes.title: Under Siege
episodes.overview: After one of their own is shot, the team suffers a series of close calls and realizes their division may be a target for a group of masked assailants.

episodes.title: Going Under
episodes.overview: Officer Lucy Chen goes undercover to infiltrate an illegal firearm operation, and Detective Harper and Officer John Nolan work together to solve a mystery involving severed limbs found around the city.

episodes.title: S.T.R.
episodes.overview: Officer Tim Bradford's ex-wife returns and asks the team to help her save someone from her undercover past. Isabel's return also creates additional pressure in Lucy and Tim's relationship as they assist in the search.

episodes.title: A Hole in the World
episodes.overview: The team investigates a pattern of kidnappings which leads them to a discovery that hits close to home with one of their own. Meanwhile, Lucy and Tim's relationship is put to the test as they begin to feel the hard hours of their jobs.

episodes.title: Double Trouble
episodes.overview: When Dim goes missing, Officer Chen and Sergeant Bradford, along with the CIA, set out to find him and enlist the help of Juicy.

episodes.title: The Enemy Within
episodes.overview: Now that Elijah and Abril have become allies, the team must rely on Monica, Elijah's lawyer, to uncover their plans; Officers Nolan and Juarez reopen her sister's case and discover a discrepancy that leads them on a new trail.

episodes.title: Exposed
episodes.overview: The team must stop a militia from detonating a highly combustible truck in their possession; Nolan, Thorson, Juarez and Harper search for three men who may have been exposed to Ebola.

episodes.title: The Con
episodes.overview: With help from the FBI, Lopez puts everything on the line to help Elijah Stone take down a gang leader in exchange for her safety; Nolan and Bailey must deal with the secrets and shady dealings his late mother left behind.

episodes.title: Death Sentence
episodes.overview: Officer John Nolan and Bailey are on the hunt for a mystery gunman after a shooting hits a little too close to home. Meanwhile, Aaron struggles to live within his means and joins Lucy to help Tamara when the mother of a child she babysits goes missing. Elsewhere, Wesley suspects that a judge is taking bribes after he excludes valuable eyewitness testimony from a case.

episodes.title: Daddy Cop
episodes.overview: In the midst of a heatwave and a citywide blackout, Officer John Nolan and Aaron follow increasingly large leads after they discover criminals hiding at the station. While on duty, Officer Chen makes an alarming discovery after being called to a scene where a pungent smell has wreaked havoc. Meanwhile, Lucy and Harper scheme to get Tim out of his new job and into a more exciting position.

episodes.title: Death Notice
episodes.overview: Officer John Nolan and Celina are enlisted to stand guard at a hospital after a dangerous prisoner must have surgery and they suspect there's more to it than meets the eye. Meanwhile, Aaron gets Lopez and Harper to help him investigate a string of home robberies, and Tim and Lucy consider how their new secret relationship will affect their work. Elsewhere, Lopez gets unexpected news.

episodes.title: The Naked and the Dead
episodes.overview: The search for a missing boy leads the team into the middle of a dangerous drug war between two rival gangs

episodes.title: The List
episodes.overview: Detective Nyla Harper and James find themselves in the middle of a bank robbery which leads the entire team on a citywide manhunt. Meanwhile, Tim and Lucy finally go on their first date, but it does have a few complications.

episodes.title: Take Back
episodes.overview: Officer John Nolan and the team investigate the unexpected death of a suspect in police custody. Their search also uncovers a very delicate loose end that could jeopardize Officer Celina Juarez's career. Meanwhile, Sergeant Grey and his wife, Luna, go to New York to visit their daughter, Dominique, only to realize she never made it home.

episodes.title: The Collar
episodes.overview: Officers John Nolan and Celina Juarez are in a race against time to stop the source of an explosive rampage.

episodes.title: Crossfire
episodes.overview: Officer John Nolan and Celina witness a shooting, realize the victim was already dead, and investigate further. Back at home, Bailey has been feeling off-center ever since the proposal, leaving Nolan to wonder what he can do to make her feel more comfortable. Elsewhere, Lopez and Harper enlist Lucy's help to investigate the gang-related murder of a local shopkeeper.

episodes.title: The Reckoning
episodes.overview: Officer John Nolan and a sleep-deprived Celina investigate a cash deposit linked to an old DEA case. Meanwhile, Wesley grows increasingly concerned about his deposition and is shocked when he realizes Elijah's attorney is a familiar face from his past.

episodes.title: The Fugitive
episodes.overview: Officer John Nolan and Officer Celina Juarez are on the hunt for a fugitive after a car incident goes awry. Meanwhile, a past injury comes to haunt Tim and Lucy comes through during his time in need in more ways than one.

episodes.title: The Choice
episodes.overview: Rosalind returns with a vengeance and Bailey's life is left hanging in the balance. With a ticking clock, the LAPD and the FBI join forces, and Officer John Nolan is forced to make a deadly decision after a harrowing ultimatum.

episodes.title: Dye Hard
episodes.overview: Officer John Nolan is assigned his first rookie, Officer Celina Juarez, whose unconventional approach to police work poses a unique challenge for him.

episodes.title: Labor Day
episodes.overview: Officer John Nolan is moving closer to his new role as a training officer. Meanwhile, Lucy's successful undercover assignment earns her an invitation for specialized training in Sacramento.

episodes.title: Double Down
episodes.overview: Officer John Nolan is once again face-to-face with serial killer Rosalind, and she wants him to know she's not done with him yet. Meanwhile, officers Bradford and Chen work undercover with Detective Lopez and the Las Vegas Police Department to arrest leaders of a major criminal enterprise.

episodes.title: Day in the Hole
episodes.overview: Officer John Nolan is forced to spend a week in solitary confinement in a quiet border town with a young local officer who is in need of some training. Meanwhile, Sergeant Bradford and Officer Chen discover that looks are deceiving and go undercover together in a possible drug trafficking case.

episodes.title: Mother's Day
episodes.overview: Sergeant Grey supports Officer Nolan's desire to become a training officer and offers to ride with him for the day to get him ready. Meanwhile, Tim and Lucy must manage expectations in their respective relationships as they decide on their plans for Mother's Day and a romantic vacation.

episodes.title: Enervo
episodes.overview: The team alongside the LA Division of the FBI are in a race to stop bombs that have been scattered throughout the city by a suspected terrorist. Meanwhile, the joint task force is suspicious of the CIA's involvement in the situation.

episodes.title: Simone
episodes.overview: Officer Nolan and the LA division of the FBI enlist the help of FBI trainee Simone Clark when one of her former students is suspected of terrorism following an explosion at a local power station.

episodes.title: Backstabbers
episodes.overview: After the robbery of a train filled with valuable auction items turns deadly, the team is called to investigate. Meanwhile, Officer Chen has doubts about being Sergeant Bradford's aid and is upset when he doesn't give her the recognition she deserves. Elsewhere, Officer Harper takes matters into her own hands and makes a life-changing decision about her personal life.

episodes.title: Coding
episodes.overview: Officer John Nolan and the team feel they must negotiate with a distraught man who is holding a hospital hostage to ensure his wife receives a lifesaving surgery.

episodes.title: Real Crime
episodes.overview: Desperate to reset the way the world sees him, Officer Thorsen reluctantly decides to be a part of a reality show to help rebrand his image; the show's producer is found murdered and the team must investigate before Aaron is made suspect number one.

episodes.title: Hit List
episodes.overview: Officer Harper puts Officer Aaron through "Plain Clothes Day," but the exercise is interrupted by an unsuspected visitor. Meanwhile, after two witnesses for an upcoming grand jury case are murdered, the team must track down the killers before it's too late.

episodes.title: Long Shot
episodes.overview: Officers Nolan and Harper help Skip Tracer Randy on his first bounty hunter case; Officer Chen and Sergeant Bradford hunt for a perpetrator on a citywide crime spree.

episodes.title: Fight or Flight
episodes.overview: Officers John Nolan and Lucy Chen must fulfill three quests if they want to get a stolen police helicopter back safely from a teenage thief. Meanwhile, Officer Nyla Harper and Aaron Thorson must guard a convicted cop killer in the hospital following a prison riot.

episodes.title: The Knock
episodes.overview: The team responds to the report of a severed hand washing up on the beach and are on the hunt to find its owner. Meanwhile, Tim attempts to prove he isn't a control freak to Lucy and invites her on a double date with him and Ashley.

episodes.title: End Game
episodes.overview: The team must rely on a criminal for his expertise to help take down an even bigger threat. Meanwhile, Officers Chen and Bradford investigate the murder of an unhoused teenager who used to be friends with Tamara.

episodes.title: Heart Beat
episodes.overview: Now that John Nolan knows about Bailey's past, he must decide if they still have a future. Meanwhile, when a plane crashes in the middle of the city the team races to find out why.

episodes.title: Breakdown
episodes.overview: Desperate to break free from his connection to Elijah, Wesley tries to plant a listening device in his office to incriminate him. Meanwhile, Officer Bradford and his sister, Genny, learn an unsettling truth about their father.

episodes.title: Hit and Run
episodes.overview: The team goes on a city-wide hunt for an individual who is threatening a mass casualty event. Meanwhile, Tim's sister Genny shows up unannounced with some surprising news, and Lopez continues her inner struggle over Wesley's deal with Elijah and tries to come up with a plan to get them out of it.

episodes.title: Fire Fight
episodes.overview: In the aftermath of Fred's house explosion, Officer Nolan and Bailey discover there's more to Fred's death than meets the eye. Meanwhile, Officer Chen and Officer Bradford demand a treasure hunt rematch and enlist Officer Grey to help set the terms to a new bet, all while they arrest a series of wealthy female criminals. Elsewhere, Wesley struggles to keep it together under the pressure of his debt to Elijah.

episodes.title: Poetic Justice
episodes.overview: Officer Nolan and team are on a hunt to retrieve a buried stash of gold before any treasure seekers get hurt. Meanwhile, Bradford is tasked with encouraging the oldest cop at the station to retire and invites him to ride with him.

episodes.title: A.C.H.
episodes.overview: When a new designer drug hits LA streets, it turns users into "zombies," and Officer Nolan and the team have a Halloween they won't soon forget. Back at home, Lucy questions whether her apartment building might be haunted.

episodes.title: Red Hot
episodes.overview: Officer Nolan and Officer Chen search for a missing person who may have international ties that puts everyone's lives in danger. Meanwhile, Harper continues the search for a serial arsonist after responding to a report of an injured cyclist. Elsewhere, Wesley must overcome an impossible task.

episodes.title: In the Line of Fire
episodes.overview: Officer Nolan and officer Chen report to a structure fire and suspect that there is more to the situation than meets the eye. Meanwhile, after witnessing a sniper shooting, the team searches for the shooter and discovers that the perpetrator has a connection to one of their own.

episodes.title: Five Minutes
episodes.overview: Officer Nolan and Officer Chen's run-in with an infamous thief tips them off to a potentially big heist surrounding the Getty's big gala event. Meanwhile, Nolan works up the courage to ask Bailey out on date.

episodes.title: Life and Death
episodes.overview: Officer Nolan and the entire team race against the clock to locate Lopez after she is kidnapped on her wedding day, not only to save her life but her unborn child's.

episodes.title: Threshold
episodes.overview: Officer Nolan mildly injures himself while chasing down a shoplifter and the local DA wants to charge the suspect with assault despite Nolan's wishes. Meanwhile, Lucy goes undercover, Lopez' wedding venue is seized by the FBI and Nolan meets his new neighbor.

episodes.title: Triple Duty
episodes.overview: Officers Nolan and Bradford hope they can de-escalate a drug war before any innocent lives are lost. Meanwhile, Officer Harper hopes she can get Officer Chen ready to go undercover.

episodes.title: Brave Heart
episodes.overview: After rushing his son, Henry, to the hospital following his collapse, Nolan is reunited with his ex-wife, Sarah, and they must come together to help their son. Meanwhile, Detective Lopez discovers "La Fiera" is in the same hospital and wants to find out exactly why,

episodes.title: New Blood
episodes.overview: When Professor Fiona Ryan's car window is smashed following a series of mysterious notes, Officer Nolan volunteers to guard her house overnight. Meanwhile, Lucy notices that Tim is being much nicer to his new boot than he was with her and she does not like it.

episodes.title: Man of Honor
episodes.overview: Officers Harper and Nolan respond to a bank robbery in progress and realize the motives of the thief run much deeper than just needing money. Meanwhile, Officers Jackson and Chen's first day riding without training officers isn't what they thought it would be.

episodes.title: Amber
episodes.overview: An Amber Alert sends the team on a race against time to find a newborn infant who was stolen from a local hospital. Meanwhile, Officers Jackson and Chen work their last shift as rookies as Officer Nolan continues on for 30 more days.

episodes.title: Bad Blood
episodes.overview: Officer Nolan, Officer Harper and Detective Lopez are assigned to the kidnapping of the son of a criminal court judge who has a long list of enemies who could possibly be involved.

episodes.title: True Crime
episodes.overview: The team gets the true crime docuseries treatment when they analyze a recent case featuring a former child actor whose adult life has garnered him a cult following.

episodes.title: Revelations
episodes.overview: Officer Nolan's decision to return to school in order to become a training officer is proving to be much harder than he expected. Meanwhile, Officer Chen considers going into undercover work after getting a taste of the job when Harper's former colleague needs help.

episodes.title: Lockdown
episodes.overview: Officer Nolan is taken hostage by a man with nothing to lose while the station goes on lockdown and races to identify the suspect before time runs out. Meanwhile, Officer Jackson and his training officer, Officer Doug Stanton, reach a tipping point in their relationship that could end Jackson's career.

episodes.title: Sabotage
episodes.overview: Officer Jackson West's relationship with his new training officer, Stanton, has escalated and he begins to work with Sergeant Grey to find a solution.

episodes.title: La Fiera
episodes.overview: Officer John Nolan's mom makes an unannounced visit that complicates his life, and Sergeant Grey considers retiring.

episodes.title: In Justice
episodes.overview: Officer John Nolan and Officer Nyla Harper are assigned to a community policing center to help rebuild their station's reputation in the community. Nolan is determined to make a positive impact but Nyla has her doubts.

episodes.title: Consequences
episodes.overview: Nearing the end of his training, Nolan now faces his biggest challenge as a police officer yet when he must come to terms with the choices he has made in pursuit of the truth.

episodes.title: The Hunt
episodes.overview: In part two of the season finale, Nolan's discovery goes much deeper than he expected and could put his life and career in jeopardy.

episodes.title: The Q Word
episodes.overview: Their rookie year is coming to an end and officers Nolan, Chen and West are about to be squeezed harder than ever before as their training officers evaluate whether they are truly ready for the job. Meanwhile, after one of their rookie classmates is involved in a shooting, the team uncovers some unsettling evidence.

episodes.title: Under the Gun
episodes.overview: Nolan and Harper are tasked with escorting 4 juvenile offenders to a Scared Straight program at a correctional facility that quickly becomes a riotous situation. Nolan is uncertain about his relationship with Grace after she fails to introduce him to her ex-husband.

episodes.title: Control
episodes.overview: Officer Nolan's relationship with his first confidential informant is tested when he discovers her back on the street dealing drugs. Meanwhile, Lucy's fear of dating following her abduction and her intrusion into Jackson's relationship is beginning to threaten their friendship.

episodes.title: The Overnight
episodes.overview: Officers Chen and Bradford respond to a call at the Los Angeles auditions of "American Idol," and Officer Chen ends up facing Ryan Seacrest and the judges. Meanwhile, Chen befriends reporter whose motives are not clear.

episodes.title: Hand-Off
episodes.overview: Officer Nolan is having a particularly bad day after learning his identity has been stolen and could jeopardize his position as an officer. Meanwhile, Sgt. Grey must confront his past and testify at the parole hearing of the man who shot Grey and murdered his partner.

episodes.title: Casualties
episodes.overview: Officers Nolan and Harper investigate a murder which may have national security implications, while Officer Bradford must confront his past when he crosses paths with a homeless veteran.

episodes.title: Follow-Up Day
episodes.overview: Nolan is given some life-changing news and invites Grace over for a homecooked meal in his newly remodeled kitchen. Meanwhile, each unit is tasked with following up on dormant cases in the hopes they can uncover new leads.

episodes.title: Now and Then
episodes.overview: Lucy returns to duty after her abduction and Harper steps in to help her through her first day back on patrol. Meanwhile, Nolan takes his son's fiancé, Abigail, on a ride along after showing interest in becoming a police officer.

episodes.title: Day of Death
episodes.overview: Officer Nolan and the entire team are in a desperate search to rescue Officer Chen after her abduction and must attempt to get Rosalind to help them in their search. Meanwhile, after Officer Lopez discovers Wesley unconscious from a dangerous cocktail of alcohol and pills, she is forced to keep him close by.

episodes.title: The Dark Side
episodes.overview: Officer Nolan and team are charged with escorting a notorious female serial killer to the graves of her previously unrecovered victims. However, when they arrive, they unearth even more than they expected. Meanwhile, Officer Chen meets a seemingly perfect man who sparks her interest, and Officer Lopez worries about Wesley as his PTSD continues to increase.

episodes.title: Breaking Point
episodes.overview: Officer Nolan's trust is tested when he tries to help the previous owner of his home reconnect with his family. Meanwhile, Officer Harper has finally earned an overnight visit with her daughter that is put into jeopardy when her past undercover life resurfaces again.

episodes.title: Clean Cut
episodes.overview: Officer Nolan kicks off his birthday by babysitting a crime scene at a law office. Meanwhile, Officer Bradford and Officer West are set to receive special awards, and Sgt. Grey rides patrol with Officer Harper after she requests an early annual evaluation.

episodes.title: Safety
episodes.overview: John and Jessica's relationship gets a lot more complicated after she delivers some surprising news. Meanwhile, Officer Bradford and Office West are assigned a community policing project helping out the Watts Rams as volunteer coaches at their fall clinic, along with Rams players Eric Weddle and Robert Woods.

episodes.title: Fallout
episodes.overview: An emergency alert of an impending missile attack sends Los Angeles into chaos and uncertainty, while the officers each try to keep the peace and deal with their own disasters.

episodes.title: Tough Love
episodes.overview: As part of their second phase of training, the rookies are asked to develop their first confidential informants. Officer Nolan soon discovers that no two informants are the same and struggles with his newest task. Meanwhile, Officer Chen's mother complicates her home life when she comes to stay with her.

episodes.title: Warriors and Guardians
episodes.overview: Officer Nolan gets off to a rocky start after being introduced to his new training officer, Nyla Harper, who has an unconventional approach to police work after her stint as an undercover detective. Meanwhile, Officer Bradford struggles to think of an appropriate birthday gift for Rachel, and Officer Lopez finds herself navigating a case that triggers a personal memory.

episodes.title: The Bet
episodes.overview: Officer Nolan navigates building tension in his relationship with Jessica and a developing rapport with Grace while working a high-stakes criminal case involving an undercover homeland security agent. Meanwhile, Officer Chen meddles with Officer Bradford's love life, and Officer Lopez learns some surprising news about Wesley.

episodes.title: The Night General
episodes.overview: Nolan teams up with new night detective Pablo Armstrong for a murder investigation case that results in an unexpected reunion with a former love interest. Meanwhile, Officer Bradford reluctantly accepts help from Officer Chen as he prepares for his sergeant exam, and Officer West pursues an unconventional move after finding himself in need of a new home.

episodes.title: Impact
episodes.overview: Danger is ever-present as the officers of the Mid-Wilshire precinct grapple with the aftermath of a plotted attack on the city of Los Angeles, leaving Officer Bradford fighting for his life. Flash forward two weeks and the rookies receive the shocking results of their latest training exam, leaving one officer questioning what the future holds. Meanwhile, tension develops at home as Nolan and Lopez advance in their relationships with Jessica and Wesley.

episodes.title: Free Fall
episodes.overview: As the rookies prepare for a big exam to see who moves on to the next stage of training, Officer Nolan and Officer Bishop are called to the scene of a murder and learn that the victim may be tied to a potential terrorist attack on the city of Los Angeles.

episodes.title: The Checklist
episodes.overview: Sergeant Gray informs the rookies that they must track down a specific set of crimes in a 48-hour period in order to qualify for their final exam. Meanwhile, Officer Nolan and Officer Bishop answer a silent alarm call at will.i.am's house.

episodes.title: Homefront
episodes.overview: When one of their colleagues is arrested by Internal Affairs for lying on the witness stand, it leads to the release of three felons whose cases he worked on and the team being asked to check in on them now that they are free. Meanwhile, Officer Nolan finds out he is being sued by a man who claims he used excessive force which led to an injury.

episodes.title: The Shake Up
episodes.overview: A massive earthquake rocks the city and throws everyone's patrols and its citizens into chaos. Meanwhile, agent Russo recommends Officer Nolan for a protective detail of Brad Hayes, a man whose dealings have put a target on his head.

episodes.title: Greenlight
episodes.overview: Officer Nolan gets a lesson in respect after his arrest of a gang member leads to a free-for-all on his life. Meanwhile, Officer Chen and Officer Bradford pull over Mario Lopez, who thinks he can talk his way out of a traffic violation.

episodes.title: Manhunt
episodes.overview: When a prison bus crashes, all units must respond as some inmates face severe injuries while others seek an opportunity to flee. In the wake of the accident, Officer Nolan tries to impress an FBI hostage negotiator while tracking down an escaped convict.

episodes.title: Plain Clothes Day
episodes.overview: The rookies are really put to the test when their training officers accompany them out of uniform for Plain Clothes Day, which forces them to make all the decisions while on patrol. Meanwhile, Officer Nolan tries to prove he has been progressing faster than the other rookies to justify his desire of becoming a detective within five years.

episodes.title: Caught Stealing
episodes.overview: The rookies become the prime suspects after it is discovered a large sum of money used in a drug bust has gone missing.

episodes.title: Heartbreak
episodes.overview: The most dangerous day of the year - Valentine's Day - has the team on high alert, and Officer Nolan invites everyone over for a party now that he is single.

episodes.title: Redwood
episodes.overview: An unscheduled visit by the vice president of the United States puts the station on high alert. The secret service tasks Officer Nolan and Officer Bishop with checking out a possible threat to the vice president while the rest of the team try to keep the streets clear and safe for his visit.

episodes.title: Flesh and Blood
episodes.overview: On Captain Andersen's orders, Officer Nolan and Sergeant Grey are paired up for the day on patrol. Additionally, Nolan's son and Grey's daughter visit their dads on the job and see them in action. Meanwhile, Officer Chen is paired up with Captain Andersen, and Officer Bradford tells Chen to protect her at all costs.

episodes.title: Standoff
episodes.overview: Officer Bradford's wife, Isabel, is found shot but alive and he vows to track down the man responsible. Meanwhile, Officer Nolan must protect his home and the truth after a home invasion attack.

episodes.title: Time of Death
episodes.overview: Officer Nolan and Officer Bishop respond to a silent alarm call at a local convenience store where two men are attempting to rob the place. Officer Nolan pursues one of the suspects on foot and is forced to make a split-second decision that will affect both of their lives. Meanwhile, Officer Bishop helps coordinate a drug bust that hits a little too close to home for Officer Bradford.

episodes.title: The Ride Along
episodes.overview: Sergeant Grey informs Officer Nolan and Officer Bishop that they are going to have a movie director as a ride-along during their patrol after a fun afternoon granting the wish of a Make-A-Wish kid as honorary police officer Kaydence Patton. Meanwhile, Officer Bradford is tested once again after he learns that his wife, Isabel, has been arrested for drug possession.

episodes.title: The Hawke
episodes.overview: Nolan and the team must help capture a cop and his former mentor from the academy after he becomes a fugitive following an assault. Meanwhile, Officer Tim Bradford needs Officer Lucy Chen to learn to predict the moves of criminals in order to capture them.

episodes.title: The Roundup
episodes.overview: Nolan, the rookies and their training officers get involved in a competition that pits them against each other, while Officer Lucy Chen notices Officer Tim Bradford is obsessed with winning at all costs.

episodes.title: The Switch
episodes.overview: The rookies are temporarily paired with new training officers, and Officer Nolan is paired with Officer Lopez. When Nolan and Lopez track down an escaped criminal, they discover a little kindness goes a long way. Meanwhile, Jackson is forced to face his fears when he is partnered with Officer Bradford, while Officer Chen and Nolan must face a hard truth.

episodes.title: The Good, the Bad and the Ugly
episodes.overview: After Nolan and Talia lose control of a crime scene, they begin to debate whether people are fundamentally good or bad and what that means for a police officer. Meanwhile, Lucy is concerned Tim is enabling his wife's destructive behavior and not taking care of himself.

episodes.title: Crash Course
episodes.overview: Talia forces Nolan to confront his personal moral instincts in order to be a good cop after he encounters a kidnapping victim. Meanwhile, Lucy is temporarily placed with a new training officer who tests her patience, and Jackson must confront his failures head-on if he wants to be an officer.

episodes.title: Pilot
episodes.overview: Starting over isn't easy, especially for small-town guy John Nolan who, after a life-altering incident, is pursuing his dream of being a police officer.

title: Reacher
overview: Jack Reacher, a veteran military police investigator, has just recently entered civilian life. Reacher is a drifter, carrying no phone and the barest of essentials as he travels the country and explores the nation he once served.

episodes.title: Cut
episodes.overview: Reacher, Tamara and Jacob go on the attack as the real extent of the plot emerges. Reacher confronts those responsible for Anna's death, Jacob is forced to face the truth, and Plum has a chance to redeem herself.

episodes.title: Vote for Sampson
episodes.overview: Reacher and Tamara finally get the answers they've been waiting for, while Jacob discovers that their woes have just begun when Plum's sources provide crucial information.

episodes.title: Plum Out of Luck
episodes.overview: Fleeing the police, Reacher and Tamara head out-of-town to find the mysterious Ahlquist only to run into more trouble. Meanwhile, Jacob and Plum deal with their own problems back in Philadelphia.

episodes.title: Bridge
episodes.overview: After a misunderstanding, Reacher becomes Philadelphia's Most Wanted. Meanwhile, old enemies catch up with him and new ones emerge. Jacob, Tamara and Plum end up in a firefight, giving Jacob his first real shot at avenging his sister's death.

episodes.title: Karambits and Pieces
episodes.overview: Reacher interrogates Sampson, Tamara breaks into a government facility, Jacob receives some crushing news and the team learns a piece of information that changes everything.

episodes.title: One Small Step
episodes.overview: Reacher learns that things are more complex than they seem as he and Lila draw closer. Meanwhile, Tamara, Jacob, and Plum find an important clue after another attack from one of their mysterious adversaries sends them back to Philadelphia.

episodes.title: Cage Fight
episodes.overview: Tamara finds herself caught up in the mystery whether she likes it or not as she, Reacher, and Jacob face off against shady government agents and a mysterious squad of professional soldiers all looking for the same missing flash drive.

episodes.title: City of Brotherly Love
episodes.overview: A chance encounter with a distraught stranger on a Philadelphia subway car draws Jack Reacher into a deadly mystery involving a missing flash drive that contains secrets worth killing for.

episodes.title: Unfinished Business
episodes.overview: Reacher finally faces off with both Paulie and Quinn.

episodes.title: L.A. Story
episodes.overview: After Reacher and Duffy travel to Los Angeles to arrange a deal, Neagley arrives in Maine to help Reacher get answers.

episodes.title: Smoke on the Water
episodes.overview: Reacher is torn between his desire to kill Quinn and his promise to Duffy to save Teresa.

episodes.title: Smackdown
episodes.overview: When a DEA tragedy puts the entire mission at risk, Reacher, Duffy, and Villanueva improvise a drastic plan to save their cover.

episodes.title: Dominique
episodes.overview: Reacher reunites with Duffy and Villanueva and finally shares the painful details of his history with Xavier Quinn.

episodes.title: Number 2 with a Bullet
episodes.overview: As a rising body count threatens his undercover position, Reacher makes a dangerous play to secure Beck's trust.

episodes.title: Truckin'
episodes.overview: Tasked with transporting cargo for his new employer Zachary Beck, Reacher must juggle the involvement of the DEA and a nosy new associate.

episodes.title: Persuader
episodes.overview: Reacher must go undercover to rescue an informant being held by a haunting foe from his past.

episodes.title: Fly Boy
episodes.overview: Reacher and Neagley make a final desperate attempt to save O'Donnell and Dixon, stop A.M. and avenge their friends' murder.

episodes.title: The Man Goes Through
episodes.overview: As the team close in on Langston, two members of the 110th face danger, compelling Reacher to devise a dangerous plan to rescue them.

episodes.title: New York's Finest
episodes.overview: As the mystery continues to unfold, Reacher and his team set a trap to even the score.

episodes.title: Burial
episodes.overview: Neagley and Dixon discover shocking information about an old friend in Denver while Reacher and O'Donnell learn more about the nefarious and mysterious A.M..

episodes.title: A Night at the Symphony
episodes.overview: Reacher and his team head to Boston to track down a political aide with insider knowledge of a top secret military-defense contract that may be the reason behind their friends' deaths.

episodes.title: Picture Says a Thousand Words
episodes.overview: After more of his friends fall victim, Reacher forges an uneasy alliance with a dogged detective, and their only clue in the case leads the 110th to a troubling discovery.

episodes.title: What Happens in Atlantic City
episodes.overview: The investigation into Franz's murder takes Reacher and the surviving members of his former Army unit to Atlantic City where the mystery deepens, danger awaits, and an old flame is rekindled.

episodes.title: ATM
episodes.overview: Reacher and Neagley investigate the murder of a member of 110th, a group of Special investigators assembled by Reacher, only to realize the whole unit may be at risk.

episodes.title: Pie
episodes.overview: Reacher leads a rescue mission at the warehouse that ends in a showdown.

episodes.title: Reacher Said Nothing
episodes.overview: Reacher springs a trap and then gets trapped himself.

episodes.title: Papier
episodes.overview: As the town is rocked by another murder, Reacher heads to New York and learns the truth about the illegal business in Margrave while Roscoe faces danger in the woods.

episodes.title: No Apologies
episodes.overview: As the mystery deepens, Reacher teams up with an old colleague and Finlay makes a shocking discovery.

episodes.title: In a Tree
episodes.overview: As the danger increases, Reacher and Roscoe grow closer and they make plans to meet with their contact from Homeland Security.

episodes.title: Spoonful
episodes.overview: Reacher and Finlay's investigation into the missing Spivey leads them into a confrontation with Kliner Sr. Roscoe learns unsettling news about Reacher.

episodes.title: First Dance
episodes.overview: When more victims are discovered, Reacher attempts to get answers but is set up. Roscoe receives a threatening message.

episodes.title: Welcome to Margrave
episodes.overview: Reacher is wrongly accused of murder while visiting the small town of Margrave, GA.

title: Mirzapur
overview: The iron-fisted Akhandanand Tripathi is a millionaire carpet exporter and the mafia don of Mirzapur. His son, Munna, is an unworthy, power-hungry heir who will stop at nothing to inherit his father's legacy. An incident at a wedding procession forces him to cross paths with Ramakant Pandit, an upstanding lawyer, and his sons, Guddu and Bablu. It snowballs into a game of ambition, power and greed that threatens the fabric of this lawless city.

episodes.title: Pratibimbh
episodes.overview: Golu returns to Mirzapur only to discover the chaos that ensued in her absence. Madhuri inaugurates Aam Bagh despite the threat of JP Yadav looming large. As Dussehra closes in, there is only one question: Who will ascend the throne of Mirzapur?

episodes.title: Ansh
episodes.overview: Beena is compelled to find safety after the fall of Guddu. Madhuri urges Sharad to let go of the past for a better future. Will Shatrughan be able to convince Saloni to keep his secret? A broken Dimpy wants to take matters into her own hands.

episodes.title: Raja Beta
episodes.overview: Guddu goes down a dark downward spiral as he loses people close to him. A new judge is assigned before Ramakant's final hearing. Meanwhile, Saloni discovers her husband's secrets. IG Dubey is reinstated and is tasked with one mission: Capturing Guddu Pandit.

episodes.title: Bum-pilaat
episodes.overview: Purvanchal is thrown into turmoil following the shocking incident in the jail. Dadda confronts his son, while Sharad and Bharat have a fallout as well. A baithak is called to resolve the gang feud.

episodes.title: Bhasmasur
episodes.overview: Purvanchal is set ablaze with a gang war between Sharad and Guddu. Madhuri makes strong decisions to break the police-gangster nexus, while a ghost from the past resurfaces. Ramakant finds a purpose in prison, which catches Lala's attention.

episodes.title: Traahi
episodes.overview: Golu plans an attack outside Mirzapur without Guddu. Guddu returns from Nepal to find Golu missing. Sharad senses something is amiss in Siwan and decides to shift his most guarded secret to Jaunpur.

episodes.title: Kekadaa
episodes.overview: Ramakant's case is in danger with the appearance of a new witness. In an attempt to save her father's opium business from collapsing, Shabnam turns to Guddu for help. Meanwhile Golu gets some much awaited information about the still missing Kaleen Bhaiya.

episodes.title: Pratishodh
episodes.overview: Guddu cements his power over Mirzapur while Sharad finally makes a very strong ally. Golu receives a threat from Bharat. Ramakant turns down Robin's offer and faces danger in prison. Meanwhile Madhuri strategises to bring Guddu down in other ways.

episodes.title: Mexico
episodes.overview: Guddu and Golu kickstart the business again, but are still looking for a supply of opium which would allow them to establish control over Purvanchal's underworld. In the hunt for the same control, Sharad tries to crack a deal with one of Guddu's old allies, while Madhuri tries to eliminate Guddu.

episodes.title: Tetua
episodes.overview: While Ramakant is tried for the murder of SSP Maurya, Guddu and Golu's claim to the throne is questioned because Kaleen Bhaiya's body is missing. Madhuri vows to fulfill her father's mission of a crime free state.

episodes.title: King of Mirzapur
episodes.overview: Beena confronts the horrors of her past, leaving the Tripathi household in chaos. Munna's new found power through Madhuri leads him to make a drastic confrontation with Akhandanand. Dadda calls for a meeting with Mama, Shatrughan and Bharat. Ramakant is forced to confront his own beliefs. Guddu and Golu assure Beena of the promise they made. Sharad looks to bring his plan to a conclusion.

episodes.title: Butterscotch
episodes.overview: Beena gives birth to a boy and is worried about the safety of the child. Lala is unhappy with Guddu's closeness to Shabnam. Golu herself is in immense pain, questions what she has become. Maurya is frustrated with constant setbacks and decides to meet with the IG. Munna takes matters in his own hands when Maqbool's lies are resurfaced. Loyalties are at stake as a repercussion of Munna's actions.

episodes.title: Chauchak
episodes.overview: Sharad Shukla and JP Yadav successfully manage to dent Akhandanand's political aspirations. JP Yadav then calls for a debauche celebration with Zarina in private. After suffering a significant personal loss, Guddu takes upon an unexpected responsibility and Shabnam agrees to help. Golu doesn't take this too well as she feels Shabnam will come in the way of their larger objective.

episodes.title: Ood Bilaav
episodes.overview: Guddu and Golu are growing from strength to strength, Guddu strives to become the bahubali of Balia. On the personal front, Guddu is getting closer to Shabnam, who asks him to let go of the past. Shatrugan doesn't have the same influence in his family as his elder brother, a fact that Golu notices and uses to her advantage. The wheels of a Adventuretic political coup are set in to motion.

episodes.title: Ankush
episodes.overview: There has been a huge setback in the Tripathi family's business, Akhandanand smells a rat but uses this set back to his advantage. Munna is coerced in to taking a big step in his life which makes the Tripathis' political alliances stronger. Ramakant is surprised to find an unexpected ally. Golu makes a business proposition to Shatrughan, but it falls through. The elections come to an end.

episodes.title: Langda
