episodes.overview: Akhandanand reprimands Munna and Sharad for their impulsive actions. Bablu's diary becomes a key in learning secrets about the Tripathi family for Golu. In order to impress Akhandanand Tripathi, Sharad introduces him and Munna to one of Bihar's most powerful business family, the Tyagis. A fortunate coincidence triggers an unexpected alliance between parties that have a common goal.

episodes.title: Bhaymukt
episodes.overview: Guddu and Golu are still not a threat to Akhandanand, but Munna thinks differently. Akhandanand assigns Munna to take charge of youth canvassing in the state along with the CM's daughter, Madhuri Yadav. Beena safeguards a big secret. Guddu and Golu's alliance with Lala begins to affect Akhandanand's business. Golu decides to get Robin's expertise. Sharad's emotions overpower his thought process.

episodes.title: Viklaang Quota
episodes.overview: Akhandanand's woes in the bedroom lead him to the doors of a sexologist. Beena continues to be gripped by the traumatic incident she endured but finds a compelling reason to survive. Guddu has to push himself to think beyond his physical strength while Golu has to learn the ropes of the trade. They make use of Dimpy's past friendship and end up sending the Tripathis a strong message.

episodes.title: Khargosh
episodes.overview: The Tripathis, still unaware that Guddu and Golu are alive, continue to form new alliances. Munna impresses Bauji and Akhandanand with the way he has handled a negotiation. Akhandanand helps the Chief Minister of Uttar Pradesh close the wedding massacre chapter. Guddu, Golu and Dimpy who are still in hiding, reunite with a loyal partner and set their sights on Mirzapur.

episodes.title: Dhenkul
episodes.overview: The Gorakhpur wedding massacre is a thing of the past for Akhandanand Tripathi. His focus is now on the present - the business and conquering larger territory to remain the King of Mirzapur. Everyone who survived that violent night has come out a different person. Despite horrific memories, they know that survival is their only option.

episodes.title: Yogya
episodes.overview: Three generations of Tripathis show the world who they really are.

episodes.title: Tandav
episodes.overview: Tempers reach a head between Guddu and Bablu while they're in exile. And it's time for the Mr. Purvanchal contest.

episodes.title: Lions of Mirzapur
episodes.overview: Guddu and Bablu have come into their own in their private and professional lives as gangsters. But is it time for a rethink?

episodes.title: Barfi
episodes.overview: A meeting of the mafia heads of Purvanchal masquerading as a Holi party leads to a fracas' that threatens to transform all equations.

episodes.title: Bhaukal
episodes.overview: Guddu and Bablu hatch an ambitious plan to increase the gun trade, but for this, both the cops and criminals of Mirzapur must cooperate.

episodes.title: Virginity
episodes.overview: Akhandanand tests the boys' moral fibre, leading them down a path of no return. And Sweety must choose between Munna and Guddu.

episodes.title: Wafadar
episodes.overview: A generation-old rivalry is rekindled.

episodes.title: Gooda
episodes.overview: Guddu and Bablu have a life-altering choice to make. Munna gets a lesson in loyalty. A new, diabolical contender for Mirzapur emerges.

episodes.title: Jhandu
episodes.overview: A shocking incident at a wedding procession ignites a series of events entangling the lives of two families in the lawless city of Mirzapur.

title: What If...?
overview: Taking inspiration from the comic books of the same name, each episode of this animated anthology series questions, revisits and twists classic Marvel Cinematic moments.

episodes.title: What If... What If?
episodes.overview: The end of the beginning...

episodes.title: What If... The Watcher Disappeared?
episodes.overview: The Watcher must stand trial for his many interventions.

episodes.title: What If... 1872?
episodes.overview: In a universe where the heroes of the MCU live in the Old West, Shang-Chi and his pistol-packing partner, Kate Bishop, traverse the frontier, saving the innocent from the evils of The Hood.

episodes.title: What If... The Emergence Destroyed the Earth?
episodes.overview: In a Universe where The Eternals never stopped The Emergence, the birth of an incubating Celestial shatters the Earth. Civilization endures on the rocky remnants of our planet, where Quentin Beck leads an authoritarian regime until freedom fighters recruit Riri Williams on a deadly mission to take him down.

episodes.title: What If... Howard the Duck Got Hitched?
episodes.overview: Howard the Duck and Darcy Lewis find themselves on an intergalactic pleasure cruise. When dangerous factions from across the galaxy descend to threaten their trip, they must discover their own cosmic powers to withstand the onslaught.

episodes.title: What If... The Red Guardian Stopped the Winter Soldier?
episodes.overview: It is 1991, and the Red Guardian takes it upon himself to join a high-profile mission and prove himself to his Red Room superiors. When his antics interfere with the Winter Soldier's own mission to kill Howard Stark, the two Soviet supersoldiers must form an alliance to escape the United States.

episodes.title: What If... Agatha Went to Hollywood?
episodes.overview: Howard Stark may have helped the Allies win World War II…but what he really wants to do is direct! On the set of Stark Pictures' first production, the playboy auteur quickly finds himself enchanted by his bewitching lead actress, Agatha Harkness. Little does she know there will be another superpower co-star on the call sheet...Kingo.

episodes.title: What If... The Hulk Fought the Mech Avengers?
episodes.overview: Captain America/Sam Wilson must suit up in a colossal mech suit to battle Bruce Banner after an attempt to cure himself of the Hulk goes horribly wrong. Bucky Barnes, Monica Rambeau, Moon Knight, and others must join Sam as his new team of Mech Avengers.

episodes.title: What If... Strange Supreme Intervened?
episodes.overview: When Captain Carter teams up with an old friend to hunt down vicious Universe Killers terrorizing the Multiverse, she discovers the greatest threat to all existence may be closer than she realizes.

episodes.title: What If... The Avengers Assembled in 1602?
episodes.overview: When Captain Carter is transported to an Elizabethan-era locale that's populated by modernday MCU figures, she'll have to uncover the cause of the temporal anomaly that's mysteriously stranded so many familiar heroes and villains in the year 1602.

episodes.title: What If... Hela Found the Ten Rings?
episodes.overview: Growing weary of Hela's bloodlust, Odin opts to teach his daughter a lesson by stripping her of her powers and banishing her to Earth. But when she lands in ancient China, the seductive lure of the Ten Rings threatens to reawaken the Goddess of Death's villainous appetite.

episodes.title: What If... Kahhori Reshaped the World?
episodes.overview: A Mohawk woman ventures into the waters of the Forbidden Lake to help save her people.

episodes.title: What If... Captain Carter Fought the Hydra Stomper?
episodes.overview: Peggy Carter / Captain Carter believes that the love of her life, Steve Rogers, is long-dead until he is discovered alive as the villainous Hydra Stomper.

episodes.title: What If... Iron Man Crashed into the Grandmaster?
episodes.overview: After his gambit to destroy the Chitauri Fleet during the battle of New York strands him on the planet of Sakaar, Tony Stark's efforts to overthrow The Grandmaster lead to a ceremonial, grand prix-turned-demolition-derby—a death match that could land Tony on the Sakaarian throne.

episodes.title: What If... Happy Hogan Saved Christmas?
episodes.overview: When Justin Hammer lays siege to Avengers Tower during the annual holiday party, there's only one person left on site to stop him - Happy Hogan. But in setting out to prove his hero chops, Iron Man's errand boy may end up transforming himself in more ways than one.

episodes.title: What If... Peter Quill Attacked Earth's Mightiest Heroes?
episodes.overview: In 1988 after seeing his mother Meredith die, Peter Quill is abducted by a group of Ravengers led by Yondu Udonta sent by the Celestial planet Ego. However rather than having a change of heart and raising Quill as his own, Yondu gave him to Ego as originally planned. Taking his walkman away, Ego raised him beginning to show his Expansion plan.

episodes.title: What If... Nebula Joined the Nova Corps?
episodes.overview: In a world where Ronan deposes Thanos long before the events of "Infinity War," Nebula is recruited to join the Nova Corps. Desperate to escape her father's shadow, she sets out to prove her detective chops.

episodes.title: What If... The Watcher Broke His Oath?
episodes.overview: In order to defeat Ultron, The Watcher breaks his oath and assembles a team of heroes from across the timelines.

episodes.title: What If... Ultron Won?
episodes.overview: Natasha Romanoff and Clint Barton seek to destroy killer-robot Ultron following a cataclysmic event.

episodes.title: What If… Thor Were an Only Child?
episodes.overview: Thor, who never learned to be a good hero, throws an out-of-control intergalactic party on Earth. He learns a neat trick the Skrulls can do, then meets Jane Foster for the first time.

episodes.title: What If… Killmonger Rescued Tony Stark?
episodes.overview: An American soldier called Killmonger rescues Tony Stark when his Humvee is attacked in Afghanistan.

episodes.title: What If... Zombies!?
episodes.overview: When The Avengers are infected by a zombie plague, surviving heroes search for a cure.

episodes.title: What If… Doctor Strange Lost His Heart Instead of His Hands?
episodes.overview: After losing the love of his life in a car crash, Doctor Strange becomes consumed with finding a spell that can bring Christine back to life.

episodes.title: What If... The World Lost its Mightiest Heroes?
episodes.overview: Nick Fury struggles to launch The Avengers when candidates are targeted by a serial killer. Meanwhile, Loki presented himself to the Earth governments as king of Asgard using all his diplomacy.

episodes.title: What If… T'Challa Became a Star-Lord?
episodes.overview: What would have happened if T'Challa and not Peter Quill were picked up by Yondu as a child and became Star-Lord?

episodes.title: What If… Captain Carter Were the First Avenger?
episodes.overview: After an ambush in the lab, Peggy Carter steps in and takes the Super Soldier serum and uses her newfound power and strength to charge right into battle.

title: Dr. STONE
overview: One fateful day, all of humanity was petrified by a blinding flash of light. After several millennia, high schooler Taiju awakens and finds himself lost in a world of statues. However, he’s not alone! His science-loving friend Senku’s been up and running for a few months and he's got a grand plan in mind—to kickstart civilization with the power of science!

episodes.title: Ushers of an Exhilarating Future
WHYMAN
GIANT STEP
COUNT DOWN
Wanting Everything
episodes.overview: The team is too small to build a round-trip rocket. They'll need to enlist help from around the world.

episodes.title: Challengers of Science
episodes.overview: The Kingdom of Science's rocket launches are mired by a string of rapid unscheduled disassemblies.

episodes.title: Unknown Known
episodes.overview: With the computer completed, the team will need a user interface: a TV.

episodes.title: Stone to Space
episodes.overview: The team will need a stupidly insane amount of electricity to turn their bauxite into an aluminum rocket body.

episodes.title: The Truth About Rockets
episodes.overview: The team gets to work wiring up several megabits' worth of memory donuts for their computer.

episodes.title: The Dawn of Computers
episodes.overview: The computer that the team is building is a series of toroidal tubes. Senku explains.

episodes.title: The Universe Is Written in the Language of Mathematics
episodes.overview: The New Perseus sets out to India to recruit mathematicians for the space program.

episodes.title: Fire
episodes.overview: The crew arrives in Spain, where they collect fluorite, olive oil and some treats.

episodes.title: Future Engine
episodes.overview: Senku and Dr. Xeno team up to gather the materials needed to make a rocket engine.

episodes.title: Whole New World
episodes.overview: With Senku back, it's only a matter of time before the rest of the Kingdom of Science is revived.

episodes.title: Scientist, All Alone
episodes.overview: Suika gathers the team's statues, sets up camp and gets to work doing science.

episodes.title: Until We Meet Again
episodes.overview: With the petrification beam approaching, who will get their hands on the revival fluid?

episodes.title: Our Dr. Stone
episodes.overview: With the revival team captured, it's up to Luna and Chelsea to revive everyone when the time comes.

episodes.title: What I Once Sought to Destroy
episodes.overview: Suika is in charge of making sure Senku's plan works, but her kindness becomes an obstacle.

episodes.title: Stone Sanctuary
episodes.overview: The team begins making, digging for, and polishing diamonds to replace the burnt-out ones inside the devices.

episodes.title: Diamond Heart
episodes.overview: The team discovers a giant pile of petrification devices. They take them apart to see what makes them tick.

episodes.title: Sickening Yet Beautiful
episodes.overview: Senku and his team have lost Stanley for now, but they aren't out of -- or rather, in -- the woods just yet.

episodes.title: Medusa Mechanism
episodes.overview: The team is going to need a weapon for when Stanley inevitably catches up to them.

episodes.title: The Escape
episodes.overview: After falling for a decoy, Stanley's team finally catches up to the crew, who must now outwit them while racing through the desert.

episodes.title: EARTH RACE
episodes.overview: Senku and company must flee from Stanley's ship, but they have to make stops to refuel.

episodes.title: Watching the Same Moon
episodes.overview: The team head to the source of the petrification beam in South America as they flee from Stanley's ship.

episodes.title: Reunion
episodes.overview: Xeno's army attacks and when all seems lost, Chrome and his friends finish the tunnel and capture Xeno.

episodes.title: Those Who Know the Rules; Those Who Make Them
episodes.overview: Ryusui and Senku take to the skies in a science versus science dogfight while Xeno's forces mount a ground counterattack.

episodes.title: Dirty Roads
episodes.overview: With Senku still confined to the bed, Chrome's team begins work on the tunnel to Xeno's base.

episodes.title: Light of Science
episodes.overview: With the crew on board tending to a severely injured Senku, Chrome's team and Tsukasa's team must join forces to devise a way to infiltrate the enemy's lair.

episodes.title: LOCK ON
episodes.overview: NASA scientist Dr. Xeno attempts to pick off the leader of the Kingdom of Science.

episodes.title: The Two Scientists
episodes.overview: Senku had gotten his start in rocket building through an email exchange with Doctor Xeno. Their approaches to science soon diverged.

episodes.title: SCIENCE IS ELEGANT
episodes.overview: Stanley orders Luna to infiltrate the Perseus and identify Doctor Taiju. Things go sideways when it turns out to be a little too easy.

episodes.title: DOCTOR VS. DOCTOR
episodes.overview: Tensions rise as Dr. Xeno makes his introductions to the Perseus.

episodes.title: Dr. X
episodes.overview: The search party narrowly escaped enemy machine gun fire. Unfortunately, the respite was short-lived.

episodes.title: Light Trap in the Darkness
episodes.overview: The Perseus lands in the Americas. They first head to Northern California in search of yellow dent corn, but discover a lot more than that.

episodes.title: SCIENCE JOURNEY
episodes.overview: Maintaining morale will be critical on the long journey to the Americas. Knowing where on the ocean you are is pretty important, too. The crew of the Perseus discuss.

episodes.title: RYUSUI VS. SENKU
episodes.overview: Senku and his companions finally set off for America in search of corn. However, a dispute arises between Ryusui and Senku shortly after they depart

episodes.title: Beyond the New World
episodes.overview: With the petrification device in the Kingdom's hands, it's time to revive Tsukasa. But there's just one problem: the device is out of batteries.

episodes.title: Treasure Island
episodes.overview: To the moon! That's the plan, at least. Senku and the Kingdom of Science need to devise a means with which to go to the moon and deal with Why-Man. The first step is allying with the people of Treasure Island and enlisting their help with some new crafts.

episodes.title: First Dream
episodes.overview: Senku stands victorious. He then works on reviving the others and fixing their communications device, but while they are talking with Ruri they encounter a strong interference with the signal.

episodes.title: Last Man Standing
episodes.overview: Much to Ibara's shock and dismay, Senku devised a plan and managed to escape petrification. Now the two enter into a head-to-head battle for control of the Medusa device.

episodes.title: Flicker of Doom
episodes.overview: Yo and the Kingdom of Science capture the petrification device, but Ibara isn't going down without a fight.

episodes.title: Joker
episodes.overview: The Kingdom of Science members launch an attack on the islanders aboard the Perseus, but Moz isn't far behind and Senku and the others are forced to retreat inside the vessel. Ibara has them cornered, but Senku unleashes his Joker card.

episodes.title: Total War
episodes.overview: The Kingdom of Science attacks and tries to execute their plan to steal the petrification device. Moz convinces Kirisame to use the device, but Ryusui's instincts tell him something is off about the situation.

episodes.title: Three-Dimensional Battle
episodes.overview: Moz and the Kingdom of Science form a tenuous, temporary alliance against Ibara. How long it will last is a question they can't afford to concern themselves with just yet.

episodes.title: Deal Game, Test of Wit
episodes.overview: More of the Kingdom of Science is brought back from petrification, but they are discovered in the cave by Moz.

episodes.title: Medusa's True Face
episodes.overview: The team revives Kaseki to work on the drone. Meanwhile, Ginro is called to see the Master.

episodes.title: The Kingdom of Science Strikes Back
episodes.overview: Kohaku is forced to destroy Ryusui's statue to prove that she isn't a spy.

episodes.title: With This Fist, a Miracle
episodes.overview: Kohaku has located the treasure left behind by Byakuya and the others, but it's encased in concrete. Senku has to devise a plan to quietly get at the contents inside, so as to not alert the guards.

episodes.title: Science Wars
episodes.overview: Amaryllis, Ginro and Kohaku are chosen to join the inner palace. The science team will need a way to communicate with them in secret, and, eventually, a way for them with the science team.

episodes.title: Beautiful Science
episodes.overview: Suika and Ginro strive to rescue the mobile lab from the Perseus.

episodes.title: The Trump Card Aboard the Vessel of Science
episodes.overview: Amaryllis explains how she avoided being petrified and how she decided to sneak into the palace.

episodes.title: Ray of Despair, Ray of Hope
episodes.overview: The Perseus arrives at the Treasure Island.

episodes.title: Treasure Box
episodes.overview: The ship Perseus is completed, then the Perseus sets sail to the Treasure Island with a select Ishigami crew on board. Dr. Stone and the others goal is a island where the ISS space station crew landed years in the past.

episodes.title: Science Vessel Perseus
episodes.overview: Kaseki's efforts to build the Perseus hits a roadblock.

episodes.title: Eyes of Science
episodes.overview: The Kingdom of Science creates radar and sonar to determine the source of the morse code.

episodes.title: First Contact
episodes.overview: Senku looks for the Sagara oil fields.

episodes.title: Greed Equals Justice
episodes.overview: The Kingdom of Science needs rations for the planned voyage of discovery.

episodes.title: New World Map
episodes.overview: Ishigami village takes up agriculture.

episodes.title: Prologue of Dr. Stone
episodes.overview: The Kingdom of Science is victorious, however it is not over for Senku. Senku must use all of his knowledge to cure Tsukasa who is severly injured.

episodes.title: Humanity's Strongest Tag Team
episodes.overview: A truce is called between the Kingdom of Science and Tsukasa Empire. All appears to be well, but some of the Kingdom's dynamite is missing.

episodes.title: To Destroy and to Save
episodes.overview: Tsukasa and Hyoga are coming to capture the miracle cave. The Kingdom of Science must buy Senku and Chrome some time to turn the tide, or it is all over.

episodes.title: Final Battle
episodes.overview: The Final Battle for the miracle cave starts as Senku and the Kingdom of Science conduct a frontal assault on the cave.

episodes.title: Secret Mission
episodes.overview: With Chrome safe and sound, Senku and Gen start work on the plan to convert people to their side with the Lilian Weinberg recording. They just have to avoid Ukyo and his incredible hearing.

episodes.title: Prison Break
episodes.overview: Desperate to escape his prisone confine, Chrome tries to stratergize a plan that will allow him to escape. However, surrounding his prison are traps and his new head jailer Yo is a former loose cannon police officer.

episodes.title: Steam Gorilla
episodes.overview: The final touches to the automobile are made and it is used to transport the science supplies to a fortified cliffside that's close to the Tsukasa empire. From there the automobile is upgraded into a tank, but unbeknownst to the rescue group preparations by the empire have been made to counter any vehicular attack.

episodes.title: Full Assault
episodes.overview: Chrome and Magnum struggles with Urkyo, while Senku, however, gets his hands busy with building up an invention; a new hope.

episodes.title: Call From the Dead
episodes.overview: Taiju and Yuzuriha are on the verge of tears after they hear Senku's voice, and Senku informs them of his plan to win the war without any bloodshed.

episodes.title: Hot Line
episodes.overview: While Senku's diversion buys Gen and others some time, soon Homura realizes something is not right.

episodes.title: Stone Wars Beginning
episodes.overview: Senku continues in trying to advance the stone world, this time he makes "space food", it is in actuality cup noodles. After Senku finishes his project, Gen has an epiphany and devises a plan to take down Tsukasa's army without violence.

episodes.title: Voices Over Infinite Distance
episodes.overview: In a flashback, Byakuya decides to leave a glass record for Senku containing a message from him. In the present, Senku and his group create a record player.Senku unveils the record player to the village and plays it. To their amazement, Byakuya's voice is heard as he introduces himself. He then stops with the formalities as he addresses Senku, knowing full well that he is free by now and is hearing the message. Byakuya wants to voice confidence in him before stopping, since he knows his son wouldn't go for sappy father-son moments. Senku laughs that Byakuya truly gets him, as Kohaku notes that Senku is cold to his father while Kokuyo sadly notes she is no better.Byakuya then has Lillian perform a song preformed with the crew helping. The villagers are in awe at the sound.

episodes.title: Wave of Science
episodes.overview: Senku and the rest of the village get to work on making the components for the cell phone. It's hard work but everyone is pumped!

episodes.title: The Treasure
episodes.overview: Senku, Chrome, and Magma venture into a cave in search of Tungsten, but there's a suspicious accident that leaves Senku and Chrome trapped at the bottom of a pit! What is Magma up to?!

episodes.title: Spartan Crafts Club
episodes.overview: With Chrome and Kaseki's water wheel finished, Ishigami Village moves into the age of electricity! But with the primitive materials available to him, will Senku be able to create a filament that can withstand the intense heat of operating a vacuum tube?

episodes.title: The Age of Energy
episodes.overview: Work begins on creating the components for Senku's cell phone, but spinning gold wire is proving to be quite the task! Luckily, Chrome and Kaseki "invent" the water wheel and drastically improve the process!

episodes.title: To Modernity
episodes.overview: Hyoga is disarmed, but the kingdom of science is still in danger - Ishigami village is in flames. And Tsukasa will soon know that Senku is still alive - How will the villagers fight off the coming invasion?

episodes.title: Stone Wars
episodes.overview: Tsukasa's army is coming. Kinro struggles to hold the bridge against the deadly spearman Hyoga and his shock troops, but Senku and the villagers are ready with deadly new weapons of science.

episodes.title: A Hundred Nights and a Thousand Skies
episodes.overview: Byakuya and the astronauts' story continues, and Senku's connection to Ishigami Village and the Hundred Tales is finally revealed.

episodes.title: A Tale for the Ages
episodes.overview: Ruri reveals the origin of the village's name and Senku learns of his father's fate.

episodes.title: The Culmination of Two Million Years
episodes.overview: After Senku's unlikely victory, quick marriage, and even hastier divorce, the kingdom of science is back to work to finally finish Ruri's medicine.

episodes.title: Master of Flame
episodes.overview: After Magma's series of tricks to reach the final match, Chrome reveals a trick of his own. With a little extra help from Gen, Chrome just may be able to pull this one off.

episodes.title: Masked Warrior
episodes.overview: All that's needed to make antibiotics is alcohol. The best way to get some is to win the Grand Bout, which the Senku and his kingdom will also need to do in order to keep Magma away from Ruri and give her the drug.

episodes.title: Buddies Back to Back
episodes.overview: To recover the most problematic ingredient in order to create sulfonamides, Ginro, Chrome, Kohaku and Senku will head to a zone of maximum danger. What kind of enemy will stand before them?

episodes.title: Clear World
episodes.overview: Suika never wants to show her face for some reason that only a few know. Fortunately, Senku knows the solution to his annoying problem.

episodes.title: A Flimsy Alliance
episodes.overview: After Gen is brutally beaten in a surprise attack, Kohaku devises a plan to bring down the attacker once and for all.

episodes.title: Let There Be the Light of Science
episodes.overview: Senku feeds the villagers ramen so they can help him make iron. Senku meets Asagiri Gen a man who's been unpetrified and is working for Tsukasa. Asagiri decides to help Senku. Senku wants to make a generator with the help of lightning.

episodes.title: Stone Road
episodes.overview: Senku wants to make antibiotics and he explains how to Chrome and Kohaku. Senku decides to use magnets to collect iron. A child named Suika offers to help Senku. Senku decides to make ramen to appease the villagers and use their manpower.

episodes.title: Where Two Million Years Have Gone
episodes.overview: Senku helps Kohaku bring hot water back to her village for her ill sister. Kohaku tells Senku about her village and that it has forty people. Senku is told he cannot enter the village. Senku explains to Chrome about the history of mankind.

episodes.title: Two Nations of the Stone World
episodes.overview: Senku awakens after being nearly killed by Tsukasa and suggests splitting up with Yuzuriha and Taiju so they can spy on Tsukasa. A girl fights Tsukasa but is defeated and trapped under a tree. Senku finds the same girl and helps her.

episodes.title: Stone World the Beginning
episodes.overview: Taiju and Yuzuriha flee from Tsukasa while taking Senku with them. It is discovered how Senku survived his first days after being freed from petrifaction.

episodes.title: Fire the Smoke Signal
episodes.overview: The group embarks on a hunt for gunpowder making supplies; an accidental explosion leads to a fight.

episodes.title: Weapons of Science
episodes.overview: Senku does not trust the motivation of Shishio, so he will try to hide his plans from a new and unforeseen enemy for his plan to revive civilization.

episodes.title: King of The Stone World
episodes.overview: Senku and Taiju prepare to make Yuzuriha as the first person they revive with their completed water, only to suddenly be chased by lions. In order to fight them off, the duo decide to instead revive the strongest fighter in their school, Tsukasa Shishio, who proves to be a valuable hunter. As the group begin harvesting seashells to grind into calcium carbonate for further advances in civilization, Tsukasa, who is against reviving the corrupt adults of human society, clashes with Senku, who remains determined to save everyone.

episodes.title: Stone World
episodes.overview: Thousands of years after a mysterious phenomenon turned all of humanity to stone, the super-intelligent, science-driven boy Senku Ishigami awakens. Facing a world of stone and the total collapse of civilization, Senku decides to use science to rebuild the world. Together with his childhood friend Taiju Oki, they begin to rebuild civilization from scratch.

title: Doctor Who
overview: The Doctor is a Time Lord: a 900 year old alien with 2 hearts, part of a gifted civilization who mastered time travel. The Doctor saves planets for a living—more of a hobby actually, and the Doctor's very, very good at it.

episodes.title: Chapter Six: The Vanquishers
episodes.overview: In the final epic chapter in the story of the Flux, all hope is lost. The forces of darkness are in control. But when the monsters have won, who can you count upon to save the universe?

episodes.title: Chapter Five: Survivors of the Flux
episodes.overview: As the forces of evil mass, the Doctor, Yaz and Dan face perilous journeys and seemingly insurmountable obstacles in their quest for survival.

episodes.title: Chapter Four: Village of the Angels
episodes.overview: Devon, November 1967. A little girl has gone missing, Professor Eustacius Jericho is conducting psychic experiments, and in the village graveyard, there is one gravestone too many. Why is Medderton known as the Cursed Village, and what do the Weeping Angels want?

episodes.title: Chapter Three: Once, Upon Time
episodes.overview: On a planet that shouldn't exist, in the aftermath of apocalypse, the Doctor, Dan, Yaz and Vinder face a battle to survive.

episodes.title: Chapter Two: War of the Sontarans
episodes.overview: During the Crimean War, the Doctor discovers the British army fighting a brutal alien army of Sontarans, as Yaz and Dan are thrown deeper into a battle for survival. What is the Temple of Atropos? Who are the Mouri?

episodes.title: Chapter One: The Halloween Apocalypse
episodes.overview: On Halloween, all across the universe, terrifying forces are stirring. From the Arctic Circle to deep space, an ancient evil is breaking free. And in present-day Liverpool, the life of Dan Lewis is about to change forever. Why is the Doctor on the trail of the fearsome Karvanista? And what is the Flux?

episodes.title: The Timeless Children
episodes.overview: The Cybermen attack, and for the Doctor nothing will ever be the same.

episodes.title: Ascension of the Cybermen
episodes.overview: The aftermath of the Great CyberWar. The Doctor arrives in the far future, intent on protecting the last of the human race from the deadly Cybermen. But in the face of such a relentless enemy, has she put her best friends at risk? What terrors lie hiding in the depths of space, and what is Ko Sharmus?

episodes.title: The Haunting of Villa Diodati
episodes.overview: The Doctor and gang arrive at the Villa Diodati, Lake Geneva, in 1816 - on a night that inspired Mary Shelley's Frankenstein. The plan is to spend the evening soaking up the atmos in the presence of some literary greats - but the ghosts are all too real. And the Doctor is forced into a decision of earth-shattering proportions…

episodes.title: Can You Hear Me?
episodes.overview: From ancient Syria to present day Sheffield, and out into the wilds of space, something is stalking the Doctor and her friends and infecting people's nightmares. As Graham, Yaz and Ryan return home to see friends and family, they find themselves haunted by very different experiences. Who is the figure calling from beyond the stars for help, and why? And what are the fearsome Chagaskas terrorising Aleppo in 1380? To find the answers, Team TARDIS embark on a mission that forces them to face their darkest fears.

episodes.title: Praxeus
episodes.overview: What connects a missing astronaut, birds behaving strangely in Peru, and a US naval officer who washes up on a Madagascan beach? The Doctor, Yaz, Ryan and Graham split up to investigate mysterious events across 21st century planet Earth. As the mystery deepens, and lives are put at risk, the TARDIS team face a deadly race against time to save humanity.

episodes.title: Fugitive of the Judoon
episodes.overview: Stomping their way into present-day Gloucester, the Judoon are on the hunt for someone on the run. Who is this fugitive? And why are these alien mercenaries after them?

episodes.title: Nikola Tesla's Night of Terror
episodes.overview: It is 1903 and on the edge of Niagara Falls, something is wrong at Nikola Tesla's generator plant, where someone – or something – is sabotaging the maverick inventor's work. Has Tesla really received a message from Mars? And where does his great rival Thomas Edison fit into these events? The Doctor and her companions Yaz, Ryan and Graham must join forces with one of history's greatest minds to save both him and planet Earth.

episodes.title: Orphan 55
episodes.overview: Having decided that everyone could do with a holiday, the Doctor takes Graham, Yasmin, Ryan to a luxury resort for a spot of rest and relaxation. However, they discover the place where they are having a break is hiding a number of deadly secrets. What are the ferocious monsters that are attacking Tranquillity Spa?

episodes.title: Spyfall, Part 2
episodes.overview: A terrifying plan to destroy humanity is about to reach fruition. Can the Doctor and her companions escape multiple traps and defeat a deadly alliance?

episodes.title: Spyfall, Part 1
episodes.overview: Intelligence agents around the world are under attack from alien forces, so MI6 turns to the only people who can help - The Doctor and friends. As the team travels the globe looking for answers, attacks come from all sides. Earth's security rests on the their shoulders - but where will this planet-threatening conspiracy lead them?

episodes.title: The Battle of Ranskoor Av Kolos
episodes.overview: The Doctor and her companions respond to nine separate distress signals all originating from the same planet: Ranskoor Av Kolos. There they discover a stranded ship, an amnesiac pilot... and an old foe.

episodes.title: It Takes You Away
episodes.overview: The TARDIS group materialize in Norway in 2018, and soon find themselves involved with a blind girl and her missing father.

episodes.title: The Witchfinders
episodes.overview: The Doctor and her companions materialize in 17th century England and soon find themselves embroiled in local witchcraft... which is the prelude to an alien invasion.

episodes.title: Kerblam!
episodes.overview: After receiving an anonymous request for help, the Doctor and her companions travel to a moon of Kandoka to investigate the universe's large retailer: Kerblam.

episodes.title: Demons of the Punjab
episodes.overview: Yasmin asks the Doctor to travel back to 1947 India to find out the secret of her grandmother's watch, and discovers more than she wanted to know.

episodes.title: The Tsuranga Conundrum
episodes.overview: After a sonic mine detonates, injuring them, the TARDIS crew wake up on a medical ship. They soon discover that they're trapped with an omnivore that threatens the ship's integrity... and the authorities will blow up the ship rather than let the creature endanger thousands of patients.

episodes.title: Arachnids in the UK
episodes.overview: The Doctor and her companions return to Earth and find a homegrown menace in the apartment complex where Yasmin's family live... and at the hotel where her mother Najia works.

episodes.title: Rosa
episodes.overview: The Doctor and her friends find themselves in the Deep South of America when they arrive in Montgomery, Alabama, in 1955. As they encounter a seamstress named Rosa Parks, they begin to wonder if someone is attempting to change history. They discover that a criminal from the future is trying to alter time and make sure that Rosa is never forced to stand on the bus.

episodes.title: The Ghost Monument
episodes.overview: The Doctor and her new friends are rescued by two separate spaceships on a mysterious quest, and at the end of the quest lies... the Ghost Monument.

episodes.title: The Woman Who Fell to Earth
episodes.overview: In a South Yorkshire city, Ryan Sinclair, Yasmin Khan, and Graham O'Brien are about to have their lives changed forever, as a mysterious woman, unable to remember her own name, falls from the night sky. Can they believe a word she says? Ryan stumbles across a mysterious pod that appears in the forest. Soon a series of strange occurrences happen in Sheffield, and the mysterious woman sets out to solve them.

episodes.title: The Doctor Falls
episodes.overview: The Doctor rescues Bill, but warns her that there's no going back to the way things were. Meanwhile, the Cybermen prepare to invade another floor of the spaceship, and Missy must choose sides.

episodes.title: World Enough and Time
episodes.overview: The Doctor decides to test Missy's reformation with a mission to investigate a distress signal coming from a 400-mile-long ship near a black hole. However, things soon take a turn for the worst and an old friend returns with new allies.

episodes.title: The Eaters of Light
episodes.overview: The Doctor, Bill, and Nardole travel to Scotland in the distant past to learn what happened to the Ninth Legion. They soon discover an alien creature stalking the woods, and the gate that must remain guarded no matter what.

episodes.title: Empress of Mars
episodes.overview: The Doctor and Bill end up stranded on Mars investigating how a 19th century message appeared on the 21st century Mars. They find Victorian soldiers... invading an ancient Ice Warrior hive.

episodes.title: The Lie of the Land
episodes.overview: Bill finds herself in a world that is ruled by the Monks, and has always believed that the Monks have been there to guide humanity and defend it. Worse, the Doctor is working with the Monks to solidify their rule.

episodes.title: The Pyramid at the End of the World
episodes.overview: The Monks materialize a 5,000-year-old pyramid as a threat, and then demand the consent of Earth's leaders to save the planet from imminent destruction.

episodes.title: Extremis
episodes.overview: The Pope asks the Doctor to investigate the mysteries of Veritas, a book that has caused everyone to read it to commit suicide. However, the Doctor soon learns that Veritas contains the real history of the universe… and it is enough to drive anyone to suicide.

episodes.title: Oxygen
episodes.overview: The Doctor takes Bill and Nardole to a space station in the future in response to a distress call. They discover that 36 of the 40 crew members are dead... but their suits aren't.

episodes.title: Knock Knock
episodes.overview: Bill and her mates receive an offer to move into an old house at a price they can't refuse. However, they soon discover that the price is much higher than promised.

episodes.title: Thin Ice
episodes.overview: The Doctor takes Bill to the Great Frost Fair on the Thames in 1814... and they discover that something is living beneath the ice. Something huge, and hungry.

episodes.title: Smile
episodes.overview: For her first proper trip, the Doctor takes Bill to a colony in the future. They discover that the skeleton crew has been wiped out, and a terrible fate awaits the awakening colonists unless they do something.

episodes.title: The Pilot
episodes.overview: A young woman, Bill, listens to the lectures of a long-time university professor, the Doctor. He soon agrees to tutor her, and Bill realizes that the Doctor is much more than he seems. Bill's mind is opened to a universe that is bigger and more exciting than she could imagine.

episodes.title: Hell Bent
episodes.overview: The Doctor bargains with the Time Lords: his knowledge of the Hybrid in return for their saving Clara from death. However, the price may be far more than the Doctor is willing to pay.

episodes.title: Heaven Sent
episodes.overview: The Doctor finds himself trapped and alone in an inescapable castle, stalked by an enemy that can't be fought. If he doesn't solve the puzzle of his captivity, then he will never leave.

episodes.title: Face The Raven
episodes.overview: Rigsy wakes up one day and finds a tattoo on his neck counting down the minutes to zero. He calls Clara's emergency number for help, and the Doctor and Clara soon discover that Rigsy is bait in a trap... but it catches the wrong person.

episodes.title: Sleep No More
episodes.overview: The Doctor and Clara find themselves aboard the Le Verrier Space Station in orbit above Triton in the 38th century, and face a deadly threat that could consume all of humanity.

episodes.title: The Zygon Inversion
episodes.overview: After the Presidential Airliner is destroyed, the Doctor and Osgood head back to London. Meanwhile, Clara discovers that she has been replaced, and the Zygon calling itself Bonnie sets out to recover the Osgood Box from the Black Archive.

episodes.title: The Zygon Invasion
episodes.overview: The Doctor and UNIT learn that the Zygon-Human truce has been broken, as a renegade faction of Zygons seek to conquer the world so that they can live in their true forms. Meanwhile, Clara witnesses a strange occurrence outside of her flat.

episodes.title: The Woman Who Lived
episodes.overview: The Doctor travels to England 1651 to find an alien artifact. What he finds instead is an old acquaintance, who he must help answer an age-old question: who wants to live forever?

episodes.title: The Girl Who Died
episodes.overview: The Doctor and Clara are captured by 10th century Vikings, only to discover that alien warriors are abducting the village fighters and harvesting their adrenaline. A young woman challenges the aliens to war, and the remaining villages turn to the Doctor for help.

episodes.title: Before the Flood
episodes.overview: The Doctor travels back to 1980 with Bennett and O'Donnell to try and stop the Fisher King from sending the message that dooms the base in the future. Meanwhile, in the future, Clara, Lunn, and Cass fight to survive the ghosts and discover that their enemies have expanded their ranks.

episodes.title: Under the Lake
episodes.overview: The Doctor and Clara arrive on an underwater base in the year 2119, and discover a base under siege. Ghosts are haunting--and killing--the crew, and the Doctor sets out to determine what they want and where they come from.

episodes.title: The Witch's Familiar
episodes.overview: On Skaro, Davros asks the captive Doctor for one last favor before his death. Meanwhile, Clara and Missy attempt reenter the Dalek city.

episodes.title: The Magician's Apprentice
episodes.overview: On modern-day Earth, planes freeze in the sky, locked in the time. UNIT turns to Clara for help, and they soon discover the person responsible: Missy, back from the dead. Missy wants their help on a unique quest: find the Doctor.

episodes.title: Death in Heaven
episodes.overview: With Cybermen on the streets of London, old friends unite against old enemies, and the Doctor takes to the air in a startling new role. Can the mighty UNIT contain Missy? As the Doctor faces his greatest challenge, sacrifices must be made before the day is won.

episodes.title: Dark Water
episodes.overview: In the mysterious world of the Nethersphere, plans have been drawn. Missy is about to come face to face with the Doctor, and an impossible choice is looming… "Death is not an end" promises the sinister organization known only as 3W – but, as the Doctor and Clara discover, you might wish it was.

episodes.title: In the Forest of the Night
episodes.overview: One morning in every city and town in the world, the human race wakes up to face the most surprising invasion yet. Everywhere, in every land, a forest has grown overnight and taken back the Earth. It doesn't take the Doctor long to discover that the final days of humanity have arrived…

episodes.title: Flatline
episodes.overview: Separated from the Doctor, Clara discovers a new menace from another dimension. But how do you hide when even the walls are no protection? With people to save and the Doctor trapped, Clara comes up against an enemy that exists beyond human perception.

episodes.title: Mummy on the Orient Express
episodes.overview: The Doctor is on the most beautiful train in history, speeding among the stars of the future. But a deadly creature is stalking the passengers. Once you see the horrifying mummy, you only have 66 seconds to live. No exceptions, no reprieve. As the Doctor races against the clock, he is seen at his deadliest and most ruthless.Will he work out how to defeat the mummy? Start the clock!

episodes.title: Kill the Moon
episodes.overview: The Doctor and Clara crash land on the Moon to find a world of horror — a mining base full of corpses, vicious spider-like creatures poised to attack, and a terrible dilemma.

episodes.title: The Caretaker
episodes.overview: The terrifying Skovox Blitzer is ready to destroy all humanity – and worse, any second now, Danny Pink and the Doctor are going to meet.

episodes.title: Time Heist
episodes.overview: The Doctor turns bank robber when he attempts to break into the most dangerous bank in the Cosmos.

episodes.title: Listen
episodes.overview: When ghosts of past and future crowd into their lives, the Doctor and Clara are thrown into an adventure that takes them to the very end of the universe.

episodes.title: Robot of Sherwood
episodes.overview: When Robots threaten Sherwood forest, the Doctor must join forces with Robin Hood to stop the evil reign of the Sheriff of Nottingham.

episodes.title: Into the Dalek
episodes.overview: A Dalek fleet surrounds a lone rebel ship, and only the Doctor can help them now… With the Doctor facing his greatest enemy, he needs Clara by his side. Confronted with a decision that could change the Daleks forever he is forced to examine his conscience. Will he find the answer to the question "am I a good man?"

episodes.title: Deep Breath
episodes.overview: Clara is alone in Victorian London with a man she doesn't know, a dinosaur in the Thames, and a spate of deadly spontaneous combustions. The Doctor has changed. It's time you knew him.

episodes.title: The Name of the Doctor
episodes.overview: Clara is summoned to an impossible conference call, alerting her that the deadly Whisper Men are closing in on Vastra, Jenny and Strax.Someone is kidnapping the Doctor's friends, leading him toward the one place in all of time and space that he should never go. It's a deadly trap that threatens to unravel his past, present and future…

episodes.title: Nightmare in Silver
episodes.overview: Hedgewick's World of Wonders was once the greatest theme park in the galaxy, but it's now the dilapidated home to a shabby showman, a chess-playing dwarf and a dysfunctional army platoon.When the Doctor, Clara, Artie and Angie arrive, the last thing they expect is the re-emergence of one of the Doctor's oldest foes. The Cybermen are back!

episodes.title: The Crimson Horror
episodes.overview: There's something very odd about Mrs Gillyflower's Sweetville mill, with its perfectly clean streets and beautiful people. There's something even stranger about the bodies washing up in the river, all bright red and waxy. When the Doctor and Clara go missing, it's up to Vastra, Jenny and Strax to rescue them before they too fall victim to the Crimson Horror!

episodes.title: Journey to the Centre of the TARDIS
episodes.overview: A spaceship salvage team drags the TARDIS on board, sending its systems into meltdown. As the Doctor marshals the motely salvage crew outside, he realizes Clara is still trapped within his malfunctioning ship, pursued by a dangerous group of ossified monsters.He has just 30 minutes to find Clara and save his TARDIS before it self-destructs.

episodes.title: Hide
episodes.overview: Clara and the Doctor arrive at Caliburn House, a haunted mansion sat alone on a desolate moor. Within its walls, a ghost hunting Professor and a gifted psychic are searching for the Witch of the Well. Her apparition appears throughout the history of the building, but is she really a ghost? And what is chasing her?

episodes.title: Cold War
episodes.overview: The Doctor and Clara land on a damaged Russian Submarine in 1983 as it spirals out of control into the ocean depths. An alien creature is loose on board, having escaped from a block of Arctic ice. With tempers flaring and a cargo of nuclear weapons on board, it's not just the crew but the whole of humanity at stake!

episodes.title: The Rings of Akhaten
episodes.overview: Clara wants to see something awesome, so the Doctor whisks her off to the inhabited rings of the planet Akhaten, where the Festival of Offerings is in full swing. Clara meets the young Queen of Years as the pilgrims and natives ready for the ceremony. But something is stirring in the pyramid, and a sacrifice will be demanded.

episodes.title: The Bells of Saint John
episodes.overview: The Doctor's search for Clara Oswald brings him to modern day London, where wifi is everywhere. Humanity lives in a wifi soup, but something dangerous is lurking in the signals, picking off minds and imprisoning them. As Clara becomes the target of this insidious menace, the Doctor races to save her and the world from an ancient enemy.

episodes.title: The Angels Take Manhattan
episodes.overview: The Doctor's heart-breaking farewell to Amy and Rory — a race against time through the streets of Manhattan, as New York's statues come to life around them… With Rory's life in danger, the Doctor and Amy must locate him before it's too late! Luckily, an old friend helps them and guides the way…

episodes.title: The Power of Three
episodes.overview: The Doctor and the Ponds puzzle an unlikely invasion of Earth, as millions of sinister black cubes arrive overnight, almost like presents falling from the sky. But what are they, what's inside them and most importantly, who sent them? With the international community at a loss, it's left to the Doctor to unearth who is behind the mystery.

episodes.title: A Town Called Mercy
episodes.overview: The Doctor gets a Stetson (and a gun!), and finds himself the reluctant Sheriff of a Western town under siege by a relentless cyborg, who goes by the name of, the Gunslinger. But who is he and what does he want? The answer seems to lie with the mysterious, Kahler-Jex, an alien doctor (yes another one!) whose initial appearance is hiding a dark secret.

episodes.title: Dinosaurs on a Spaceship
episodes.overview: An unmanned spaceship hurtles towards certain destruction – unless the Doctorcan save it, and its impossible cargo… of dinosaurs!By his side a ragtag gang of adventurers; a big game hunter, an Egyptian Queen and a surprised member of the Pond family. But little does the Doctor know there is someone else onboard who will stop at nothing to keep hold of his precious, prehistoric cargo.

episodes.title: Asylum of the Daleks
episodes.overview: Kidnapped by his oldest foe, the Doctor is forced on an impossible mission – to a place even the Daleks are too terrified to enter… the Asylum. A planetary prison confining the most terrifying and insane of their kind, the Doctor and the Ponds must find an escape route. But with Amy and Rory's relationship in meltdown, and an army of mad Daleks closing in, it is up to the Doctor to save their lives, as well as the Pond's marriage.

episodes.title: The Wedding of River Song
episodes.overview: As the Doctor makes his final journey to the shores of Lake Silencio in Utah, he knows only one thing can keep the universe safe—his own death.

episodes.title: Closing Time
episodes.overview: In the last few days of his life,the Doctorpays a farewell visit to his old friend Craig and encounters a mystery. People are going missing, a silver rat scuttles in the shadows of a department store and somewhere close by the Cybermen are waiting.

episodes.title: The God Complex
episodes.overview: The Tardis lands in what looks like an ordinary hotel. But the walls move, corridors twist and rooms vanish. There is a room for every visitor that contains their deepest, darkest fears. Fears that will kill them. What lies in the Doctor's room? And when his turn comes, will he welcome death like all the rest?

episodes.title: The Girl Who Waited
episodes.overview: Amy is trapped in a quarantine facility for victims of an alien plague—a plague that will kill the Doctor in a day. The Doctor can use the Tardis to smash through time and break in, but then Rory is on his own. Can he rescue Amy before she is killed by kindness?

episodes.title: Night Terrors
episodes.overview: The Doctor receives a distress call from the scariest place in the Universe: a child's bedroom. Terrified of the monsters in his cupboard, George's pleas for help break through the barriers of all time and space. But allaying his fears won't be easy, even for the Doctor. Because George's monsters are real.

episodes.title: Let's Kill Hitler
episodes.overview: In the desperate search for Melody Pond, the Tardis crash lands in 1930s Berlin, bringing the Doctor face-to-face with the greatest war criminal in the Universe. And Hitler. The Doctor must teach his adversaries that time travel has responsibilities—and in so doing, learns a harsh lesson in the cruelest warfare of all.

episodes.title: A Good Man Goes to War
episodes.overview: Amy Pond has been kidnapped and the Doctor is raising an army to rescue her. But as he and Rory race across galaxies calling in long-held debts and solemnly-given promises, his enemies are laying a carefully concealed trap.In her cell in Stormcage, River Song sadly acknowledges that the time has come at last. For this day will mark the Battle of Demons run and the Doctor's darkest hour. Both sides will make their sacrifices and River Song must finally reveal her most closely guarded secret to the Doctor.

episodes.title: The Almost People
episodes.overview: As the solar storm rages, Jennifer, a Ganger driven mad by the memories of being 'decommissioned', is seeking revenge. She can remember every excruciating second of every 'execution' and is determined that the humans will pay. She isn't just talking war, she's talking revolution.

episodes.title: The Rebel Flesh
episodes.overview: A solar tsunami sends the TARDIS hurtling towards a futuristic factory on earth where human doppelgangers are used to mine dangerous acid. A second wave hits and the 'Gangers' separate. They can remember every second of their 'originals' life and feel every emotion they've ever experienced.

episodes.title: The Doctor's Wife
episodes.overview: The Doctor receives a distress signal from an old friend. Could there really be another living Time Lord out there? Hopes raised, he follows the signal to a junkyard planet sitting upon a mysterious asteroid in a Bubble universe, populated by a very strange family. The Doctor, Amy and Rory are given the warmest of welcomes by Auntie, Uncle and Nephew.But the beautiful and insane Idris greets them in a more unusual fashion—what is she trying to tell the Doctor? As the Doctor investigates, he unwittingly puts his friends in the gravest danger.

episodes.title: The Curse of the Black Spot
episodes.overview: The TARDIS is marooned onboard a 17th-century pirate ship whose crew is being attacked by a mysterious and beautiful sea creature, as the time-traveling drama continues.Becalmed and beset by cabin fever, the pirates have numerous superstitious explanations for the appearance of a mysterious Siren. The Doctor has other ideas but as every plan of escape is thwarted, he must win the trust of the implacable Captain Avery and uncover the truth behind the pirates' supernatural fears—and he must work quickly because some of his friends have already fallen under the Siren's spell …

episodes.title: Day of the Moon
episodes.overview: The Doctor is locked in the perfect prison. Amy, Rory and River Song are being hunted down across America by the FBI. With the help of new friend and FBI-insider, Canton Everett Delaware the Third, they reunite to share their discoveries and memories.

episodes.title: The Impossible Astronaut
episodes.overview: Four envelopes, numbered 2, 3 and 4, each containing a date, time and map reference, unsigned and TARDIS blue. Who sent them? And who received the missing envelope numbered 1?

episodes.title: The Big Bang
episodes.overview: The Doctor is gone, the Tardis has been destroyed and the universe is collapsing. The only hope for all of reality is a little girl who still believes in stars…

episodes.title: The Pandorica Opens
episodes.overview: According to legend, the Pandorica contains the most feared being in all the cosmos, a monster soaked in the blood of a billion galaxies.

episodes.title: The Lodger
episodes.overview: There's a house on Aickman road and a staircase that people go up, but never down. To solve the mystery of the man upstairs the Doctor must face his greatest challenge.

episodes.title: Vincent and the Doctor
episodes.overview: Terror lurks in the cornfields of Provence, but only a sad and lonely painter can see it.

episodes.title: Cold Blood
episodes.overview: It's the most important day in the history of Earth—the dawn of a new age of harmony or the start of its final war.

episodes.title: The Hungry Earth
episodes.overview: 2015: the most ambitious drilling project in history has reached deeper below the Earth's crust than man has ever gone – but now the ground itself is fighting back.

episodes.title: Amy's Choice
episodes.overview: It's been five years since Amy Pond traveled with the Doctor and when he lands in her garden again, on the eve of the birth of her first child, she finds herself facing a heartbreaking choice.

episodes.title: The Vampires of Venice
episodes.overview: Desiccated corpses, terror in the canal, and the sinister House of Calvierri—the Doctor takes Amy and Rory for a romantic mini-break.

episodes.title: Flesh and Stone
episodes.overview: No way back, no way up, no way out. Trapped among an army of Weeping Angels the Doctor and his friends must try to escape through the wreckage of a crashed space liner.

episodes.title: The Time of Angels
episodes.overview: Don't blink—the Weeping Angels return! The Doctor is recruited by Father Octavian to track the last of the Angels through the terrifying Maze of the Dead. And the mysterious River Song is back in the Doctor's life—but can he trust her?

episodes.title: Victory of the Daleks
episodes.overview: The Doctor has been summoned by an old friend, but in the Cabinet War Rooms far below the streets of London, it's his oldest enemy he finds waiting for him.

episodes.title: The Beast Below
episodes.overview: The Doctor takes Amy to the distant future where she finds Britain in space. Starship UK houses the future of the British people, as they search the stars for a new home. But as Amy explores, she encounters the terrifying Smilers and learns a deadly truth inside the Voting Booth.

episodes.title: The Eleventh Hour
episodes.overview: The Doctor has regenerated into a brand new man, but danger strikes before he can even recover.

episodes.title: Journey's End
episodes.overview: Season 4 concludes with the Doctor's companions making a last stand against Davros and the Daleks with the Doctor and the TARDIS both out of commission.

episodes.title: The Stolen Earth
episodes.overview: The Earth gets hijacked and relocated by a new Dalek empire, prompting the Doctor's allies--Rose Tyler, Sarah Jane Smith, Capt. Jack Harkness and Martha Jones--to band together while an old enemy lurks behind the scenes.

episodes.title: Turn Left
episodes.overview: What would have happened if the Doctor had died facing the Racnoss? We find a nightmare world as Donna and Rose attempt to stop the approaching Darkness.

episodes.title: Midnight
episodes.overview: Vacation plans go awry for the Doctor when he joins tourists on a flight over the crystalline planet Midnight, where the passengers encounter a malevolent force.

episodes.title: Forest of the Dead
episodes.overview: As the shadows rise, the Doctor forges an alliance with the mysterious River Song. But can they halt the advance of the Vashta Nerada?

episodes.title: Silence in the Library
episodes.overview: The Doctor meets River Song for the first time as he and Donna face the Vashta Nerada!

episodes.title: The Unicorn and the Wasp
episodes.overview: In 1926, Agatha Christie disappeared for ten days. Was a giant alien wasp to blame?

episodes.title: The Doctor's Daughter
episodes.overview: As the shadows of war loom on the planet Messaline, the Doctor meets the most important woman of his life...

episodes.title: The Poison Sky
episodes.overview: As the Sontarans choke the Earth, the Doctor and UNIT battle to keep both Martha and Donna alive.

episodes.title: The Sontaran Stratagem
episodes.overview: Martha Jones summons the Doctor back to UNIT and modern-day Earth, but an old enemy lies in wait.

episodes.title: Planet of the Ood
episodes.overview: The Doctor takes Donna to her first alien world, where she finds the human race has developed dark secrets...

episodes.title: The Fires of Pompeii
episodes.overview: It's Volcano Day in Pompeii... Can Donna dare the Doctor to change history?

episodes.title: Partners in Crime
episodes.overview: Donna and the Doctor reunite and must save the lives of millions threatened by a sinister alien... Allons-y!

episodes.title: Last of the Time Lords
episodes.overview: Earth has been conquered, the Doctor and Jack are imprisoned and the Master rules supreme. Can Martha Jones save the world?

episodes.title: The Sound of Drums
episodes.overview: Harry Saxon - aka the Master - becomes prime minister, but his dark ambitions reach beyond the stars.

episodes.title: Utopia
episodes.overview: Captain Jack Harkness storms back into the Doctor's life, and at the end of the universe, an evil old enemy is waiting...

episodes.title: Blink
episodes.overview: Only the Doctor can stop the Weeping Angels, but he's lost in time. So Sally Sparrow must fly into action...

episodes.title: The Family of Blood
episodes.overview: It's 1913, and war comes to England early as the terrifying Family hunt for the Doctor.

episodes.title: Human Nature
episodes.overview: A schoolteacher called John Smith dreams of adventures in time and space...
The Doctor and Martha must stop a spaceship from hurtling into the sun. But time and a malevolent alien force are against them.

episodes.title: The Lazarus Experiment
episodes.overview: Martha has to save her family from the lunatic schemes of the monstrous Professor Lazarus.

episodes.title: Evolution of the Daleks
episodes.overview: As a new Dalek Empire rises in 1930s New York, the Doctor must enter an unholy alliance.

episodes.title: Daleks in Manhattan
episodes.overview: The Doctor finds his oldest enemies at work on top of the Empire State Building when he and Martha travel to 1930s New York.

episodes.title: Gridlock
episodes.overview: The Doctor takes Martha to New Earth, where he must battle a powerful old enemy and have a fateful meeting with the Face of Boe...

episodes.title: The Shakespeare Code
episodes.overview: In Elizabethan England, William Shakespeare is under the control of witch-like creatures.

episodes.title: Smith and Jones
episodes.overview: A Judoon platoon on the moon and a vampiric alien! It's all happening when Martha meets the Doctor.

episodes.title: Doomsday
episodes.overview: As the human race is caught in a war between Daleks and Cybermen, the Doctor faces losing Rose.

episodes.title: Army of Ghosts
episodes.overview: The Cybermen have invaded Earth, but the Doctor and Torchwood are about to confront an even greater threat.

episodes.title: Fear Her
episodes.overview: London, 2012. The Doctor has brought Rose to see the Olympics, but a little girl unwittingly threatens billions of lives.

episodes.title: Love & Monsters
episodes.overview: Who is the sinister and mysterious Victor Kennedy, and why is he so keen to find the Doctor?

episodes.title: The Satan Pit
episodes.overview: As Rose battles the murderous Ood, the Doctor must grapple with a monster that challenges his every belief: the Beast.

episodes.title: The Impossible Planet
episodes.overview: The Doctor and Rose land in a base on an 'impossible planet'. But the TARDIS is missing, there's a killer in the base, and who are the Ood?

episodes.title: The Idiot's Lantern
episodes.overview: A face-stealing alien is rampant in Britain at the time of Queen Elizabeth II's coronation. The Doctor and Rose investigate!

episodes.title: The Age of Steel
episodes.overview: The Cybermen take control of London and start converting the populace. It looks like even the Doctor is beaten...

episodes.title: Rise of the Cybermen
episodes.overview: On a parallel Earth where Rose's parents remained together, the Doctor sees a terrifying enemy reborn... The Cybermen are coming!

episodes.title: The Girl in the Fireplace
episodes.overview: The Doctor is smitten by Madame de Pompadour, but the court at Versailles is under attack from Clockwork killers...

episodes.title: School Reunion
episodes.overview: The return of Sarah Jane and K-9! The Doctor plus companions old and new fight the bat-like Krillitanes!

episodes.title: Tooth and Claw
episodes.overview: Queen Victoria, a werewolf and the birth of Torchwood... The Doctor's trip to Scotland, 1879, could prove fatal...

episodes.title: New Earth
episodes.overview: The Doctor is summoned to an apparently beautiful 'New Earth' where he and Rose find gruesome secrets inside a luxury hospital.

episodes.title: The Parting of the Ways
episodes.overview: The Ninth Doctor's final episode is an epic encounter with the Daleks.

episodes.title: Bad Wolf
episodes.overview: The Doctor, Rose and Captain Jack fight for their lives on board the Game Station, but disaster strikes when the Daleks capture Rose!

episodes.title: Boom Town
episodes.overview: The Doctor, Rose and Captain Jack discover a Slitheen is behind a plan to build a nuclear power station in Cardiff.

episodes.title: The Doctor Dances
episodes.overview: 'Are you my mummy?' The Child's plague is spreading throughout wartime London, and it looks like Captain Jack is doomed.

episodes.title: The Empty Child
episodes.overview: Homeless children in wartime London are terrorised by an unearthly child. Plus we meet a certain Captain Jack...

episodes.title: Father's Day
episodes.overview: Rose witnesses the day her father died, but interfering leads to terrible consequences... and sinister creatures!

episodes.title: The Long Game
episodes.overview: The Doctor investigates a strange satellite, and Adam's skills as an assistant are tested.

episodes.title: Dalek
episodes.overview: The Doctor is shattered and Earth is in danger as he and Rose discover the Time Lords' deadliest enemy beneath Utah.

episodes.title: World War Three
episodes.overview: Time is running out for the Doctor as Downing Street announces mankind's first Interplanetary War.

episodes.title: Aliens of London
episodes.overview: Rose is taken home, but a spaceship crashes in the Thames and London is closed off... Enter the Slitheen!

episodes.title: The Unquiet Dead
episodes.overview: Charles Dickens and the Doctor team up as corpses stalk the streets of Victorian Cardiff.

episodes.title: The End of the World
episodes.overview: The Doctor takes Rose on her first voyage through time, to the year five billion and the end of planet Earth.

episodes.title: Rose
episodes.overview: Rose Tyler meets a mysterious stranger called the Doctor, and realises Earth is in danger.
